title: EUC Project Manager( contract )
description:
Sword is a leading provider of business technology solutions within the Energy, Public and Finance Sectors, driving real transformation change within our clients. We use proven technology, specialist teams and domain expertise to build solid technical foundations across platforms, data and business applications. We have a passion for using technology to solve business problems, working in partnership with our clients to help in achieving their goals.

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager (End User Computing) to join a key technology programme, leading the delivery of a large-scale device refresh and rollout project.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on Project Manager with a strong background in end-user technology deployments, who can coordinate stakeholders, manage delivery timelines, and ensure a seamless experience for end users throughout the rollout.

  • Project Planning & Delivery
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria.
  • Build and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, and dependencies.
  • Manage project budgets, resources, and schedules.
  • Track progress and report status to stakeholders.
  • End User Computing Workstream Leadership
  • Lead device refresh and laptop deployment projects.
  • Manage M365 migrations and user transitions.
  • Coordinate application deployments and upgrades.
  • Oversee user onboarding and device lifecycle activities.
  • Ensure readiness for go-live and transition to BAU support.
  • Stakeholder & Vendor Management
  • Work with Service Desk, Infrastructure, Security, EUC Engineers, and Business Leads.
  • Coordinate third-party suppliers and vendors.
  • Manage communications with users, project teams, and sponsors.
  • Facilitate workshops, governance meetings, and steering committees

Requirements

  • Proven experience delivering EUC, desktop, laptop, or device refresh projects.
  • Strong Project Management background within enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience managing multiple stakeholders across technical and business teams.
  • Excellent communication, planning, and organisational skills.
  • Ability to manage risks, issues, and project dependencies effectively.
  • Experience working with deployment engineers, service desk teams, and infrastructure teams.
  • Familiarity with project delivery methodologies and governance practices.
  • Energy , Oil & Gas industry Experience

Benefits

At Sword, our core values and culture are based on caring about our people, investing in training and career development and building inclusive teams where we are all encouraged to contribute to achieve success.

We offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your professional development and enhance your overall quality of life. In addition to a Competitive Salary, here's what you can expect as part of our benefits package:

Personalised Career Development: We create a development plan customised to your goals and aspirations, with a range of learning and development opportunities within a culture that encourages growth.

Flexible working: Flexible work arrangements to support your work-life balance. We can’t promise to always be able to meet every request, however are keen to discuss your individual preferences to make it work where we can.

A Fantastic Benefits Package: This includes generous annual leave allowance, enhanced family friendly benefits, pension scheme, access to private health, well-being, and insurance schemes, an employee assistance programme, discounted cash plan and more…..

At Sword we are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, ensuring that all applicants receive fair and equal consideration for employment, regardless of whether they meet every requirement. If you don’t tick all the boxes but feel you have some of the relevant skills and experience we’re looking for, please do consider applying and highlight your transferable skills and experience. We embrace diversity in all its forms, valuing individuals regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. Your perspective and potential are important to us.

title: Investment Banking Senior Associate | Industrials (ADG)
description:

Corporate Finance

Industrials



Overview

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.



Corporate Finance

Houlihan Lokey has extensive expertise in mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, activist shareholder and takeover defense, and other related advisory services for a broad range of U.S. and international clients. Our experience in M&A has earned us consistent recognition throughout the industry. In 2025, LSEG ranked our firm the No. 1 investment bank for all global M&A transactions.



Industrials

Houlihan Lokey’s Industrials Group has earned a reputation for providing superior service and achieving outstanding results in M&A advisory, capital-raising, restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory services.

Our transaction quality and client work benefit from our company culture, where financial professionals are highly engaged in the execution of client projects, and from our experience as leaders in the market for over a decade, which has given our professionals valuable exposure to a variety of situations and challenges. .

Job Description

Associates are an integral part of Houlihan Lokey’s business activities and play a key role in the delivery of exceptional service to our clients. Houlihan Lokey hires Associates to work specifically as part of industry aligned teams, assisting with a variety of investment banking services and transactions. This position will be based in our DC - Tysons Corner office and will support our ADG - Government Services industry coverage efforts as part of our global Industrials Group.

Associates support all facets of our investment banking engagements by:

  • Managing client relationships

  • Participating in end-to-end transaction execution including but not limited to the following:

  • Preparing confidential information memoranda, marketing, and presentation materials

  • Analyzing historical and projected financial information

  • Developing complex financial and valuation models

  • Coordinating transaction execution

  • Building data rooms and managing due diligence processes

  • Participating in the development of recommendations to clients alongside senior bankers

  • Managing and supervising junior banking team members

  • Assisting senior bankers with the new business development process, including the development of pitch books, identifying prospective new clients, etc.

Basic Qualifications

The environment at Houlihan Lokey is collegial entrepreneurial, and as such, rewards high performing team members that are driven to succeed with substantial responsibility. The ideal candidate should be motivated, creative and outgoing, and possess:

  • At least four years of investment banking experience

  • An undergraduate degree with academic distinction

Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive financial modeling experience and strong analytical abilities

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • A very high degree of intellectual curiosity and the ability to think independently

  • The ability to work cooperatively with all levels of staff

  • The ability to manage multiple projects and hit deadlines in a highly organized manner

  • An independent, solutions-focused mindset





Compensation and Benefits

Houlihan Lokey is committed to providing its employees with an exciting career opportunity and competitive total compensation package, which may include other components such as discretionary incentive compensation. The firm’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the possible salary range for this role at the time of posting is:



$200,000 - $225,000



Actual salary at the time of hire may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant qualifications, skills, and experience and the location where this position may be filled.

2026 Benefits

description:

The Browne Center is currently hiring Corporate Facilitators to work on specific programs with a variety of populations from youth and students to non-profits, corporate and other adult groups. The Browne Center exists because we believe that human connections are the catalyst for positive change. We achieve this by designing and facilitating learning and development experiences.

With a 30-year history of working with various types of organizations, the Browne Center is known for it’s leading-edge expertise in meaningful and actionable programs tailored to meet each individual client’s needs. Programs for clients range in scope from one-day experiences to multi-day – spread over the course of a year or back-to-back.

Our facilities include: a 52-element challenge course, a climbing chimney, an orienteering course, all equipment to successfully manage and lead activities associated with aforementioned elements, a seminar building, yurts and access to over 100 acres on the Great Bay.

The Browne Center has two broad client population groups it serves – Corporate/Organizational and Youth/Student.

The Browne Center prides itself in enhancing interpersonal skills:

  • Leadership

  • Team Development

  • Community Building

  • Trust building

  • Empathy

  • Communication

  • Trust

  • Self-Awareness and Advocacy

  • Healthy Risk Taking and Resiliency

  • Conflict Resolution

  • Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Careful and intentional facilitation of group process to ensure a high quality and high-impact client experience.

  • Address client learning objectives by following program design provided to facilitators by Lead or Program Manager.

  • Management of risks – physical, social and emotional - associated with both group process as well as use of experiential activities including challenge course.

  • Responsible use and care of all Browne Center equipment including all props, climbing ropes, etc. All required equipment and facilities will be provided to each facilitator.

  • Delivery of one-off or multi-day programs focused on team dynamics, leadership, and various aspects of interpersonal skill development.

  • Facilitators are responsible for working with Browne Center Program Directors to meet specific client needs.

  • Delivery of programming both on-site at The Browne Center as well as off-site at hotels, conference centers, office locations.

Program Preparation (20%)

Program Delivery (70%)

  • Program facilitation and interfacing with clients

Follow-up (10%)

  • Any related follow-up items with client. This may include summarizing notes from facilitated meetings, suggested follow-on readings to support the work of the group, etc.

  • Post program debrief and proper return of gear/materials

Minimum Acceptable Education & Experience:

  • Minimum acceptable education is a 4-year college degree; in a related field – Business, Organizational Behavior/Development, Education, etc.

  • Relevant practical experience leading teams and/or organizations

  • Experience with facilitating experiential learning activities and exercises

Desired Certifications:

title: Payment Insight Analyst I
description:
Overview

The Payment Insight Analyst I is a position within the CCV business unit responsible for reviewing internal and client systems, as well as contracts, to determine how healthcare claims should be paid. This role involves analyzing claim information, interpreting client requirements, and applying contractual terms to ensure accurate claim pricing in accordance with established guidelines and client expectations. The analyst partners with internal audit teams to support compliance and quality initiatives, consistently meets performance metrics, and adheres to appropriate workflows and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documents to ensure consistency and accuracy across all claim activities.

Responsibilities

  • Review internal and client systems to determine eligibility and payment methodologies for healthcare claims.
  • Analyze claim documentation to identify accurate repricing approaches based on contractual terms.
  • Interpret and apply client-specific requirements to the claim repricing process.
  • Ensure claims are repriced in accordance with established guidelines and client expectations.
  • Partner with internal audit teams to support compliance and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Meet or exceed established performance metrics for accuracy, timeliness, and productivity.
  • Adhere to defined workflows and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documents to maintain consistency.
  • Maintain detailed and organized documentation of all repricing activities and outcomes.
  • Identify discrepancies or potential issues in claims and escalate them per company protocols.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and other departments to resolve claim-related questions.
  • Participate in training sessions and stay updated on changes to policies, procedures, and client requirements.
  • Support the implementation of process improvements to enhance claim repricing accuracy and efficiency.
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive client and patient information in compliance with company policies and HIPAA regulations.
  • Assist in compiling operational reports and data as requested by management.
  • Contribute to a positive team environment by demonstrating professionalism, reliability, and a commitment to company values.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Minimum one-year professional experience.
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Finance, or a related field preferred.
  • Relevant coursework or training in healthcare claims, insurance, or data analysis is a plus.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
  • Minimum one year of experience in a healthcare, insurance, or claims processing environment preferred. (Education Experience can be substituted, in lieu of professional experience).
  • Experience working with data entry, documentation, or administrative tasks.
  • Experience adhering to quality standards and compliance processes is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in reviewing and processing data.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to interpret contracts, guidelines, and client requirements.
  • Proficiency with computer systems and basic office software (e.g., Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook).
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to follow established workflows and SOPs.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills to meet deadlines and performance metrics.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new processes and systems.
  • Professionalism and commitment to confidentiality (HIPAA compliance).

Cognitive/Mental Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
  • Maintaining focus.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.

Base compensation ranges from $19.00 to $22.75 per hour. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Nonexempt employees are eligible to receive overtime pay for hours worked in excess of 40 hours in a given week, or as otherwise required by applicable state law.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 10/3/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

This is mind blowing.” See some of our recent Awards and Recognition and read about some of the reasons to live in Cincinnati.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is seeking a Principal Hardware Test Engineer to join the System Integration & Test (SEIT) team in Cincinnati, OH. The role involves conducting comprehensive verification activities throughout the program life cycle, including requirements analysis, test procedure development, test execution, and formal reporting. This position will be 100% on-site.

Please be aware that this position will be contingent upon obtaining funding, customer approval and holding final clearances prior to start date.*

Essential Duties:

  • Develop hardware test requirements and detailed integration test plans, procedures, readiness reviews (TRRs), test data, and reports.
  • Execute hardware qualification testing in accordance with established requirements, plans, and procedures.
  • Conduct hardware tests while managing and prioritizing problem resolution.
  • Compile data to determine necessary changes in test equipment, procedures, or to establish new test requirements.
  • Lead cross-functional testing (including hardware, software, and systems engineers) in both laboratory and field environments.
  • Conduct formal technical reviews, such as Test Readiness Reviews (TRRs) with internal stakeholders and external customers.
  • Test Equipment Management that includes the design, development, or integration of specialized test equipment, instrumentation, and data acquisition systems.
  • Data Analysis of test data, identify anomalies, perform root cause analysis, and generate comprehensive test reports.
  • Technical and operational problem solving to troubleshoot complex, multi-domain system failures (hardware/software/mechanical) and conduct root cause analyses.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact during test events, managing customer expectations and reporting results.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM discipline from an accredited university with 5 years of related test experience, or a Master's Degree in a STEM discipline from an accredited university with 3 years of related test experience, or a PhD in a STEM discipline from an accredited university with 1 year of related test experience.
  • Experience authoring hardware test procedures, managing hardware test facility interfaces, and ensuring data integrity and cataloging with general direction.
  • Experience with hardware test execution, diagnostics, and formal requirement decomposition with traceability and verification with general direction.
  • Strong working knowledge of standard test equipment: RF Power Meters, Frequency Generators, Network Analyzers, Spectrum Analyzers, Oscilloscopes, Waveform Generators, Synthesizers, Digitizers, and/or Signal Analyzers.
  • Proficient in at least one of the following software packages used in hardware testing: LabVIEW, MATLAB, and Python and/or have experience with test interfaces such as: Ehternet TCP/IP, USB, GPIB, RS-232, RS-422, etc.
  • Active US Government Secret Level security clearance or the ability to obtain one.
  • US Citizenship is required
  • Ability to work 100% onsite is required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to apply problem solving skills to provide technical hardware solutions to complex engineering test cases.
  • Experience creating automated test scripts that integrate with hardware interfaces.
  • Experience working with operational hazards such as overhead lifting, Thermal Chambers, and Vibration Test systems
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple, shifting priorities while maintaining safety standards.
  • Demonstrated leadership of System Test efforts in a dynamic work environment.
  • Experience with COMSEC material management.
  • Experience engaging external customers through meetings, presentations, and technical negotiations.
  • Active US Government Top Secret Level security clearance.

Primary Level Salary Range: $94,200.00 - $141,200.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

title: Data Engineer - Microsoft Fabric / Azure
description:
De Nationale Loterij gaat op zoek naar een Data Engineer - Microsoft Fabric / Azure.


Al meer dan 90 jaar biedt de Nationale Loterij alle meerderjarige Belgen veilig en verantwoord spelplezier aan. De Nationale Loterij staat sterk door het volle vertrouwen dat zij bij haar spelers geniet: precies daarom was zij in staat om in 2025 een omzetcijfer te laten optekenen van 1,666 miljard euro. Dankzij het principe van kleine bedragen die bij haar spelen worden ingezet door een groot aantal spelers, kan de Nationale Loterij jaar in jaar uit niet minder dan 385 miljoen euro laten terugvloeien naar de Belgische samenleving. Op die manier kunnen tal van projecten en verenigingen die zinvol werk leveren ten gunste van de gemeenschap, de financiële steun genieten die zij nodig hebben om het verschil te kunnen maken.

Dat alles is echter enkel mogelijk op voorwaarde dat de Nationale Loterij de absolute referentie blijft in haar sector, enerzijds door haar reputatie van betrouwbaarheid en onberispelijkheid in stand te houden, en anderzijds door haar spelers de beste speelervaring aan te bieden met een gevarieerd gamma van producten en speelkanalen.


In het Data Platform Team van de Nationale Loterij ben jij de drijvende kracht van de automatisering, de betrouwbaarheid en het prestatievermogen van onze infrastructuur. Je bent veel meer dan een beheerder van pipelines: jij kneedt onze architectuur immers zodanig dat onze data vlot én veilig kunnen circuleren.

Wij zijn op zoek naar een senior profiel dat zelfstandig kan werken en heldere technische beslissingen kan nemen, en tegelijkertijd blijk geeft van teamgeest op basis van feedback, gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid en een transparante communicatie.

Dit is je takenpakket als Data Engineer - Microsoft Fabric / Azure:

  • een modern concept: het Medallion Design. In nauwe samenwerking met de Data Architect en de Solution Designer werk je onze nieuwe data-architectuur uit (Bronze/Silver/Gold) en implementeer je ze in het Azure-ecosysteem.
  • Generieke Data Engineering: jij beheert het verzamelen, de integratie en de opslag van gegevens die afkomstig zijn van verschillende bronnen. In dat verband garandeer je een krachtige en opschaalbare transformatielogica.
  • Automatisering en DataOps: je ontwerpt en onderhoudt kritische Azure DevOps (CI/CD)-pipelines met de bedoeling om onze data-oplossingen op grote schaal te kunnen implementeren.
  • Ondersteuning van de Data Science: je verricht analyses en modelleringen van data. Vervolgens werk je samen met de Data Scientists om de modellen in kwestie te implementeren, op te schalen en in productie te zetten.
  • Optimalisering en prestatievermogen: jij zorgt voor de Performance Tuning van de Big Data-verwerkingen (Spark) en van de SQL-omgevingen, om op die manier een maximale efficiëntie van het platform te garanderen.
  • Het ecosysteem Azure Fabric: jij beheert en optimaliseert de Azure Stack (Synapse, Lakehouse, Fabric), met inbegrip van de semantische modellen en van de Power BI-integratie.

Waarom uitgerekend jij het verschil kan maken!

Ervaring: je hebt een erkend senior profiel. Je kan een ruime, onderbouwde ervaring voorleggen in een complexe Cloud Data-omgeving (deze functie staat dus niet open voor junior profielen).

Technische deskundigheid waarover je absoluut moet beschikken:

  • Data Processing: je beheerst PySpark.
  • DevOps: je bent een expert op het vlak van CI/CD-pipelines in Azure.
  • Opslag en transformatie: je beschikt over een stevige ervaring met dbt, SQL en T-SQL.
  • Azure Cloud: je beheerst de Data Stack (Synapse Analytics, Lakehouse, et idealiter ook Microsoft Fabric).
  • Architectuur: je beheerst de semantische modellen en de dimensionele modellering (de Kimball Methodology), en hun implementatie in analytische Power BI-architecturen.

Soft Skills:

  • Zelfstandigheid: je kan initiatieven op een autonome manier opstarten en van a tot z beheren.
  • Betrouwbaarheid: je hebt een grote verantwoordelijkheidszin en je geeft blijk van een sterke betrokkenheid bij het werk dat je als owner aflevert. Daarenboven beschik je over de bekwaamheid om berichten of ideeën goed te keuren of af te keuren.
  • Teamgeest: je bent een prima communicator, je hebt een feedback-cultuur en je vindt samenwerken leuk.
  • Structuur: je kan structuur aanbrengen in je eigen werk en in dat van anderen.
  • Nieuwsgierigheid: in dat kader ben je grondig op de hoogte van de rol van gemanipuleerde gegevens en kan je dus de Business-afdelingen van de Nationale Loterij perfect bijstaan om werkelijke waarde te creëren.

title: Senior Product Designer, Pricing
description:
Who we are:

At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.


About the team:

Our Product Design team is a vibrant ensemble of customer advocates, product designers, and user researchers working together on a global scale. We are dedicated to enhancing connections between pet parents and pet service providers. Our mission extends to developing sophisticated solutions that tackle diverse challenges with the booking experience, cross-platform communication, personalized scheduling, secure payments, and building trust and ensuring safety in the marketplace. Our team plays a crucial role in elevating the marketplace experience across web, iOS, and Android platforms, significantly impacting the end-to-end customer journey.

Who we are looking for:

Rover is launching a brand-new team focused on pricing, and we're looking for a Sr. Product Designer to help shape it from the ground up. This is a 6-month contract engagement with the opportunity to extend, ideal for a designer who's energized by ambiguity and excited to help define a new focus area for the company.

Pricing touches nearly every part of the Rover experience, so this role will work across the design org rather than within a single, siloed team. You'll partner closely with Data Analytics and Marketplace teams to understand how pricing decisions affect owners, sitters, and the marketplace as a whole, and you'll need to be a strong communicator and coordinator to keep your work aligned with the many other teams whose scope you'll touch.

You will apply your keen eye for detail and solid understanding of user-centered design principles to craft compelling pricing experiences. Utilizing data, you will rigorously evaluate, test, and refine theories, designs, and behavioral triggers, ensuring they meet high standards of usability and engagement.

As a senior member of the team, you will serve as a subject-matter expert and advocate for the customer during the exploration, planning, and implementation of user-centered features. You will have ownership over the design process, ensuring that experiences are rooted in trust and feature high-quality visual aesthetics. You will maintain a consistent look and feel across all devices, aligning with strategic design objectives, our design system, and specific product requirements.

You should have extensive experience in product design, with a robust portfolio demonstrating proficiency in creating user-centered design solutions across various platforms. You will need to handle multiple projects simultaneously and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including teams outside your immediate pod. A proven track record of impactful design implementations that drove improvements in user experience and business outcomes is essential.

Rover is also in the midst of transitioning to an AI-native product development lifecycle, so a genuine curiosity about and comfort with AI tools is important for this role.

The role:

  • Help define the strategy, scope, and working rhythms of a net-new pricing team at Rover.

  • Run workshops and collaborate closely with product management to identify and define strategic product-investment opportunities that align with our key objectives.

  • Work hand-in-hand with product managers, engineers, and data analysts to establish product requirements, roadmaps, and user experiences around pricing.

  • Partner with our UX Research team to conduct user and usability testing throughout the product life-cycle, ensuring a seamless user experience.

  • Employ a human-centered design approach, blending psychological insights, data, and user research to guide design decisions.

  • Coordinate closely with designers on other teams whose scope intersects with pricing, ensuring consistency and clear communication across the broader design org.

  • Consistently integrate empathy and user insights into daily interactions with your team, championing the voice of our users.

  • Take full ownership of your projects, actively seeking and incorporating feedback from peers, stakeholders, and customers to enhance our community's experience for both owners and sitters.

  • Create engaging customer experiences from concept to engineering-ready deliverables.

  • Bring curiosity and hands-on familiarity with AI tools to support a more AI-native design and product development process.

  • Establish and track customer experience metrics for your projects, ensuring alignment with our goals.

What we are looking for in you:

  • 5+ years of experience in UX/Product design.

  • Track record of proven customer and business outcomes.

  • Comfort working with data analytics; experience partnering with data or analytics teams to inform design decisions is strongly preferred.

  • Proficiency in design tools like Figma and other prototyping software.

  • Experience across various UX design platforms, including web, mobile web, and native apps.

  • Strong coordination and communication skills, with experience working across multiple teams or stakeholder groups on shared or overlapping scope.

  • Ability to effectively consolidate diverse stakeholder views to achieve aligned objectives and explore innovative solutions.

  • Strong track record of collaborative work with creatives, utilizing excellent critical thinking skills.

  • Data-driven design approach, with comfort in using business, product, and UX metrics to inform decisions.

  • In-depth knowledge of UXR research methodologies and a strong partnership approach with our growing UX Research team.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and enthusiasm for helping stand up a new team and focus area.

  • Familiarity with and curiosity about AI tools in the product design and development process.

  • Excellent communication skills with stakeholders, coupled with the ability to manage expectations and gracefully receive feedback.

  • Commitment to producing high-quality, polished, and professional work.

  • Bachelor's degree in human-computer interaction, user experience design, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

We would love it if you also had:

  • Experience with a two-sided marketplace.

  • Experience designing pricing, monetization, or related economic/marketplace mechanics.

At Rover, we’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, while doing our jobs better than ever before. We believe the best business outcomes come from a diverse set of perspectives and we’re committed to promoting an inclusive, inventive, and fun environment with amazing employees. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.
Rover is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, military or veteran status, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or partnership status, genetic predisposition, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.
We are committed to work with you to look for reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Northrop Grumman Space Systems – Launch and Missile Defense Systems has an exciting career opportunity for a Software (SW) Configuration Analyst 5 to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. This position will be located in Huntsville, AL.

The selected SW Configuration Analyst 5 will join the Ground-based Midcourse Defense (GMD) Weapons System (GWS) Configuration Management and Data Management (CM/DM) Team supporting successful and compliant execution of all phases of Configuration & Data Management (CDM) principles (planning, configuration identification, change control, status accounting, verification/audits, and data management).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drives the successful outcome of CM activities across the GMD weapon‑system portfolio, encompassing software, integration with subcontractor-produced hardware, and all sites.

  • Develops and maintains software configuration management tools to support configuration identification, control, reporting, and delivery of both internally developed and externally purchased commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) software products.

  • Performs configuration management and release engineering to ensure new software product operating parameters are traceable, comply with standard hardware configurations, and are logistically sustainable.

  • Communicate issues and risks pertaining to CDM implementation and potential solutions.

  • Manage Change Records End to End – create, track, and control modification records, ensuring rigorous management oversight and traceability of multiple baselines.

  • Collaborate with key program stakeholders, to ensure the successful release of software artifacts and the creation of deployment media.

  • Synchronize Engineering Change Data – partnering with engineering, quality, operations, and data control groups to implement released changes smoothly across HW and SW product lines.

  • Upholds configuration control and certifies baselines revisions throughout the project lifecycle. Performs configuration status accounting and physical configuration audits.

  • Prioritize and manage emergency software releases, supporting the engineering team(s), ensuring timely resolution of operational deficiencies or anomalies that affect customer satisfaction.

  • Completes SW CM and media integrity checks.

  • Partners with software developers in the use of configuration management tools and the implementation of software quality standards.

  • Designs and implements build procedures that are used to support software product development and use. May develop / release program command-media.

  • Supports the harmonization of CDM processes and tools while championing innovative solutions to improve efficiency.

  • Operate and plan in an Agile environment.

The selected candidate should thrive in a fast-paced work environment with high expectations and work closely with Program/Engineering leadership to ensure long-term/short-term milestones are accomplished.

  • Bachelor’s Degree plus 12 years of relevant experience in Configuration Management (CM)/Data Management (DM); or a Master’s Degree plus 10 years of relevant experience; or a PhD. and 8 years of relevant Experience.

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and must have the ability to obtain a DOD security clearance to a level of Secret, which is required to start

  • Understanding and demonstrated experience with the implementation of configuration management standards and practices (e.g., ISO, ANSI, CMII) and baseline management

  • Experience with analyzing proposed changes of product design to determine effect on overall product and system baseline

  • Experience in reviewing contract documents to determine documentation/product delivery requirements for each phase of project

  • Strong Software Configuration Management background.

  • Experience using configuration and data management tools

  • Experience working configuration management in a highly regulated industry

  • Experience performing and analyzing data integrity scans

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Must be able to support an in-person / closed-area work environment full-time

  • Ability and willingness to travel 10% to support business needs

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience operating in Agile development environments; including CI/CD pipeline.

  • Experience using Bitbucket, Confluence, and Jira.

  • Experience with CM and product lifecycle management (PLM) tools.

  • Experience with SW CM branching strategies & tagging, pull requests, merges, and build versioning.

  • Ability to identify the needs to build automation, designing and implementing CI/CD solutions

  • Experience running and analyzing Checksum scans.

  • Demonstrated implementation of configuration status accounting / CM verification.

  • Strong knowledge of how business processes work together to ensure interfaces with other business processes are efficient.

  • Experience managing customer deliverables (CDRLs) and/or supplier deliverables (SDRLs).

  • Experience in developing impact assessments.

  • Experience in developing impact assessments and proposals estimations.

Job Description:

Lead Data Engineer

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Lead Data Engineer will work as part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will serve as lead for designing, building, testing, and maintaining scalable data engineering components and platform services that power the CMM Program. This role delivers high-quality, secure, and performant data pipelines, transformations, ETL/ELT delivery, data management solutions, and system integrations aligned with federal standards and CMM objectives for modernization, analytics, and operational excellence. The Lead Data Engineer partners closely with the Data Architecture, Data Governance, and Migration teams to ensure engineering work is consistent, auditable, and aligned with CMM's cloud-based CI/CD standards.

The Lead Data Engineer will execute the following responsibilities:

Data Platform & Architecture

  • Develop and implement a scalable, secure, cloud-based data platform supporting operational data, reporting, and analytics delivering cloud-based architecture (data lake, lakehouse, or data warehouse).

  • Ensure alignment with federal security requirements, judiciary architecture standards, data governance policies, and application modernization initiatives.

  • Engineer multi-tenant, cloud-based environments supporting hybrid/on‑premises systems, enabling SQL, NoSQL, IaaS, PaaS, distributed SQL, multi-modal, and event-driven/streaming databases.

  • Design and implement auditable data integration patterns across Judiciary systems and external platforms, including the legacy CM/ECF system during the coexistence period, with pipelines integrated into Government-provided CI/CD processes.

  • Implement and maintain data quality controls, validation rules, and governance-aligned data structures, coordinating with the Data Quality/Validation Engineer to sustain required accuracy and field-completeness thresholds on an ongoing basis.

  • Drive continuous database and query performance monitoring and optimization, including automated performance tuning, query optimization, and indexing strategies.

  • Coordinate with the Cloud Data Architect/Data Modeler to ensure engineering implementation stays aligned with the Data Architecture Blueprint and evolving data models.

  • Document data platform architecture, integrations, data quality metrics, and service statistics, updating this documentation each Program Increment (PI).

  • Partner with DevSecOps/CI-CD engineering to ensure data pipelines are built, tested, and deployed through Government-provided CI/CD tooling.

  • Escalate and help resolve technical risks, defects, and dependencies affecting data engineering delivery across the CMM program.

  • Support development of the Data and Technology Enabler Roadmap across data engineering, reporting/analytics, and AI/ML use cases.

Data Engineering & Integration

  • Design and develop data ingestion, ETL/ELT pipelines for integrating data from multiple enterprise sources, and transformation logic for near-real-time and batch workloads.

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing maintenance of data management solutions, including operational databases, document storage services, data models, schemas, and data access APIs.

  • Provide technical direction and day-to-day oversight to the Data Engineers (ETL/ELT Pipelines) team, reviewing designs and ensuring consistent engineering standards across pipelines.

  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for database provisioning, configuration, and management to ensure consistency, repeatability, and auditability.

  • Implement robust, reusable data services supporting analytics, reporting, and downstream data marts and / or gold layers.

  • Collaborate with architects to implement logical and physical data models in cloud-based platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, or AWS Redshift)

  • Develop and maintain high-quality, testable code using secure coding standards and best practices.

  • Support the operationalization CMM Data Classification Standards, including workshops, security controls, metadata requirements, and integration into system design, procurement, and training.

  • Configure metadata structures, workflows, automation, and security settings; develop ingestion processes and attribute definitions for catalog entries.

  • Create training, job aids, and communications to support user adoption.

  • Integrate data pipelines with cloud services, messaging, and storage components.

  • Implement data quality checks, validations, and error-handling mechanisms.

  • Optimize pipeline performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  • Support CI/CD-enabled deployments, including automated testing and promotion across environments.

  • Support incident resolution and root cause analysis for data pipeline failures.

  • Produce and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and workflows.

  • Ensure deliverables meet federal security, governance, and audit requirements.

  • Operates within an Agile federal delivery environment across multiple scrum teams.

  • Collaborates closely with architects, DBAs, business analysts, and QA personnel.

  • Accountable for code quality, performance, and delivery timelines.

  • Expected to maintain audit-ready documentation and technical artifacts.

Data Migration & Archiving

  • Partners closely with the Data Architecture, Data Governance, and Migration teams to execute the data migration, archival, and disaster recovery (DR) strategy.

  • Deliver migration documentation for scripts, transformations, and validation results.

  • Support the Failover Testing and DR drills engineering activities.

  • Implement operational databases supporting data migration, archival, DR, document storage, indexing services, schemas, and secure data APIs using IaC for provisioning and configuration.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • MA/MS degree with 7+ years or BS/BA degree with 9+ years of general experience in information systems and 7+ years of specialized experience.

  • Experience may be considered in lieu of degree as follows: HS (16+ years), AA/AS (14+ years), BA/BS (12+ years), Doctorate Degree/Ph.D. (9+ years).

  • Experience in data engineering and design data architecture.

  • Experience and understanding of best practices regarding system security measures.

  • Experience in conducting research for advanced technologies to determine how IT can support business needs by leveraging software, hardware, or infrastructure.

  • Experience with AWS data and compute services.

  • Experience with data orchestration tools.

  • Proven track record in software and data engineering roles.

  • Hands-on experience building enterprise-scale data pipelines.

  • Strong proficiency with SQL, Python and data transformation techniques.

description:
Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. Job Description

Are you an experienced solution architect with a track record of designing complex, scalable services?

Do you have the ability to influence senior stakeholders and shape innovative, commercially viable solutions?

Then consider the role of Associate Director of Digital Solution Design at Reed in Partnership!

Internal applications for this role close on 30/07/2026

What is the role about?

The Associate Director of Digital Solution Design, through the leadership and development of the Digital Solution Design function, will define and embed a consistent approach to designing scalable, customer-centred solutions across Reed in Partnership’s services.

The role will lead the design of end-to-end digital solutions that respond to commissioner requirements, operational needs, and market opportunities. This will include translating business requirements into viable solution architectures across digital, operational, and service design components.

Digital Solution design will centre on balancing innovation, feasibility, cost-effectiveness, and delivery readiness. The role will ensure that all designed solutions are aligned to organisational strategy, compliant with contractual and regulatory requirements, and capable of delivering measurable outcomes.

A key element of the role will be working closely with Business Development to shape winning bids and propositions, alongside Operational, Digital, and Product teams to ensure solutions are deliverable, scalable, and continuously improved post-implementation.

Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Lead and develop the Digital Solution Design function, establishing standards, methodologies, and governance for digital solution design across the organisation.

  • Own and evolve the organisation’s technology strategy, including target architecture, principles, and direction for platforms, integration, and data.

  • Own the end-to-end digital solution design process for new bids, contract mobilisations, and service improvements.

  • Lead digital solution design across business and technology teams, including coordination with third-party suppliers and solution partners.

  • Design commercially viable, operationally effective, and technically scalable solutions that can be reused across contracts and service lines.

  • Work in partnership with Business Development teams to shape compelling, innovative, and commercially robust bid solutions.

  • Lead end-to-end bid digital solution design activity, including early qualification, feasibility assessment, and contribution to winning propositions.

  • Partner with Digital, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to ensure alignment between digital solution design, delivery capability, and product strategy.

  • Lead key digital design decisions, including buy vs build, platform selection, and integration approach, to support long-term scalability and sustainability.

  • Provide authoritative design leadership across bids and service transformation activity, acting as the escalation point for complex digital solution design decisions.

  • Build and maintain strong senior stakeholder relationships, influencing across business, technology, and external partners.

What’s in it for you?

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays

  • Reed Pension Scheme

  • Award Winning Management & Leadership training

  • Professional & Personal Development Funds

  • Bi-annual pay reviews

  • Plus much more that can be found on our website

  • With the chance to dramatically make a difference to the local community, this role offers immense job satisfaction.

At Reed in Partnership, we live and breathe our values in every decision and action taken, resulting in a collaborative and enjoyable culture within our offices. Our company values – we are fair open and honest; we take ownership, and we work together.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

Essential attainments:

  • Demonstrable digital solution leadership skills with experience building and leading high-performing teams.

  • Proven track record of designing and implementing complex digital service or operational solutions within a multi-stakeholder environment.

  • Strong experience in digital solution architecture design, service design, or business architecture within public services or similar sectors.

  • Experience of working across digital, operational, and commercial domains to create integrated digital solutions.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to translate complexity into clear, deliverable designs

  • A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.

  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification). OR achievement of a Level 2 in Literacy Assessment at interview stage OR International Equivalents.

Essential criteria:

  • Sound understanding of financial, contractual, and risk management principles.

  • Evidence of applying structured design or project methodologies (e.g. TOGAF, MODAF service design, Agile, or other architecture frameworks).

  • Experience of supporting or contributing to bid development and mobilisation activity.

  • Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, including at senior level.

  • Evidence of contributing to strategic direction and organisational development

We aim to ensure that no candidate or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, age, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity. We offer a guaranteed interview scheme for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria.

description:
The Opportunity

You’re a closer. You don’t need motivation or a script read to you — you need qualified homeowners in front of you and no ceiling on what you can earn. We provide both.

Most “six-figure sales” ads can’t back up the number. We can — and we’ll prove it before you ever take the job. Ask us in your interview to see the income and performance report for our entire sales team, including W-2s. Real numbers, real people, no smoke.

One of our top performers in Alaska broke a company record in April 2026 by earning over $100,000 in a single month — then did it again in May. He’s cleared $500,000+ three years running. He isn’t lucky; he’s a consummate professional with sharp, trained skills and relentless energy. We built the system that lets people like him win at that level — and we’ll show you the proof.



Why the income is real: you start with a full calendar — then build on it

This is a commission-only role — and if you’re a true closer, that’s exactly why the ceiling is this high. Here’s the difference from a typical commission grind: you’re not starting from zero. We invest heavily and continuously in filling your calendar with qualified appointments — our own dedicated call center, home shows and events, door-to-door teams, direct mail, digital, and television. The majority of your opportunities are generated for you.

Our top closers don’t stop there. The best people on this team also build their own business — referrals, repeat clients, their own network — and we double your commission on every sale you generate yourself. That’s the opportunity in front of you: ride the volume we provide, then stack your own upside on top. It’s a big part of how our highest earners get to where they are.



The brand opens the door before you knock

Renewal by Andersen is the exclusive replacement-window division of Andersen Corporation — the most recognized and trusted window brand in North America for over 120 years. You’re not convincing people you’re legitimate. You’re representing the name they already wanted in their home, backed by a premium product, full-service installation, and a warranty that closes objections for you.



What You'll Do

  • Meet with homeowners in scheduled in-home consultations
  • Understand customer needs and design customized replacement window and patio door solutions
  • Present Renewal by Andersen products, pricing, financing, and warranty options
  • Guide homeowners through a consultative purchasing process
  • Maintain customer information and follow-up activities within Salesforce
  • Generate referrals and self-generated business opportunities
  • Partner with installation and operations teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience



What Makes Someone Successful Here

  • A proven history of succeeding in commission-driven sales
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • Confidence presenting and closing in a customer's home
  • Self-discipline and personal accountability
  • Coachability and commitment to continuous improvement
  • The ability to work evenings and weekends
  • A valid driver's license and reliable transportation



What you get

  • Pre-set and pre-qualified appointments and generous bonus allocations for self-generated leads
  • No income ceiling: first-year consultants commonly reach $150K+; top performers earn $250K–$600K
  • Double commission on every sale you generate yourself
  • Monthly volume bonuses and self-generated bonuses
  • 3-week paid intensive training, plus ongoing coaching and performance from our highly skilled leadership team
  • Salesforce CRM, sales samples and displays
  • A clear path to grow into mentor and sales-manager roles



Who this is for — and who it isn’t

This role is designed for ambitious sales professionals who want to be rewarded directly for their performance. We meet homeowners when they’re available, so evenings and weekends are part of the rhythm, and there’s real road time between appointments — our best people use that windshield time to sharpen their process and get their head right before they walk in. If you want a salary, a cap, and a 9-to-5, this isn’t it. If you want to be paid for exactly what you produce, and you back yourself to produce, we should talk.

Apply now — and ask to see the numbers.

title: Vice President, Growth
description:
Who We Are:

At Guardian Restoration Partners, we are on a mission to build the most impactful restoration business in the industry. Our network of "Guardians" helps property owners in crisis rebuild their lives after devastating events like water, fire, and mold damage. As part of our team, you’ll be contributing to a company that values results, integrity, and putting customers first.

Guardian is a high-growth, private equity–backed company building a national platform in the restoration and field services industry. Through a focused acquisition strategy and strong organic growth, we are creating a best-in-class organization that combines local market expertise with the scale, systems, and discipline of a national platform. We are a passionate group of professionals committed to preserving the legacy of small and medium-sized businesses while accelerating their growth. We bring deep expertise and a hands-on approach to support our partners, expand the Guardian network, and make a lasting, positive impact across every organization

What We Need:

Guardian Restoration Partners is building one of North America’s leading residential restoration platforms. As we continue to scale, our next competitive advantage will come from creating a consistent, measurable, and scalable approach to generating profitable organic growth across our partner companies.

We are seeking a Vice President, Growth to build and lead Guardian’s enterprise Business Development Operating Model. Reporting directly to the CEO, this executive will define and execute Guardian’s enterprise growth strategy in partnership with the CEO and executive leadership team, lead the Business Development organization, and establish the people, processes, technology, analytics, and operating rhythm needed to drive sustainable, profitable growth. This is a hands-on builder role for a leader who can move fluidly between enterprise strategy and field execution. The right candidate will bring the commercial vision to define what great looks like, the operating discipline to turn that vision into a repeatable system, and the influence to drive adoption across a decentralized organization.

Over the first 12 months, this leader will be expected to materially improve qualified lead generation, Business Development productivity, conversion, channel performance, and commercial visibility while embedding a consistent growth operating model across Guardian’s partner companies.

Key Responsibilities:

Build Guardian’s Sales Operating System

  • Design and implement a scalable commercial operating model across Guardian’s partner companies.
  • Own the design and continuous improvement of Business Development quotas, territory structures, compensation plans, sales methodology, lead-management standards, CRM strategy, and commercial technology.
  • Establish consistent KPIs, reporting, forecasting, and operating cadences across the enterprise.
  • Develop an enterprise sales playbook that incorporates proven practices from across the platform while allowing for appropriate local market flexibility.
  • Create clear performance visibility at the enterprise, regional, market, partner, and individual levels.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve the operating system as Guardian grows.

Lead Enterprise Sales Strategy

  • Develop and execute Guardian’s enterprise sales optimization strategy in partnership with the CEO and executive leadership team.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to increase qualified lead generation, improve conversion, expand market share, and strengthen customer acquisition economics.
  • Define and optimize Guardian’s enterprise approach across core sales channels, including plumbing partnerships, property management, enterprise relationships, and digital marketing.
  • Allocate resources across channels based on performance, scalability, market opportunity, and return on investment.
  • Balance immediate performance improvement with the development of durable, long-term commercial capabilities.
  • Build digital marketing into a more predictable and meaningful source of qualified leads while continuing to strengthen Guardian’s relationship-driven referral channels.

Lead and Develop the Business Development Organization

  • Provide enterprise leadership to Regional Sales Leaders, Business Development Managers, and the broader Business Development organization.
  • Define the organizational structure, leadership capabilities, role expectations, and talent standards required to support Guardian’s sales strategy.
  • Recruit, coach, develop, and retain high-performing commercial leaders while addressing capability and performance gaps directly.
  • Establish clear quotas, performance expectations, accountability mechanisms, succession plans, and leadership-development priorities.
  • Partner with Market Area Presidents and General Managers on local staffing, market-level sales execution, and shared performance management of Regional Sales Leaders and Business Development leadership.
  • Build a strong succession pipeline and leadership bench capable of scaling with Guardian’s continued acquisition and organic growth.

Improve Commercial Performance

  • Increase qualified lead volume, Business Development productivity, conversion, and market-level commercial performance.
  • Establish reliable visibility into qualified leads, close rates, cost per lead, cost per sold job, channel performance, pipeline health, and individual productivity.
  • Use performance data to identify root causes, prioritize interventions, and hold leaders accountable for improvement.
  • Partner with Finance to evaluate sales investments, improve acquisition economics, and ensure customer acquisition costs grow more slowly than the value of the jobs generated.
  • Identify, test, and scale practices that consistently produce stronger commercial results.

Lead Change Across a Decentralized Organization

  • Build credibility and strong working relationships with Market Area Presidents, General Managers, founders, and local commercial teams.
  • Introduce and implement greater consistency without diminishing local accountability, customer relationships, or entrepreneurial ownership.
  • Translate enterprise strategy into practical tools, behaviors, and operating routines that field leaders can execute.
  • Lead pilots, incorporate field feedback, and scale successful approaches across the platform.
  • Navigate resistance, challenge underperforming practices, and drive sustained adoption through influence, evidence, and measurable results.

Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience across sales, business development, commercial operations, revenue operations, or enterprise sales, including at least five years leading within a multi-location, decentralized field services, home services, or other blue-collar operating environment.
  • Demonstrated success building, implementing, or materially scaling a commercial operating system across a multi-location, multi-brand, or decentralized organization.
  • Experience leading field-based sales or Business Development teams through regional, divisional, or market-level leaders.
  • A track record of measurably improving lead generation, conversion, productivity, market share, and customer acquisition economics.
  • Strong working knowledge of CRM platforms, sales analytics, compensation design, territory planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and commercial technology.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide change across entrepreneurial, founder-led, acquired, or independently operated businesses.
  • Strong financial acumen, including experience evaluating commercial investments, channel performance, return on investment, and operating leverage.
  • Demonstrated ability to move between executive strategy, operating detail, field coaching, talent decisions, and performance accountability.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.

Experience in restoration, home services, field services, or another decentralized service business is strongly preferred.

Skills & Leadership Attributes That Will Make You Successful In This Role:

  • Builder mindset: You know how to create scalable capabilities where limited infrastructure or standardization exists today.
  • Commercial judgment: You distinguish between sales activity and profitable growth, using performance data and return on investment to make disciplined resource-allocation decisions.
  • Operational discipline: You translate strategy into clear processes, metrics, ownership, routines, and accountability.
  • Field orientation: You remain close to local leaders, customers, referral partners, and frontline execution rather than leading exclusively through corporate dashboards.
  • Enterprise influence: You can challenge established practices, navigate competing priorities, and gain adoption without relying solely on hierarchy.
  • Talent leadership: You build strong leaders, address performance gaps directly, and create organizational depth.
  • Change leadership: You know how to introduce consistency across entrepreneurial businesses without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Learning agility: You test, learn, adapt, and scale based on evidence rather than applying a fixed playbook to every market.

Why This Role Matters

Guardian believes enduring competitive advantage is created through strong operating systems. As the company scales, we are intentionally building enterprise capabilities that help our partner companies grow faster, perform more consistently, and learn from one another without sacrificing local accountability or entrepreneurship.

The Vice President of Sales will build one of Guardian’s most important enterprise capabilities. This leader will have the mandate to shape our commercial strategy, strengthen the Business Development organization, improve how sales are measured and managed, and scale the practices that help each partner company outperform its local market.

Working directly with the CEO and executive leadership team, this executive will have a meaningful opportunity to influence Guardian’s growth trajectory, operating performance, and long-term enterprise value.

The VP, Operations partners closely with General Managers, field leaders, and enterprise peers across Transformation, Revenue Cycle, Operations, People, FP&A, and Accounting to strengthen gross profit performance, improve execution, and drive consistent operational standards across the portfolio.

Our Core Values:

  • Customer-First Mindset: Our customers are at the heart of our business. We strive to exceed their expectations and build lasting relationships.
  • Do the Right Thing: Integrity is at the core of everything we do. We are committed to being ethical and trustworthy in every situation.
  • Results Matter: We deliver on our promises and drive outcomes that make a measurable difference.

Total Rewards:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Paid time off

We are focused on becoming an employer of choice and are continuously evaluating how to expand our Total Rewards offerings to best support our employees.

Why Join Us?

At Guardian Restoration Partners, we are committed to empowering our employees with the resources and opportunities they need to excel. When you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive Compensation: A comprehensive package that includes health, vision, dental, and retirement plans to support your financial and personal well-being.
  • Collaborative Culture: Be part of a mission-driven team that values innovation, teamwork, and meaningful impact.
  • Professional Growth: Thrive in an entrepreneurial environment where you’ll take on diverse challenges, gain hands-on experience, and have opportunities to shape your role as the company grows.

You’ll contribute to a dynamic team where your expertise will make a tangible difference in our success. We offer a supportive environment that fosters collaboration, innovation, and a strong commitment to your personal and professional development.

Compensation:

Guardian is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $225,000, plus eligibility for variable compensation and participation in Guardian’s long-term incentive plan. Actual compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.

Location:

This is a remote executive role with significant travel required to Guardian’s partner companies and corporate headquarters in Denver, Colorado. The successful candidate must be comfortable maintaining a strong field presence and traveling regularly to build relationships, understand local market dynamics, and drive adoption across the platform.

Application Deadline:

The anticipated application deadline is August 7th though that date may change depending on the volume of qualified resumes we receive by that time.

Ready to Apply?

If you are motivated by meaningful work and want to be part of a growing organization that values results, integrity, and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join a team that supports your professional growth and makes a real impact.

The salary range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. For this position, the base salary pay range is listed below.

At Guardian Restoration Partners, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Hydrostatic Test Technician
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Factory Services team is part of the Shared Services, Systems & Infrastructure (3SI) organization within the Maritime Division. This team owns the shared technical services that support all production business lines on site, including machining, hydrostatic testing, tooling, and 3D printing. The hydrostatic test chamber is a critical shared resource used to validate the integrity of pressurized vessels and components before they are integrated into undersea systems. As the site scales to support multiple product lines, demand on this capability will grow and this role will be essential to keeping production on schedule.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Hydrostatic Test Technician to operate and maintain our hydrostatic test chamber, performing pressure testing on sealed vessels, housings, and other pressurized components used in autonomous underwater vehicles. Our undersea platforms are flooded vehicles, meaning the electronics and other water-sensitive subsystems are housed inside individually sealed, pressurized enclosures. This role is responsible for verifying the structural integrity and watertight seal of those enclosures before they are integrated into production vehicles. You will set up and execute test procedures, monitor pressure data, document results, and work closely with production and engineering teams to ensure components meet specifications. This is a hands-on role that requires mechanical aptitude, comfort working with high-pressure systems, strong attention to detail, and the discipline to follow test procedures precisely. If you are someone who takes pride in getting the details right and understands that your work directly impacts the reliability of fielded systems, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Hydrostatic Test Execution: Set up, operate, and monitor the hydrostatic test chamber to perform pressure testing on sealed vessels, housings, and pressurized components. Follow established test procedures to pressurize components to specified levels, hold for required durations, and monitor for pressure loss or leaks.
  • Test Preparation and Fixturing: Prepare components for testing by installing fittings, plugs, seals, and connections. Verify test setup is correct before pressurization. Maintain and organize test fixtures, tooling, and support equipment.
  • Inspection and Defect Identification: Visually inspect components before, during, and after testing for leaks, pinholes, seal failures, weld deficiencies, or other nonconforming conditions. Identify and clearly document any anomalies found during testing.
  • Data Recording and Documentation: Accurately record all test parameters, results, and observations. Complete test reports and quality records in accordance with standard operating procedures. Interpret pressure gauge readings and calibration data to ensure testing accuracy.
  • Equipment Maintenance and Calibration: Perform routine maintenance on the test chamber, pumps, gauges, fittings, and related equipment. Support calibration activities and flag equipment that is out of tolerance or in need of repair.
  • Safety Compliance: Adhere strictly to all safety protocols for high-pressure testing operations. Maintain a clean and organized work area. Report any safety concerns, near-misses, or equipment malfunctions immediately.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with production teams, quality, and engineering to schedule tests, communicate results, and support troubleshooting when components do not pass. Provide feedback to engineering on recurring test failures or design concerns.
  • Process Improvement: Contribute to the development and refinement of test procedures, fixturing, and workflows. Identify opportunities to improve test efficiency, throughput, or reliability as the site scales.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of experience in a hands-on testing, inspection, or manufacturing technician role
  • Familiarity with pressure testing (hydrostatic or pneumatic), leak detection, or similar quality verification processes
  • Ability to read and work from technical documentation, engineering drawings, and test procedures
  • Strong attention to detail with a disciplined approach to following procedures and recording data accurately
  • Mechanical aptitude and comfort working with high-pressure systems, pumps, fittings, and gauges
  • Effective communicator who can clearly document and convey test results to engineering and production teams
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in defense, aerospace, or maritime manufacturing
  • Experience with pressure vessel testing, proof testing, or burst testing of sealed enclosures or housings
  • Familiarity with subsea, AUV, UUV, or underwater robotics systems
  • VT (Visual Testing) or PT (Penetrant Testing) certification, or willingness to obtain
  • Experience with ERP or MES systems for test record management and work order closeout
  • Confined space, crane, or rigging certification
  • High school diploma or technical certificate in a relevant trade; associate degree in a technical field is a plus
US Hourly Range
$28—$37 USD

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates.
