About the Role:

Primarily based in Hawke's Bay, and reporting to the Construction Director, you will take a project from early design through to practical completion; working on behalf of the client but in a very hands-on project management role. Your duties will also include:

  • Overseeing cost control management, including budget set up, ensuring your finger is on the pulse at all times

  • Alongside the project team, take an active role in managing procurement and contract management

You will have excellent commercial construction knowledge, be an action orientated individual that will add value and continuously strive for the best! In addition to this, you will have the following attributes:

  • A minimum of 7+ years’ experience in a Project Manager role, in the commercial construction environment within New Zealand, preferably in design and build

Join Our Legacy
If you’re looking for a role where your efforts directly contribute to the success of a purpose-driven organisation, this is your chance. Be part of a company that doesn’t just build commercial projects – we build strong relationships and stronger communities.

title: Senior Reliability & Failure Analysis Engineer
description:
Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

ORT / Qualification tests

  • Continues ensure that the reliability of products is well maintained as when it is originally qualified. Select representative product PNs from family and provide ORT plan
  • Lead ORT samples collection and tests. Work with product engineers. Ensure ORT samples can be collected for each planed PN on time

  • Take the lead for related data collection and analysis and then produce formal qualification reports for customers

NPI projects

Participate in customer specification and requirements review and then determine relevant reliability test plans based on project needs and be responsible for the execution of tests and monitor progress of reliability and qualification program

  • Take the lead for related data collection and analysis and then produce formal qualification reports for customers
  • Follow up product reliability issues from beginning to closing, make sure that product reliability issues can be solved on time

FIT

  • Reliability calculation for field FIT
  • Update FIT reports for customers periodically

Failure analysis

  • Responsible for investigating product and process failures, identifying root causes, and driving corrective actions to improve quality, reliability, and yield.
  • Conduct failure analysis through cross-sectional evaluation and external laboratory testing techniques, including SEM, FTIR, and DSC, to identify failure mechanisms and determine root causes. Requires strong problem-solving skills and experience with root cause analysis methodologies and laboratory characterization tools.
  • Analyze failure trends and provide recommendations to improve product reliability, yield, and quality.
  • Interface with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues and communicate findings.
  • Maintain failure analysis databases and ensure proper documentation of investigations.

Engineering support

  • Other jobs allocated by quality manager/director
  • Work with cross function team to do continual improvement on reliability test fees

  • Do continual improvement for reliability lab management

Continual improvement

  • Work with cross function team to do continual improvement on reliability test fees
  • Work with cross function team to do continual improvement on product reliability
  • Do continual improvement for reliability lab management

Education & Experience:

  • Experience on start-up manufacturing set-up.

  • Mathematical skills. Statistical data analysis.   • Ability to handle multiple priorities involving external and internal priorities

title: Chef Instructor, Savory (Sur La Table)
description:
With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food.

Position Overview
As a Chef Instructor, Savory at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things savory cooking. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in culinary techniques, cooking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Savory plays a key role in inspiring a love for cooking while driving sales of cookware, cutlery, and kitchen tools through hands-on savory classes and engaging culinary instruction.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Experience & Brand Representation
· Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty.
· Deliver exceptional in-store culinary experiences focused on savory cooking classes that reflect Sur La Table’s passion for food, teaching, and high standards, while following provided recipes and game plans to ensure consistency and quality.
· Communicate technical cooking concepts and savory techniques in a clear, encouraging, and approachable manner.
· Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources.
Sales & Business Performance
· Drive sales by upholding kitchen standards, encouraging second class sign-ups through strong customer engagement, and promoting retail items used or featured in class.
· Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates.
· Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews.
Team Engagement & Store Support
· Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations.
· Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations.
· Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness.
Operations & Compliance
· Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations.
· Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment.
· Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses.
· May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions.
· Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly.
· Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy.
· Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Physical Requirements
· Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers.
· Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time.
· Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor.
· The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or nose.
· Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel and crouch to demonstrate, retrieve and/or replenish merchandise and/or cooking equipment.
· Ability to use hands to seize, hold, grasp, turn, or otherwise to chop, whisk, slice, stir, juice and/or demonstrate other techniques.
· Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs.
· Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise.
· Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work.
· Available to work between 12 and 16 hours per week, with a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. While this is the minimum availability, scheduled hours may differ based on business needs.
· Regular and predictable attendance with the flexibility to adjust class assignments based on demand.
· Ability to work in a variable kitchen environment included but not limited to open flames, hot surfaces, temperature variations, various food allergens both physical and airborne.
Qualifications & Experience
· Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employment.
· A degree in culinary arts is preferred; however, candidates with extensive culinary experience and demonstrated technical proficiency will be considered in lieu of formal education.
· 1-2 years of kitchen operations experience.
· Valid Food Manager Certification.
· Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
· Passion for community engagement and providing exceptional customer experiences.

title: NATO Systems Engineer
description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems has an opening for a NATO Systems Engineer to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals within our Systems Engineering organization. This role is located in Rancho Bernardo, CA.

In this role, you should expect to perform technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems. You'll be responsible for analyses performed at all levels of total system product: concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal. Additionally, you will ensure the logical and systematic conversion of customer or product requirements maintain accuracy, transforming them into total systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints. This will require functional analysis, timeline analysis, detailed trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications.

Essential Functions:

  • Evaluate anomalies, and assist with the disposition and correction of integration issues
  • Present technical recommendations to internal and external technical leadership
  • Perform requirements traceability of defects
  • Develop, de-bug and execute Regression Verification Tests
  • Perform hands-on Integration within Test environment
  • Support field operations including maintenance and mission support

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must have a Bachelors of Science degree in a STEM field and at least 2 years of relevant military / professional experience, OR a Master's Degree in a STEM field and at least some of relevant military / professional / academic experience
  • Must have an active US Government Secret or higher clearance (with a background investigation completed within the last 6 years or currently enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience conducting end to end system integration, verification and validation
  • Experience with RQ-4 air vehicle, ground segment, sensor payloads, COMMS and support equipment

Primary Level Salary Range: $0.00 - $0.00

In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

title: ESOP Retirement Plan Administrator - Assistant
description:
Assistant ESOP Administrator


DEPARTMENT: ESOP Services

SUPERVISOR: Client Services Manager

ESOP Partners, Inc. is a third-party administration and consulting firm dedicated to providing a liquid business transition solution for owners of closely held businesses through the establishment, maintenance, and sustainability of Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs). Our mission is to maximize the financial and cultural benefits of employee ownership by helping ESOP companies build strong, informed, and engaged employee ownership cultures.


We aspire to be nationally recognized as the leading ESOP firm in the country. We pursue this vision through our Core Values:


  • Seek to Understand – We identify the underlying reasons behind questions and actions and take ownership of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Manage Expectations – We proactively communicate clear, specific, and achievable objectives to create alignment and accountability.
  • Collaborate – We work together through constructive discussion and teamwork to achieve win-win outcomes.
  • Get Things Done – We prioritize, organize, and execute efficiently to deliver accurate and timely results.
  • Practice Professional Skepticism – We apply a questioning mindset to objectively analyze information for quality and accuracy.
  • Exhibit Mental Strength – We manage challenges with professionalism, resilience, and a solutions-oriented attitude.


POSITION SUMMARY

The Assistant ESOP Administrator supports client service and internal teams by performing key plan administration functions, including census reconciliation, eligibility determination, basic trust accounting, required reporting (1099-R and 945), recordkeeping distributions, and preparation of client mailings.


This role is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and compliant work that meets established quality standards in a deadline-driven environment. Success requires strong attention to detail, accountability, effective prioritization, and a commitment to ongoing ESOP education and professional development to enhance expertise and client service.


POSITION DETAILS

Location: In-office position based in Appleton, Wisconsin

Position Type: Full-time | Exempt

Work Schedule: This role has a seasonal workload and requires the ability to work more than 45 hours per week during the peak period of January through May annually.

Experience Level: Entry Level


KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Essential duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Responsible for individual production results as well as contribution to busy season goals for the ESOP administration team.
  • Census data reconciliation.
  • Determines which employees have met plan eligibility provisions determined by the plan document.
  • Reports basic trust activities occurring within ESOP or accrued for the reporting period.
  • Responsible for preparing control list and other documents relating to the mailing of statements.
  • Responsible for documenting distributions, tracking forms received, and entering them into our proprietary software.
  • Responsible for following up on payment files.
  • Responsible for preparing the 1099Rs and 945 for ESOP clients.
  • May attend ESOP industry conferences, events, seminars, etc. to increase ESOP knowledge and skills.
  • Consistently perform all duties in alignment with ESOP Partners’ Core Values


QUALIFICATIONS

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Demonstrates a strong desire to learn and develop ESOP knowledge by taking ownership of professional growth, applying feedback, and continuously improving.
  • Communicates proactively, clearly, and consistently with team members, administrators, and leadership to keep stakeholders informed of project status, deadlines, next steps, and potential obstacles.
  • Builds effective working relationships by adapting communication style to different audiences, remaining open to diverse perspectives, and collaborating respectfully with others.
  • Communicates professionally and respectfully in both verbal and written interactions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Effectively utilizes Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and established processes to complete work accurately and consistently.
  • Manages multiple priorities by organizing work effectively, meeting deadlines, and adjusting priorities as business needs change.
  • Demonstrates strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with an emphasis on Microsoft Excel.
  • Maintains a high level of organization and attention to detail to produce accurate, high-quality work.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Math, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Will consider an applicant with an Associate degree along with demonstration of strong analytical skills and excellent Excel skills and/or relevant prior experience.
  • Experience with benefits administration or retirement plans is preferred.


PHYSICAL AND COGNITIVE REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to sit for extended periods and work at a computer
  • Ability to analyze complex information and exercise sound judgment
  • Ability to maintain focus and accuracy in a deadline-driven environment


PERFORMANCEW EXPECTATIONS

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on:

  • Accuracy, quality and timeliness of work product
  • Accountability and ownership of production hours
  • Adherence to ESOP Partners’ Core Values
  • Effectiveness of professional communication

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Oracle DRM based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to own critical financial master data management and support global FP&A forecasting environments.
You will design and maintain Oracle DRM/EDMCS structures that enable accurate, controlled, and scalable financial planning.
The position combines hands-on technical development with data governance, automation, and systems integration.
You will build automated data pipelines connecting financial master data with platforms such as Oracle Hyperion, AWS Redshift, and S3.
Working closely with global finance stakeholders, you will translate complex organizational changes into robust metadata solutions.
You will also play a key role in improving operational efficiency, strengthening financial controls, and resolving critical data issues during close cycles.
This is a strong opportunity for an experienced Oracle DRM professional who enjoys solving complex problems at the intersection of finance, data, and technology.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust hierarchies, node types, validations, and workflows within Oracle DRM and EDMCS to support global FP&A forecasting models.
  • Build and optimise automated ETL pipelines connecting Oracle DRM data with downstream platforms, including Oracle Hyperion, AWS Redshift, and S3-based data lakes.
  • Develop complex validation scripts and approval workflows that enforce financial data governance and strong internal controls, including SOX compliance requirements.
  • Automate manual finance data-management processes through scripting and programmatic solutions using Python, Groovy, PL/SQL, or Windows Batch scripting.
  • Partner with global finance and FP&A teams to understand organisational changes, restructurings, product launches, and other business requirements and translate them into scalable metadata configurations.
  • Maintain data integrity across financial master data structures, identifying and resolving mismatches, inconsistencies, and process issues.
  • Troubleshoot system performance and provide technical support during critical monthly and quarterly financial close cycles.
  • Contribute to the migration and modernisation of legacy Oracle DRM environments where required.
  • Support integrations with financial planning and consolidation platforms and help ensure reliable data flows across the wider finance technology ecosystem.
  • Create technical documentation and communicate complex data and system concepts clearly to non-technical business stakeholders.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional experience in financial master data management or a closely related field.
    • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle DRM (Data Relationship Management).
    • Solid proficiency in Python and strong SQL/PL-SQL skills, with additional scripting experience in Groovy or Windows Batch considered valuable.
    • Strong understanding of FP&A concepts and financial master data, including Chart of Accounts, General Ledgers, organisational hierarchies, and multi-currency consolidation structures.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or another relevant quantitative or technical discipline.
    • Experience designing data structures, validation rules, approval workflows, and governance processes within enterprise financial systems.
    • Experience integrating financial master data with downstream applications and data platforms.
    • Previous experience migrating legacy on-premise Oracle DRM solutions is a strong advantage.
    • Familiarity with AWS services such as Amazon Redshift, S3, Glue, and Lambda is desirable.
    • Experience supporting corporate finance users working with platforms such as Hyperion Essbase, Planning, or IBM TM1 is a plus.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to troubleshooting complex data and system issues.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and produce clear documentation for business stakeholders.
    • Comfortable working collaboratively with global finance, technology, and business teams while also taking ownership of technical deliverables.

title: Zero Trust Information Systems Security Engineer
description:
Zero Trust Information Systems Security Engineer

The Opportunity:

Are you looking for an opportunity to share your experience in system security engineering to help our country and assist our clients with critical missions? As a systems security and network security engineer, you can identify the information system security engineering needed to assess vulnerabilities and recommend the best solution and security strategy. We need your experience to lead the development and implementation of security solutions that will protect our military.

On our team, you’ll troubleshoot and analyze complex challenges for customers using your knowledge of network and security devices, applications, and identifying tools. You’ll use your curiosity for technology and market trends to further research and develop security solutions. Using your knowledge and experience in cybersecurity, you’ll assess security threats and implement infrastructure controls.

In this role, you’ll closely impact the DoD by protecting their infrastructure. With mentoring, challenging hands-on problem-solving, and opportunities to learn new tools and skills, we focus on growing as a team to make the best solutions for our customers.

Work with us as we secure and protect critical AI or ML networks for the better.

What You’ll Work On:

Design, develop, and implement Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions.

This position focuses on Delinea PAM solution to safeguard critical information systems and data against advanced cyber threats, with a primary emphasis on zero trust architecture. The engineer will leverage data analytics, visualization, and observability techniques to enhance threat detection, incident response, and security posture. This requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams, development of security policies, and continuous evaluation of security controls to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of sensitive information.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in an ISSE, ISSO, or IT role

  • 3+ years of experience with ICAM principles and technologies such as multi-factor authentication, privileged access management, security operations, and security architecture leveraging ICAM solutions such as SailPoint, Radiant Logic, Ping Federate, and Delinea

  • 3+ years of experience with administration and integration of directory services, including LDAP compliant directories such as Active Directory

  • 3+ years of experience with SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) integrations and troubleshooting protocol exchanges and resolving complex identity and federation issues

  • 3+ years of experience with DoD architecture, strategic planning, concept of operations, performance attributes, system architecture and design, evolving methodologies, and statutory and regulatory requirements

  • Knowledge of Zero Trust principles and frameworks such as NIST 800-207

  • Ability to resolve complex identity and federation issues

  • TS/SCI clearance

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • IASAE II Certification such as CASP+, CISSP, or CSSLP Certification

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with cybersecurity tools and technologies such as IDS, IPS, firewalls, and host-based security

  • Experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems such as Splunk, Elastic, Logstash, and Kibana

  • Experience with data broker technologies such as Cribl or Confluent, operating systems security events such as Windows or Linux, and networking protocols such as TCP, IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, or HTTPS

  • Experience with programming or scripting, including with PowerShell, Ansible, Python, and automation frameworks such as Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, or Chef

  • Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities to automate, enhance, and accelerate IT operations and security monitoring

  • Experience supporting enterprise PAM solution delivery project

  • Experience troubleshooting processes and standards for PAM

  • Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), or GIAC Vulnerability Assessment Professional (GVAP) Certification

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000.00 to $225,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. title: Staff Machine Learning Ops Engineer
description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Preply is scaling an AI-powered learning platform used by millions of learners and tutors worldwide. As ML and GenAI become increasingly central to our product, marketplace, and operational systems, we’re looking for a Staff ML Ops Engineer to define and evolve the platform that enables machine learning at company scale.

This is a senior technical leadership role for an engineer who can combine deep hands-on expertise with platform vision. You will help define the current and future direction of Preply’s ML platform, set technical standards, and design the systems that allow ML teams to move from research to production quickly, safely, and cost-efficiently.

You’ll partner closely with Applied Science, Data, Product, and Engineering leadership to build a scalable, secure, and observable ML platform that powers multiple business lines. Your impact will come not only from the systems you design, but from the standards you set, the engineers you mentor, and the technical decisions you help de-risk across the organization.

Why is this role important:

Preply’s next stage of growth depends on making AI a scalable company-wide capability, not a collection of isolated models and experiments. This role will define how ML systems are built, deployed, monitored, and improved across the company.

You’ll shape the platform that powers personalized learning, smarter experiences for tutors and learners, marketplace intelligence, content generation, automation, and future GenAI products. The goal is to make it dramatically easier for teams to turn ML ideas into reliable, secure, cost-efficient product experiences at a global scale.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Define the technical vision and roadmap for Preply’s ML platform, ensuring it can support growing ML and GenAI adoption across multiple teams, products, and business lines.

  • Lead the architecture of platform capabilities across the full ML lifecycle: experimentation, feature engineering, artifact management, training, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and governance.

  • Design cloud-native infrastructure for distributed training and inference, including GPU-based environments, autoscaling, workload isolation, rollout strategies, and cost optimization.

  • Set the technical direction for CI/CD for ML, embedding testing, validation, security, performance checks, and release confidence into deployment pipelines.

  • Establish observability standards for ML systems, including model metrics, service health, alerts, drift detection, data quality, lineage, and business-impact monitoring.

  • Lead the evolution of Preply’s GenAI and LLM platform capabilities, including building LLM Gateway services, vector retrieval infrastructure, prompt experimentation, evaluation frameworks, latency-optimized inference, and reliable model-serving patterns.

  • Partner with Applied Science and Data leads, Product leaders, and Engineering teams to align platform investments with experimentation velocity, cost efficiency, operational reliability, and user impact.

  • Design platform abstractions, internal libraries, templates, and self-service tooling that help ML Scientists and engineers move faster without compromising reliability or security.

  • Act as a technical multiplier across engineering by mentoring senior engineers, influencing architecture, raising standards, and guiding teams through complex platform decisions.

  • Identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the path from ML research to production, making the platform easier, safer, and more efficient for all ML-powered product development.

What you need to succeed:

  • 9+ years of engineering experience, with significant depth in large-scale ML, data, infrastructure, or platform systems.

  • Proven ability to architect and scale production-grade ML platforms that support many teams, workflows, and ML use cases.

  • Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture and end-to-end ML workflows, including experimentation, feature management, model versioning, training, deployment, monitoring, performance benchmarking, and lifecycle management.

  • Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, Kubernetes, distributed compute, CI/CD, observability, and infrastructure-as-code practices.

  • Experience building enabling tools and platform capabilities for Applied Scientists, Data Scientists, and engineering teams.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make pragmatic architecture decisions across reliability, scalability, security, cost, and developer experience.

  • Excellent communication and influence skills, with experience aligning cross-functional stakeholders and translating platform strategy into execution.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, raise engineering standards, and multiply the impact of teams around you.

  • Product-impact mindset: you care about building platform capabilities that accelerate experimentation, improve user experiences, and unlock measurable business value.

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks and GenAI infrastructure, such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector stores, retrieval systems, prompt evaluation, model serving, or LLM observability.

Why you’ll love it at Preply

  • An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;

  • A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;

  • A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;

  • Access to free mental health support platforms;

  • The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!)

#LI-AG1

Our Principles

  • Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

  • We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

  • Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

  • Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

  • Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

  • Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

  • Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

  • Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

  • One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Overview:

We are seeking a strategic, experienced Director of Global Corporate Communications to lead proactive storytelling for Visa. This role will shape and drive the narrative around Visa's growth, financial performance and business momentum, translating complex data and business results into compelling stories for media and other key stakeholders.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on practitioner, someone who can develop a communications strategy tied to business priorities and financial results, and who is equally comfortable drafting a press release, briefing a reporter, or advising senior executives on messaging.

This is a unique opportunity to help define how Visa tells its growth story to the world, sitting at the intersection of financial communications, data storytelling and proactive media engagement within a global, matrixed organization.

Essential Functions:

The ideal candidate has the ability to:

Proactive Storytelling & Growth Narrative:

  • Support the development of the strategy and execution of Visa's proactive storytelling agenda, articulating Visa's growth story across markets, products and business lines.
  • Support Visa's financial communications, including quarterly earnings, investor-adjacent messaging, in close partnership with Investor Relations, Finance and Legal, and other business milestones.
  • Partner with Visa’s business and economic insights team to identify and shape data-driven storytelling opportunities that showcase Visa's impact and momentum.

Content Development & Media Engagement:

  • Draft, edit and refine high-quality communications materials, including press releases, executive talking points, media pitches and Q&A documents.
  • Lead direct media engagement, including pitching, briefing and building relationships with key financial, business and trade press.
  • Serve as a hands on contributor who can step in to write, pitch or execute when timing or capacity requires direct involvement.

Executive & Stakeholder Partnership:

  • Partner closely with senior communications leaders, Investor Relations, Finance, Legal and business unit leaders to align messaging across audiences.
  • Act as a connective tissue across global and regional communications teams to ensure consistency in the growth narrative.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement:

  • Partner with communications leaders to track the impact and effectiveness of financial communications and storytelling initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools and approaches for data storytelling and proactive media engagement.

Since 1938, BHN has helped individuals, families, and communities thrive through compassionate, high-quality care and support. With deep roots in Western Massachusetts and a growing presence in communities throughout the state, we are currently seeking a Clinical Supervisor to join our Clinical Stabilization Services (CSS) team and help advance our mission of empowering people to live healthier, more fulfilling lives.

What We Offer:

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Make a meaningful impact in the lives of individuals, families, and communities throughout Western Massachusetts.
  • Professional Growth – Access ongoing training, mentorship, career development, and advancement opportunities across one of the region's largest behavioral health organizations.

  • Support high-quality admissions, assessments, individualized treatment planning, clinical programming, discharge planning, and transitions to continuing care.
  • Promote effective multidisciplinary collaboration among clinical, medical, nursing, recovery-support, and case-management staff to address each individual's treatment needs.

title: Senior Analyst - Logistics AU
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Analyst - Logistics AU based in India.

This role sits within a dynamic Logistics ANZ team supporting safe, reliable, and cost-effective fuel distribution across Australia.
You will use data, financial modelling, and logistics expertise to improve network performance, costs, and operational efficiency.
The position combines analytical ownership with close collaboration across carriers, sales teams, finance, and technology stakeholders.
You will manage freight rates, forecasting, reporting, payment validation, and commercial analysis while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
The role offers exposure to complex logistics networks spanning ground fuels and aviation fuels, with opportunities to influence important commercial decisions.
You will primarily support Australia while also contributing to New Zealand activities and providing cross-market coverage when required.
This is an excellent opportunity for an analytical and commercially minded professional who enjoys turning complex data into practical business solutions.

Accountabilities:

  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the Australian logistics network, including carriers, operating regions, terminals, supply points, fleet types, delivery models, and business segments.
  • Maintain accurate carrier and supply-point mappings, including truck types, delivery models, and regional coverage.
  • Assess logistics models, supply impacts, and network constraints to support customer onboarding and operational planning.
  • Manage freight rate requests for new customers through Salesforce, coordinating with third-party carriers to obtain, validate, and consolidate accurate rates.
  • Act as a key point of contact for carriers regarding freight rates, clarifications, confirmations, tender outcomes, and related commercial discussions.
  • Maintain carrier rate outcomes and tender records, including won and lost opportunities, and provide structured monthly feedback on tender decisions.
  • Calculate and distribute monthly fuel issue rates in accordance with approved escalation methodologies.
  • Prepare and submit AdBlue sales and volume reports in line with applicable Australian regulatory requirements.
  • Review existing carrier freight rates to ensure cost recoveries remain aligned with contractual and commercial agreements.
  • Conduct annual carrier freight rate reviews using Distribution Cost Index models, fuel issue data, and carrier inputs.
  • Review transfer and pairing reports to validate freight costs and expected payments, investigate discrepancies, and support resolution of carrier payment queries.
  • Clear suspense items by providing missing or corrected rate information in collaboration with logistics and finance teams.
  • Build and maintain logistics financial forecasts, including annual logistics planning, using sales forecasts, DCI models, and issue assumptions.
  • Provide logistics cost and volume data to support pricing strategies, tenders, customer evaluations, and commercial decisions.
  • Assess logistics costs, risks, and operational feasibility for tenders and new customer opportunities, including inputs for commercial and credit reviews.
  • Conduct ad hoc logistics and operational analysis to identify cost-optimisation opportunities and support business decision-making.
  • Review loading and unloading performance using carrier and terminal data and identify trends or opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Use SAP, Salesforce, Power BI, and other logistics systems to manage freight rates, reporting, forecasting, and payment validation.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI reports that turn logistics data into meaningful trends, insights, and actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate closely with the Logistics Analyst supporting New Zealand to improve performance and maintain alignment across the ANZ region, including providing leave cover when required.

    • Requirements:

    • Graduate degree in any discipline, preferably in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Data, Analytics, or a related field.
    • Strong understanding of supply chain operations, including transportation, logistics, storage, and distribution.
    • Demonstrated ability to build, manage, analyse, and maintain large datasets and analytical models that support problem-solving, decision-making, and optimisation.
    • Advanced Excel and Power BI skills, with the ability to create meaningful analysis, reporting, dashboards, and visualisations.
    • Previous experience with SAP, particularly SAP PRE or SAP Ariba, and Salesforce is desirable.
    • Experience or strong knowledge of logistics operations, freight pricing, carrier management, financial forecasting, and commercial analysis.
    • Strong numerical and analytical capabilities, with excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to problem-solving.
    • Effective communication skills and confidence working with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, including customers, carriers, sales teams, and finance partners.
    • Ability to simplify complex analytical findings and communicate them clearly to non-technical or commercial audiences.
    • Strong commercial mindset, with the ability to assess both short-term impacts and longer-term business implications.
    • Ability to manage changing priorities, work across multiple projects, and collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
    • Curious and proactive approach, with a demonstrated drive to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities.
    • Ability to evaluate problems objectively and use data to develop and compare practical alternatives.
    • Comfortable working independently while maintaining strong collaboration with regional and global stakeholders.
    • Strong judgement, adaptability, and organisational skills in a fast-paced business environment.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time position with a hybrid office/remote working model.
      • Based in Pune, India.
      • Working hours aligned to Australian business operations: 3:00 AM – 12:00 PM IST.
      • Opportunity to work with an international logistics and commercial team supporting operations across Australia and New Zealand.
      • Exposure to complex supply chain, freight, commercial, financial, and operational challenges.
      • Strong learning and development opportunities to support long-term career growth.
      • Inclusive and collaborative working environment that values diversity and different perspectives.
      • Work-life balance supported through a hybrid working arrangement.
      • Life and health insurance benefits.
      • Medical care package.
      • Opportunities to develop expertise across logistics analytics, financial modelling, commercial decision-making, and data visualisation.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is fielding the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of seabed exploration. Anduril has brought to the market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth platform, and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "large" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on multi-million-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.s our Maritime team continues to quickly grow, we are looking for motivated candidates that are inspired to work within an extremely energetic, creative, and innovative team that is passionate about subsea robotics and exploring the open ocean. We work in a highly dynamic environment where collaboration and idea sharing are a way of life.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for an Inventory Control Supervisor to join our rapidly growing team in Quonset, Rhode Island. In this role, you will be responsible for standing up and leading the inventory control function at our multi-product manufacturing site, ensuring material accuracy and availability across multiple production lines. You will oversee a team of Inventory Control Associates, establish cycle count programs, drive root cause analysis on inventory discrepancies, and partner closely with production and warehouse teams to maintain uninterrupted material flow. This will require experience with inventory management systems (ERP/WMS), cycle counting methodologies, and a strong foundation in warehouse operations within a manufacturing or production environment. If you are someone who thrives in a fast-paced, build-from-scratch environment, can bring structure where processes are still being defined, and is energized by the challenge of scaling operations across new product lines, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Inventory Accuracy & Control: Own cycle count programs, physical inventory counts, and reconciliation processes across all product lines. Drive inventory record accuracy above target thresholds and investigate root causes when discrepancies arise.
  • Team Leadership: Supervise and develop a team of Inventory Control Technicians. Set priorities, assign work, and build a culture of precision and accountability. Coordinate with Materials Associates to ensure alignment across warehouse operations.
  • Multi-Business Line Operations: Maintain segregated inventory tracking across multiple Maritime programs. Ensure material movements, transactions, and adjustments are attributed to the correct business line to support the site's cost allocation model.
  • ERP/WMS System Ownership: Serve as a warehouse power user for ERP and WMS platforms. Support system configuration for multi-BL tracking, ensure transaction discipline, and troubleshoot system issues. Participate in ongoing systems buildout as the site scales.
  • Financial Stewardship: Monitor and reconcile inventory-related variances. Support financial auditing activities, lead physical inventory counts, and partner with the Production Finance Lead on inventory valuation and excess and obsolete (E&O) material management.
  • Compliance & Government Property: Ensure all material management practices comply with federal requirements, including the Defense Federal Acquisitions Regulation Supplement (DFARS) for government property accountability. Maintain audit-ready records at all times.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the primary inventory liaison between the warehouse, production lines, procurement, and Finance. Participate in the site's battle rhythm meetings and provide visibility into material status, risks, and constraints.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify and lead process improvements to increase accuracy, reduce waste, and improve material flow. Implement standardized procedures that scale as additional business lines come to the site.
  • Metric Reporting: Develop and maintain inventory dashboards covering accuracy percentages, inventory turns, transaction discipline, shrinkage, and cycle count results. Report regularly to site leadership on performance and trends.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of experience in inventory control, warehouse management, or materials management in a manufacturing environment
  • 1+ year of experience supervising or leading a team
  • Proficiency with ERP and/or WMS platforms (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar)
  • Advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH) and comfort working with large data sets
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Effective communicator who can work across functions and present to leadership
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFFERED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in a defense, aerospace, or government-contract manufacturing environment
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related field
  • Experience standing up inventory processes at a new or scaling facility
  • Familiarity with quality management systems (e.g., AS9100, ISO 9001)
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement certification or experience
  • Programming or scripting skills (Python, SQL) for data analysis and reporting automation
  • Experience managing inventory across multiple product lines or programs within a single facility

Position Purpose:

The Child Advocacy Center (CAC) Director provides strategic, operational, financial, and programmatic leadership for Aviva Health’s Child Advocacy Center. The Director is responsible for ensuring the delivery of trauma-informed, child-centered, multidisciplinary services for children and families impacted by abuse, neglect, exploitation, violence, and other adverse experiences.


The Director leads the development and operation of a nationally accredited Child Advocacy Center and serves as the primary liaison between Aviva Health and community partners including law enforcement, child welfare, medical providers, mental health providers, prosecutors, victim advocates, schools, and community organizations.


This position oversees all CAC staff, programs, grants, accreditation activities, quality improvement initiatives, and multidisciplinary team (MDT) coordination while ensuring compliance with state, federal, and accreditation standards.


Essential Functions:

  • Develop and implement the CAC’s strategic plan, goals, and annual objectives.
  • Lead efforts to achieve and maintain accreditation through the National Children’s Alliance (NCA).
  • Identify opportunities to expand services and improve outcomes for children and families.
  • Represent the CAC within local, regional, and statewide child abuse intervention and prevention and response initiatives.
  • Actively participate in quarterly OCAS membership meetings and as needed outside of the membership meetings
  • Promote community awareness regarding child abuse intervention and prevention, and recovery.
  • Develop and maintain Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) with partner agencies.
  • Foster collaboration among law enforcement agencies, Oregon Department of Human Services Child Welfare, District Attorney's Office, Medical and Behavioral Health Providers.
  • Direct daily operations of the Child Advocacy Center including forensic interviews, medical evaluations, family advocacy services, mental health referrals and treatment coordination, victim support services, case tracking and outcomes reporting.
  • Ensure services are delivered in a child-friendly, culturally responsive, trauma-informed environment.
  • Develop and manage annual operating budgets.
  • Identify and pursue grant opportunities and funding partnerships.
  • Work collaboratively with Aviva Health leadership on budget planning and resource allocation.
  • Oversee grant applications, reporting requirements, and compliance activities.
  • Monitor financial performance and ensure fiscal sustainability.
  • Serve as spokesperson and ambassador for the CAC.
  • Participate in public education, fundraising, and awareness events.
  • Prepare reports and presentations for leadership, boards, grantors, and community stakeholders.



Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in psychology, social work, criminal justice, human services, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • Minimum five (5) years of progressively responsible leadership experience.
  • Eperience working with child welfare, child abuse investigations, victim services, behavioral health, healthcare, or criminal justice systems.
  • Experience managing programs, budgets, and personnel.
  • Minimum three (3) years of supervisory experience.

The Integration Management Analyst is a critical contributor within the Integration Management Office (IMO), responsible for enabling disciplined execution and tracking of integration performance, with a particular focus on monthly value capture processes, financial tracking, and data-driven insights. Value Capture & Financial Performance Management

  • Support stage-gate governance, business case updates, and initiative approvals.

Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting to track integration KPIs, synergy realization, and execution progress.
  • Perform data analysis to identify trends, risks, and performance improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure data integrity across systems and act as a steward of integration data quality.
  • Drive evolution of reporting capabilities, leveraging BI tools (e.g., Power BI) to enhance executive visibility.
  • Support creation of a “single source of truth” for integration reporting and performance tracking.

IMO Operations, Reporting & Stakeholder Enablement

  • Prepare recurring IMO reporting and executive-ready summaries of integration performance.
  • Support meeting cadence (IMO, workstream, SteerCo), including agenda development and action tracking.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, user guides, and training materials.
  • Facilitate communication across stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency.
  • Support onboarding and enablement of new team members and system users.

title: Senior Data Scientist, GBSG Demand Planning
description:
Demand planning is the starting point for how the Global Business Solutions Group (GBSG) understands and prepares for what's coming. An accurate, well-reasoned demand forecast is the single most important input to how the business plans and operates — it shapes downstream capacity, service levels, and expense, and it gives leaders a trustworthy view of where demand is heading and why. When the forecast is right, everything downstream gets easier; when it's off, the cost shows up quickly in customer experience and margin.


We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own demand forecasting for a subset of our GBSG demand planning portfolio. This is an individual contributor role with significant scope and visibility — you will be a primary modeler, analyst, and thought partner on how we forecast demand, quantify its drivers, and continuously improve forecast accuracy across pre-season, in-season, and off-season horizons. You will be expected to break down ambiguous business problems into sound, hypothesis-driven analysis and translate the results into clear, compelling recommendations that influence cross-functional leaders.


Responsibilities

Demand Forecasting Ownership

  • Own end-to-end demand forecasting across the GBSG demand planning portfolio, from early-season outlook through real-time in-season re-forecasting.

  • Build and maintain models that translate business and customer signals — funnel and trade-up dynamics, offer acceptance, seasonality, product and usage trends — into accurate, decision-ready demand forecasts.

  • Produce interval-level, daily, and weekly demand forecasts at the granularity the business needs, along with the assumptions and drivers behind them, so that partners can plan capacity, service, and expense with confidence.

  • Quantify and communicate forecast risk through scenario models and confidence intervals (e.g., upside/downside demand cases for peak-season planning).

Model Development & Innovation

  • Translate demand-planning business problems into predictive/prescriptive modeling problems, selecting the appropriate statistical, ML, or AI technique, and independently owning model build, validation, and review using paved-path tools.

  • Advance forecasting methodology — incorporating time-series models, regression-based approaches, causal inference, and ML techniques to improve accuracy and reduce forecast error.

  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B/n) to test drivers of demand and validate modeling choices, applying descriptive and inferential statistical methods.

  • Explore and incorporate new signal sources: marketing spend curves, product funnel data, historical seasonality and usage trends, and macroeconomic indicators.

  • Assess where AI/ML meaningfully improves the demand forecast, offering data-backed recommendations on where new techniques will move the needle versus where they will not.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Influence

  • Act as a trusted 'translator' between technical and non-technical partners — framing model outputs as clear demand narratives and using data storytelling to influence working teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Partner with Workforce Management, Capacity Planning, and Finance as the consumers of the demand forecast, ensuring the forecast is understood, trusted, and actionable for their downstream capacity, service, and expense decisions.

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to understand how offer and product strategy shifts demand, and reflect those dynamics in the forecast.

  • Define the metrics and KPIs that measure forecast quality and business impact, and provide thought partnership on business cases and learning plans across the portfolio.

Operational Analytics & In-Season Support

  • Support real-time in-season demand analytics — tracking actuals versus forecast, funnel conversion, and emerging demand signals — and re-forecast as conditions change.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and data products that surface demand trends and forecast risk to operational and leadership audiences.

  • Lead post-season retrospectives on forecast accuracy and bias analysis, and turn the learnings into methodology improvements.

Data & Infrastructure

  • Write and maintain production-quality SQL and Python (or R) code against Intuit's datalake, with sound data preparation and workflow management (authoring, scheduling, monitoring).

  • Partner with Data Engineering to improve upstream data quality and pipeline reliability for forecasting use cases.

  • Document models, assumptions, and methodologies to enable reproducibility and stakeholder trust.


Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in data science or quantitative analytics, with a focus on forecasting, demand planning, or time-series modeling.

  • Strong proficiency in Python (pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn) and SQL across large-scale data environments; comfort with data workflow management.

  • Hands-on experience building, validating, and deploying time-series or demand forecasting models in a production or operational context, and independently reviewing model quality.

  • Ability to break down ambiguous business problems into analytical questions and sound hypotheses, and to find evidence to prove or disprove them.

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate and influence through data storytelling — translating model outputs into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments — particularly during high-stakes operational windows.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Operations Research, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

Preferred

  • Experience designing and interpreting experiments (A/B/n) and applying causal inference methods (e.g., propensity score, difference-in-differences, synthetic control) to answer business questions.

  • Familiarity with applying AI/ML or GenAI techniques to forecasting problems, including measuring model performance (accuracy, latency, cost).

  • Experience defining metrics/KPIs for an initiative and partnering across multiple lines of business or a broad portfolio rather than a single product.

  • Exposure to workforce management, capacity planning, or contact-center / expert-network demand as a consumer of demand forecasts.


Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
San Diego $149,500 - $202,500

title: Senior Associate, Strategic & Corporate Development
description:
About Tantalus Systems (TSX: GRID)

Tantalus is a technology company dedicated to helping utilities modernize their distribution grids by harnessing the power of data across all their devices and systems deployed throughout the entire distribution grid – from the substation to the EV charger located behind the meter. We offer smart grid solutions across multiple levels: intelligent connected devices, communications networks, data management, enterprise applications and analytics. Learn more at .


Come join us if you’re interested in being part of an entrepreneurial team, solving complex technical problems and delivering innovative solutions that will directly impact the electrification of everything and the decarbonization of our society.


We have operations throughout the United States and Canada with offices in Burnaby (British Columbia, Canada), Raleigh (North Carolina, USA), and Norwalk (Connecticut, USA).


This position offers a competitive salary plus variable compensation based on performance targets and business objectives. Tantalus also offers generous benefits, including medical, dental and vision plans, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts and paid time off.


The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, this role serves as a strategic thought partner to the CEO and executive team, combining analytical depth with hands-on execution across the Company’s financial and strategic priorities.


As Senior Associate, Strategic & Corporate Development you will partner with leaders on FP&A activities (including budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling), support corporate finance and capital allocation decisions, contribute to investor relations by helping prepare earnings and investor materials, and provide rigorous analytical support on M&A, strategic partnerships, and contract negotiation.


In this role, you will translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations, build and maintain models and dashboards, prepare executive- and Board-ready materials, and coordinate cross-functional workstreams to ensure strategic initiatives are well-analyzed, well-communicated, and well-executed. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role that turns strategic direction into concrete analysis, decisions, and outcomes, while continuously improving how Tantalus plans, invests, and communicates with its stakeholders.

Location of Position:

This position is in office and located in our Norwalk, CT office

Specifically, the Senior Associate, Strategic & Corporate Development will:

Strategy & Market Intelligence

  • Monitor macro and sector trends in the electric utility, smart grid, and cleantech markets and synthesize them into actionable strategic insights for the CEO and leadership team.
  • Conduct competitive landscape analysis, market sizing, and benchmarking to inform product strategy, go-to-market decisions, and corporate development priorities.
  • Prepare executive-level briefings, industry analyses, and strategic memos on emerging technologies, regulatory developments, and competitor activity.
  • Support the CEO on ad hoc strategic projects and special initiatives as they arise


Strategic Finance and FP&A

  • Develop and maintain financial models, operating forecasts, and multi-year financial plans.
  • Partner with Finance on quarterly and annual budgeting processes.
  • Build scenario and sensitivity analyses to support executive decisions on capital allocation, pricing strategy, and business development opportunities.
  • Prepare financial performance summaries, KPI dashboards, and variance analyses for leadership review.


Corporate Development, M&A and Partnerships

  • Support the preparation and continuous improvement of investor-facing materials, including investor presentations, earnings releases, earnings call prepared remarks, and shareholder letters.
  • Screen, evaluate, and prioritize inorganic growth opportunities including acquisitions, strategic investments, and technology partnerships.
  • Build detailed financial models encompassing discounted cash flow (DCF), accretion/dilution, and comparable company analyses in support of M&A evaluation.
  • Coordinate and manage due diligence workstreams, across Finance, Legal, Engineering, Sales, and other teams.
  • Prepare investment memoranda, deal summaries, and management presentations to support executive and Board decision-making.
  • Support post-acquisition integration planning and development including ntegration playbooks, Day 1 readiness checklists, and 100-day integration plans.



Investor Relations & Capital Markets

  • Support the preparation and continuous improvement of investor-facing materials including investor presentations, earnings releases, earnings call scripts, and shareholder letters.
  • Own and maintain consensus model trackers, monitoring EPS estimates, revenue forecasts, price targets, and analyst ratings across all covering research banks, and prepare regular briefing summaries for the CEO.
  • Coordinate relationships with sell-side research analysts, managing information flow and logistics for meetings and non-deal roadshows.
  • Help articulate Tantalus’s ESG and clean energy transition narrative for linking grid modernization and utility decarbonization into a compelling investment story.


Strategic Partnerships & External Stakeholders

  • Help identify, develop, and manage strategic partnerships with utilities, technology vendors, industry associations, and other ecosystem participants.
  • Support contract negotiation preparation, partnership structuring analyses, and ongoing partner relationship management.
  • Represent Tantalus professionally with investment bankers, consultants, and other external advisors as directed by the CEO.


Board & Executive Support

  • Assist in the preparation of Board of Directors meeting materials including board packages, committee presentations, and supporting analyses.
  • Ensure materials are accurate, well-organized, and delivered on schedule; manage Coordinating board meeting logistics with the executive assistant and Chief Counsel & Administrative Officer.
  • Maintain a library of Board-approved strategic and financial reference materials.


Industry & Customer Engagement

  • Develop high-quality presentation materials for customer engagements, industry conferences, and trade association events.
  • Collaborate with the Marketing, Sales, and Product teams to ensure external-facing content is consistent with the Company's messaging, branding, and strategic positioning.
  • Support keynote preparation and speaker materials for the CEO and other senior executives.


What you Bring:

Education and Experience:

  • 4-6 years of progressive experience in investment banking, management consulting, corporate development, strategic finance, FP&A, or a related analytical field, including at least 2 years in an analytical, strategy-focused role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Professional designations such as CFA, CPA, or CBV are an asset.
  • Exposure to M&A transaction processes, capital markets activities, or corporate strategy in a growth-stage or publicly traded company.
  • Experience building and interpreting complex financial models to support senior executive decision-making.
  • Experience preparing executive-ready materials (presentations, memos, briefings) for senior leadership, Boards, or investors.
  • Comfortable with Office 365 with advanced proficiency in Excel (complex financial modelling, pivot tables, Power Query) and PowerPoint (executive-quality presentation design).
  • Experience using data visualization tools (like Power BI, Tableau) and financial data platforms (e.g., Bloomberg, Capital IQ, FactSet).
  • Demonstrated ability to work with AI-powered research and productivity tools to accelerate research, synthesize information, and draft clear, concise executive level communications.
  • Prior experience in the electric utility, energy technology, cleantech, or infrastructure sectors is an asset.
  • Ability to use Python or similar tools for data analysis, financial modelling automation, and workflow scripting is advantageous.

Personal Attributes:

  • Analytical Rigor: Strong quantitative skills with the ability to build, audit, and interpret financial models; work with complex data sets and turn analysis into clear, practical conclusions.
  • Executive Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to synthesize complex analyses into concise, board-ready narratives.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: Interest in the utilities, grid modernization, and clean energy transition; proactive in staying current on industry trends and developments.
  • Discretion & Integrity: Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information — including non-public financial data, M&A targets, and board materials.
  • Organizational Excellence: Strong project management skills; comfortable managing multiple priorities, tight timelines, and operate with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Team-oriented with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively across functions and with senior stakeholders

If you possess some of the key skills and experiences outlined in the job posting and are genuinely interested in the position, we invite you to take a chance and submit your application. We value diverse perspectives, unique skills, and believe in the power of potential over specific qualifications.


Tantalus is committed to employment equity and building a diverse workforce. We welcome and encourage Indigenous applicants, people of color, all genders, 2SLGBTQ+ and persons with disabilities to apply. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. For a confidential inquiry, simply email us at careers@tantalus.com.
