title: Salesforce - Principal Consultant Full-time
description:
Company Description

At Scyne, we are public purpose sector specialists who support governments and their agencies, and not-for-profit organisations, to deliver services to Australians, helping to build more resilient, equitable, secure and prosperous communities. We are guided by our values of Stronger Together, Amplify Impact, Build Trusted Relationships, Value Every Person, Think Beyond Limits, and Defined by Ethics.

Our purpose-driven professionals provide clients with access to the skills, capabilities and expertise to support the delivery of government agendas and public purpose projects, with specialist teams across three national practices:

  • Transformation
  • Risk, Programs and Cyber
  • Commercial, Financial and Infrastructure

Our Transformation Practice

Our Transformation practice brings together the skills and capabilities to support our clients to address their big agendas and deliver transformation programs. We look for passionate individuals with diverse backgrounds who can bring new perspectives to support our clients to address critical challenges across:

  • Architecture & Technology
  • Business & Experience
  • Capability & Change
  • Data & Artificial Intelligence (AI)
  • Execution & Enablement

Job Description

The Salesforce Principal Consultant is a senior client-facing leadership role within Scyne’s Transformation practice, responsible for initiating, influencing and delivering high-impact Salesforce-enabled transformation for public purpose clients. This role will provide strategic direction across complex Salesforce programs, lead client teams and projects, contribute to new and existing client work, and help shape scalable, sustainable solutions that enable the acceleration of performance improvement and business outcomes. The role requires a leader who can operate as a trusted advisor to C suite stakeholders, translate business and policy priorities into practical technology outcomes, and work collaboratively across Scyne to drive commercial success, innovation and client impact.

There is flexibility for the position to be based in any of our national offices: Melbourne, Sydney, Canberra, Brisbane, Perth or Adelaide. Regular interstate travel may be required.

In this role as a Director, you will:

  • Lead Salesforce-enabled transformation programs for public purpose clients, shaping strategy, solutions and delivery approaches that create meaningful impact.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, translating complex business, policy and service delivery needs into practical Salesforce outcomes.
  • Lead client teams and multi-disciplinary delivery teams across Salesforce advisory, architecture, implementation and optimisation.
  • Drive business development activity including proposals, solution shaping in our Architecture & Technology practice, supporting new pursuits and pipeline growth.
  • Provide technical and commercial leadership across delivery quality, project performance, risk, utilisation and client outcomes.
  • Coach and develop consultants, contribute to Salesforce capability uplift, and help build a high-performing, collaborative and innovative team.

Qualifications

We are searching for purpose-driven and passionate people who share and can live our values.

  • You're collaborative in nature and love working in and celebrating as a team. You respect and care for your colleagues and are curious about others’ views and reflect on the impact we have on others.
  • You have a growth mindset. You're interested in asking questions to challenge our thinking and love new ideas and trying new things.
  • You're curious about and able to put yourself in our clients’ shoes; you earn and value the trust placed in us.
  • You're someone who does what you say you'll do, and you do the right thing when no-one is looking, and you call it when you feel something isn’t quite right.

Technically, you will bring to the position demonstrated experience in working on transformation programs, with several of the following:

  • Significant experience leading Salesforce advisory, delivery or implementation programs.
  • Proven track record leading increasingly complex client projects, including responsibility for project outcomes, stakeholder engagement, solution quality, team performance and commercial results.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop new client work, support account growth, contribute to revenue targets and lead proposals, solution shaping and business development activity.
  • Deep understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including relevant clouds, architecture considerations, integration, data, security, governance, adoption and release management.
  • Experience translating business, policy and service delivery needs into Salesforce-enabled solutions that improve client outcomes, user experience, operational performance and digital maturity.
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary teams across business analysis, architecture, configuration, development, testing, change, deployment and optimisation activities.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience managing pipeline, utilisation, project economics, work in progress, billing, risk, quality and delivery governance.
  • Relevant Salesforce certifications are highly desirable
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in technology, business, information systems, or a related discipline are desirable.

Previous consulting experience is favourable. This will allow you to hit the ground running, leading consulting engagements and being directly involved in the day-to-day management of our local Transformation practice. As a Director, you will also develop new project work with existing clients and through creating new client relationships.

Additional Information

  • Market leading Parental Leave: Allows either carer to take 26 weeks of leave, flexibly, until a child is two years of age. A six-month minimum service requirement for new starters applies. We also make full superannuation contributions for up to 12 months (including unpaid parental leave).
  • Flex working: Our people have the autonomy to choose where and when they work so they can integrate their professional and personal lives, finding the right balance that fuels their growth, wellbeing, engagement and productivity. If it works for them, their teams, and their clients, it works for us.
  • Additional leave: a 5th week of paid leave to support rest, wellbeing, and inclusion during our annual summer shutdown also Birthday leave, First Nations Cultural Leave, Floating Public Holidays, Leave+ (purchased leave up to 12 weeks), Study Leave, Volunteering Leave, and more!
  • Smart Device reimbursement: Working flexibly means accessing the information you need on the go. That’s why we help pay for your smartphone or tablet, claiming up to $60 a month towards your bill.
  • Wellness and Lifestyle benefits: We’ll give you $295 a year to spend on items or activities that support your wellness, and up to $205 a year to support your balanced lifestyle.
  • Sonder: A digital care platform that empowers people to actively take control of their wellbeing to live well and perform at their best, free to Scyne Employees and their immediate family members.

We Value Every Person and Every Voice:

We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and promoting a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion.

We are passionate about improving outcomes with First Peoples, working in collaboration with government and community sectors towards programs which focus on First Nations clients, consumers and communities. We recognise the knowledge, insights and capabilities of First Peoples. Their strength, resilience and cultural competence are highly valued.

We know that an inclusive culture, and collective intelligence improves the decision-making processes and is critical to delivering exceptional outcomes for our clients and team. We encourage applications from those in marginalised and/or historically underrepresented communities within our workforce. Additionally, if you require any adjustments to the process, please let us know

Recruitment and Assessment Process:

Scyne’s approach to recruitment and selection is underpinned by key principles and expectations, ensuring we recruit and onboard a skilled and diverse workforce that is representative of the communities and organisations we serve. We ensure selection to roles is fair, with equal access provided, and appointments factor in but not limited to relative ability to fulfil the role, prior performance, potential and alignment with our values – taking unique experiences, perspectives, and contributions into consideration.

We carry out background checks on our people to ensure we have made a sound hiring decision and to protect the organisation and our clients from potential risk. If required, confirmation of a valid Commonwealth security clearance or the ability to obtain a Commonwealth security clearance.

At Scyne, we deeply value our recruitment partnerships. To ensure a clear and efficient process, we kindly request that all candidate submissions from search firms and recruiters are only made in alignment with a pre-existing, signed agreement for a specific position. Please note that any resumes submitted to Scyne for this position on an unsolicited basis, without a prior agreement, will not create any financial obligation for us. Consequently, we will not be liable for any fees or commissions should an unsolicited candidate be engaged, regardless of any conflicting terms or conditions you may have.

title: Senior Product Designer (Up)
description:
About Ferocia

We're the team behind Up, but under the hood, we're Ferocia - a passionate tech company driven by financial inclusion. Since 2011, we've been crafting innovative financial tools, starting with the digital platform for Bendigo Bank. We believe technology can empower everyone, from the advantaged to the disadvantaged, which is why Up was born.

Now, as part of the Bendigo and Adelaide Bank family, we combine the agility of a small company with the reach and stability of a major player. Together, we're carbon neutral, community-focused, and dedicated to high standards of corporate governance. Our mission? To leverage technology to help Australians move from financial stress and anxiety to a place of confidence and empowerment.

Want to join us? We'd love to hear from you!

The role

We're looking for 2 experienced Senior Product Designers to lead the work on our savings and home loan experiences. This is a rare opportunity to join a small team and have a real impact on people's lives by helping Australians build savings habits and feel in control of their home ownership journey.

Our designers wear many hats and own projects from start to finish — from idea to successfully shipped. Sometimes it's just a few days on a fun feature, sometimes it's months on a new financial product. So on a normal day, you could be:

  • Finding and exploring opportunities for every step of the user journey — whether it's reviewing user feedback, conducting interviews, analysing data, playing with a random idea, reinventing the wheel, refining existing concepts, or fixing tiny bugs.
  • Solving financial problems with a unique approach by focusing on how people feel and what's uniquely "Up". This takes real craftsmanship and attention to detail to make a simple feature feel like a game-changer (interactions, visuals and copy) and a genuine understanding of how people manage their money and use our app.
  • Building new financial products. This takes deep systems thinking to map complex interactions and dependencies and create a holistic experience across many touchpoints. You'll need to be comfortable with complex technical problems and know how to approach big projects strategically.
  • Working closely with our creative (Product, Design, Brand) and leadership teams to discuss ideas, review work in progress, help define our roadmap, and shape our long-term strategy. You’ll have to be comfortable designing concepts and interactive prototypes at various levels of fidelity to be able to clearly communicate your ideas to the right audience.
  • Collaborating with engineering teams to ship high-quality features to our users within our delivery timeframes — by helping scope, prioritise, review, and adapt concepts as necessary. As well as working with our Marketing and Support teams to ensure a great user experience at any touchpoint.

What we're looking for

  • Experience designing and delivering end to end projects (from idea to successfully launched) — with at least 5 years working with product teams (ideally on a SaaS or consumer product, and even better if it's in Fin-Tech), or within a digital agency.
  • Creativity and craftsmanship — strong interaction and visual skills, with a keen eye for detail to achieve visually pleasing aesthetics — from tiny micro-interactions, to complex multi-step experiences, and the ability to think outside of conventional approaches. We really pride ourselves in the way we present experiences and the emotional responses we seek from our users.
  • Problem solving skills and a strong product lens — the ability to understand customer needs, motivations and behaviours, and to know how to translate this understanding into product opportunities. Being able to think holistically about end to end experiences, and design solutions that fit into an ecosystem.
  • Collaboration and communication skills — the ability to articulate ideas effectively and provide sound reasoning for decisions, and to use storytelling to inform and influence.
  • Passion — harder to define, but we're looking for people who have a desire to push the limits, break the status quo, and be at the forefront of where technology is leading us. An eagerness to learn, expand your skills, and do the best work possible.
  • Technical knowledge, especially front-end, and a general understanding of an agile engineering development process.
  • Ability to work with a certain level of ambiguity, and "get shit done" autonomously — we operate like a start-up and things can often be messy, undefined, or change at the last minute. We're looking for someone who enjoys innovative fast paced work environments and tackling all sort of problems.

Interview process

More details will be provided on application, but all applicants will go through the same stages:

  1. Intro chat and career review with Sylvain (Head of Design) — 30min
  2. Presentation of 2-3 case studies to Sylvain (Head of Design) and 2 Product Design Leads, for a deep dive into your work and your design skills — 60min
  3. Interview with a cross-functional team (EM, Front-end developer, Product Designer) with a critique of an app of your choice, to understand how you think, and get a feel for what it would be like working together — 60min
  4. References check
  5. Offer!

When applying, make sure to attach a portfolio or provide a link to an online portfolio (including any needed passwords) to demonstrate your skills and some examples of work you’ve produced.

Estimated salary range
$135,000—$165,000 AUD

Working at Ferocia

We have a hybrid work culture where people can attend the Ferocia office as much or as little as makes sense for them.

We offer:

  • A small team of passionate people
  • Generous leave and parental policy
  • Flexible working schedule
  • Great city office and perks (rooftop, gym and personal trainer, games…)
  • Budget for personal development, training, and conferences
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Home loan rebates for our loans (conditions apply)

Not quite ticking every box? Throw your hat in the ring anyway! At Ferocia, we're all about shaking things up and rewriting the rules. We thrive on diversity and inclusion, and we wholeheartedly encourage you to step up and shine. Let us be the judge of your qualifications for this role – you just might surprise yourself!

title: Group leader
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

SUMMARY
Lead the operation of the back end of the manufacturing line.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

· Coordinate with Manufacturing Supervisor and organize line workload and staffing depending on product priority.
· Ensure work meets or exceeds Jabil workmanship standards and monitor the CIQ system closely in order to fix repetitive and recognized problems immediately.
· Minimize changeover times through organized and well-planned changeovers.
· Minimize excess material on floor; ensure proper stock and availability of operation supplies and equipment.
· Verify that only accurate, current, and authorized documentation is available on the line.
· Inform or instruct employees of any deviations or changes.
· Notify Manufacturing Supervisor immediately regarding all employee problems, concerns and recommendations.
· Strive for continuous improvement in all areas of responsibility.
· Ensure line personnel are thoroughly trained, certified and are performing their assigned functions.
· Motivate and challenge all line members to perform to their full potential through direct and timely formal and informal feedback.
· Track production and ensure all deadlines and schedules are met.
· Review all relevant policies and procedures issued to the line and ensure that appropriate employees read, understand, and adhere to them.
· Adhere to all safety rules, use and ensure that workers use the required protective equipment.
· Ensure that assigned area is clean and organized.
· Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
· Comply and follow all procedures within the company security policy.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
High School diploma or equivalent required and two to six years experience in a relevant Jabil production position; or equivalent combination of experience and education. Experience in printed circuit board manufacturing strongly preferred.

BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. title: ATS Software Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

  • CAE Vision: Our vision is to be the worldwide partner of choice in defense and security, and civil aviation by revolutionizing our customers’ training and critical operations with digitally immersive solutions to elevate safety, efficiency and readiness.
  • CAE Defense & Security Mission: CAE's Defense and Security business unit focuses on helping prepare military customers to develop and maintain the highest levels of mission readiness.
  • CAE Values: Empowerment, Innovation, Excellence, Integrity and OneCAE make us who we are and we strive to make a difference in the world while helping each other succeed.

What We Have to Offer:

  • Comprehensive and competitive benefits package and flexibility that promotes work-life balance
  • A work environment where all employees are valued, respected and safe
  • Freedom to succeed by enabling team members to deliver, take initiatives and make decisions
  • Recognition, professional development, advancement and having fun!

This position is contingent on Contract Award.

Summary

This role is performed as part of a production engineering team supporting the development, integration, and deployment of training systems. Responsibilities include networking, interfacing platform simulation applications, and providing product level troubleshooting and integration. The position follows the direction of lead engineers, works effectively with general technical guidance, and supports the Training System Support Center (TSSC) through all phases of software design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Engineering solutions must be imaginative, thorough, practical, and aligned with organizational standards and objectives.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Performs engineering tasks within a production team environment supporting the development, integration, and deployment of training systems and associated software applications.
• Assists in networking design, system configuration, and interfacing with platform simulation applications as part of integrated training solution development.
• Completes assigned work with general technical direction from lead engineers, ensuring accuracy, quality, and adherence to project timelines.
• Communicates project status, technical issues, risks, and recommended solutions or corrective actions to lead engineers and project stakeholders.
• Designs, modifies, develops, writes, and implements software programming applications for training system components.
• Installs, configures, and supports software applications and operating systems used within simulation environments.
• Participates in all phases of software development within the TSSC, including requirements review, design, coding, integration, testing, and deployment, with minimal supervision.
• Performs product level troubleshooting, diagnoses software and system issues, and supports corrective actions to restore or enhance system functionality.
• Develops engineering solutions that are imaginative, thorough, practical, and consistent with established technical processes and organizational objectives.
• Creates and maintains accurate technical documentation such as design notes, installation guides, test procedures, and software support materials.
• Collaborates closely with cross-functional teams including software, hardware, and integration engineers to support system configuration updates and capability enhancements.
• Follows established engineering procedures, configuration management guidelines, and quality standards to ensure consistent and reliable product performance.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

• Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
• 1–3 years of experience in software development, systems integration, or engineering support roles.
• Foundational knowledge of software programming languages, debugging methods, and structured development practices.
• Familiarity with operating systems, networking principles, and software installation processes.
• Ability to follow engineering direction and work effectively with general supervision.
• Strong problem solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues and propose practical solutions.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills, especially for reporting status and documenting engineering activities.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team oriented technical environment.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with simulation devices, training systems, or defense related software environments.
• Knowledge of system integration principles and interfacing with simulation platform software.
• Experience working with software version control systems or configuration management tools.
• Familiarity with distributed computing, networking protocols, or simulation networking technologies.
• Ability to develop or update detailed technical documentation for software and system support.
• Experience troubleshooting complex interactions between hardware, software, and integrated systems.

Security Responsibilities

Must comply with all company security and data protection / usage policies and procedures. Personally responsible for proper marking and handling of all information and materials, in any form. Shall not divulge any information, or afford access, to other employees not having a need-to-know. Shall not divulge information outside company without management approval. All government and proprietary information will be accessed and stored electronically on company provided resources.

  • Incumbent must be eligible for DoD Personal Security Clearance.

Due to U.S. Government contract requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for this role.

Work Environment

Work is performed in a subassembly shop, final assembly labs and customer sites. All areas are climate controlled however there are times when individuals will need to work outside in the elements.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

• Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working on computers or performing engineering tasks.
• Ability to walk through simulator bays, engineering labs, or training system areas as needed.
• May occasionally need to lift and move small equipment or components (up to approximately 25 lbs).

Other Duties

The Nkabom Collaborative is a Community of Practice addressing youth unemployment in Ghana's nutrition and agri-food sectors through experiential learning, inclusive community-based research, and youth-led entrepreneurship. This innovative partnership brings together nine leading Ghanaian and Canadian institutions to transform the nutrition-agri-food ecosystem and create dignified employment opportunities for young people, especially women and marginalized communities in Ghana.

Together, the Secretariat team (6-8 people in total) will serve as a facilitating hub for activity across all partner institutions (PI). The Secretariat will likewise promote and reflect the shared Principles of Collaboration adopted by the Partner organizations in support of Collaborative programming and deliverables and in the day-to-day operations of the Secretariat in support of the Collaborative.

Position Summary:
Reporting to the Associate Director, Administration & Operations, to the Secretariat of the Nutrition and Sustainable Agri-food Collaborative, the Administrative Officer will provide efficient and effective administrative and operational support to the Secretariat. The incumbent will develop and maintain administrative standards, practices and systems for the Secretariat, acting as a liaison between the Secretariat and the McGill partners of the Collaborative as well as external organizations in both Canada and Ghana. Working closely with the leadership team of the Secretariat, the Administrative Officer will be responsible for activities related to general office management, the management of physical resources, event planning, meetings, travel arrangements, and records management. enter position summary here

  • Responsible for the timely submission of expense reimbursement claims related to travel and other expenses.
  • Responsible for purchasing office materials and equipment as needed by the members of the Secretariat.
  • Maintains detailed inventories of IT equipment, software and capital assets purchased by the Secretariat and McGill partners with donor funds provided for the Collaborative.
  • Supervision of support staff.

Other Qualifying Skills and/or Abilities

  • Motivated self-starter with an ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision as well as within a team.

  • Strong demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 applications including Share Point, Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and OneNote.

description:
Description

We're looking for an experienced Network Security & Infrastructure Architect to lead enterprise network transformation, security hardening, and infrastructure modernization initiatives. The successful candidate will be responsible for assessing, designing, and implementing secure, scalable, and resilient network solutions across enterprise, data center, hosted, and edge environments.



Responsibilities
  • Enterprise Network Hardening (Software Defined Access - SDA)
  • Review and assess the current enterprise network security posture, architecture, and operational controls.
  • Define and implement network security policies aligned with industry best practices and security frameworks.
  • Identify security gaps, vulnerabilities, and configuration weaknesses across the enterprise network landscape.
  • Develop recommendations and remediation plans to strengthen network security and compliance.
  • Reconfigure and optimize Software Defined Access (SDA) and data center network environments based on assessment findings and best-practice recommendations.
  • Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and operations teams to ensure consistent policy enforcement and governance.
  • Hosted & Edge Network Transformation
  • Conduct firewall estate reviews and drive firewall policy alignment initiatives to ensure consistent rule sets across environments.

  • Evaluate existing Cisco routing infrastructure and identify opportunities for performance, resiliency, and operational improvements.
  • Lead routing assessment activities, including network discovery, design validation, and implementation planning.
  • Implement routing enhancements and optimization recommendations across enterprise and edge environments.
  • Develop a strategic Network Refresh Roadmap covering hardware lifecycle management, technology modernization, capacity planning, and future-state architecture.


Qualifications

Technical Skills & Experience:

  • Strong experience in enterprise networking, network security, and infrastructure architecture.
  • Hands-on expertise with Cisco networking technologies, including routing, switching, and Software Defined Access (SDA).
  • Proven experience with firewall platforms, including Check Point and other leading security technologies.
  • Deep understanding of network security principles, segmentation, zero-trust architectures, and secure access controls.
  • Experience conducting network assessments, architecture reviews, and transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of data center networking, hosted environments, cloud connectivity, and edge network architectures.
  • Familiarity with industry security frameworks and best practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, CISSP, CISM, Check Point certifications, or equivalent.
  • Experience leading large-scale network modernization and security transformation initiatives.
  • Strong stakeholder management, documentation, and presentation skills.

Key Deliverables:

  • Enterprise network security posture assessment and recommendations.
  • SDA and data center network optimization plan and implementation.
  • Firewall alignment and standardization strategy.
  • Check Point replacement assessment and migration roadmap.
  • Cisco routing enhancement assessment and implementation.
  • Enterprise network refresh strategy and future-state architecture roadmap.

title: Vice President, Global Benefits
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa is seeking a Vice President, Global Benefits to lead the strategy, governance, design, and delivery of benefits and wellbeing programs for a global workforce of more countries. This executive will be responsible for shaping a benefits portfolio that strengthens Visa’s employee value proposition, supports attraction and retention, advances employee wellbeing, and aligns with the company’s business priorities.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Total Rewards, the Vice President will lead the Global Benefits Center of Excellence and serve as a key member of the Total Rewards Leadership Team. The role will establish the global benefits vision and operating model, set enterprise-wide priorities, and partner closely with regional People teams and cross-functional leaders to deliver programs that are globally consistent, locally relevant, financially sustainable, and compliant with applicable requirements.

This leader will bring strategic perspective, operational discipline, and strong executive judgment to a complex global portfolio. They will advise senior leaders, manage risk, guide major investments, oversee vendor and partner performance, and lead transformation efforts that modernize the benefits experience for employees while supporting Visa’s long-term growth.

Key Responsibilities

Global Benefits Strategy

  • Define and execute a comprehensive global benefits and wellbeing strategy aligned with Visa's business priorities, workforce needs, and People Team objectives.
  • Establish enterprise-wide principles and standards that balance global consistency with regional flexibility and compliance requirements.
  • Continuously evaluate market trends, workforce demographics, employee expectations, and competitive practices to inform program evolution and innovation.
  • Ensure benefits and wellbeing programs contribute meaningfully to employee engagement, talent attraction, retention, and workforce productivity.

Global Governance, Risk, and Compliance

  • Establish and oversee governance frameworks that enable effective decision-making, accountability, and compliance across Visa's global benefits portfolio.
  • Provide oversight of regulatory requirements, fiduciary responsibilities, controls, audits, and risk management activities across all regions.
  • Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Tax, Payroll, Finance, Sourcing, Global People Solutions, and regional People leaders to ensure sustainable and compliant program administration.
  • Anticipate emerging legislative and regulatory developments and proactively guide organizational responses.

Financial Stewardship and Investment Management

  • Lead financial strategy and stewardship for Visa's global benefits programs, ensuring effective management of investments and operating expenditures.
  • Guide annual planning, forecasting, funding strategies, and long-range financial modeling.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, business cases, and trade-offs to optimize employee experience, organizational value, and financial sustainability.
  • Partner with Finance and executive leadership on enterprise-level workforce investment decisions.

Benefits Operations and Service Delivery

  • Ensure operational excellence across all aspects of benefits administration, service delivery, employee support, and vendor performance.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that simplify processes, improve employee experiences, and increase organizational efficiency.
  • Develop scalable operating models that enable global consistency while supporting regional market needs.
  • Maintain a strong focus on quality, service, execution, and measurable outcomes.

Digital Transformation, Technology, and Analytics

  • Lead the evolution of the benefits technology ecosystem to enhance employee experiences and operational effectiveness.
  • Leverage data, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies to inform decisions and improve program performance.
  • Establish measurement frameworks that provide actionable insights into utilization, engagement, cost, outcomes, and return on investment.
  • Drive innovation and digital transformation initiatives that modernize benefits delivery and employee navigation experiences.

Vendor and External Partner Management

  • Oversee Visa's global benefits vendor ecosystem, including strategic partner selection, governance, performance management, contract negotiations, and service delivery.
  • Build strong relationships with consultants, insurers, healthcare partners, retirement providers, and other external stakeholders.
  • Ensure third-party partnerships drive innovation, quality, risk mitigation, operational effectiveness, and value creation.

Corporate Initiatives and Mergers & Acquisitions

  • Serve as the benefits subject matter expert and strategic advisor for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Lead assessment, integration, harmonization, and change management activities related to benefits programs and employee impacts.
  • Contribute to enterprise projects that require broad People Team, regulatory, workforce, or financial expertise.

Executive Advisory and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on benefits strategy, workforce wellbeing, financial investments, risk management, and employee experience.
  • Influence business and People Team decisions through data-driven insights, thoughtful analysis, and practical recommendations.
  • Build strong partnerships across Total Rewards, Talent, People Business Partners, Finance, Sourcing, Legal, People and Enterprise Technology, Communications, and regional People organizations.

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing global Benefits COE.
  • Build organizational capabilities, succession plans, operating practices, and talent strategies that support long-term success.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, inclusion, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Continue evolving the Global Benefits COE to meet the changing needs of Visa's workforce and business strategy.

Leadership Characteristics

Enterprise Perspective: Demonstrates the ability to connect benefits strategy to broader business, workforce, and organizational objectives while balancing employee experience, financial stewardship, risk management, and operational excellence.

Strategic Agility: Combines long-term vision with practical execution. Anticipates future trends and translates complexity into actionable strategies and solutions.

Influence and Partnership: Builds trusted relationships across functions, regions, and leadership levels. Successfully navigates ambiguity and drives alignment among diverse stakeholders.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Champions new ideas, technologies, and approaches that improve outcomes for employees and the organization.

Data-Driven Decision Making: Leverages insights, analytics, and sound judgment to identify opportunities, manage risk, and drive business results.


People Leadership: Develops talent, builds high-performing teams, and creates

an environment where employees can grow, contribute, and succeed.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 10 years of experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 8 years of work experience with a PhD.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in global benefits, total rewards, People functions, or a related discipline.
  • Significant experience leading complex global programs across multiple regions, geographies, and regulatory environments.
  • Proven track record developing and executing enterprise-level strategies and operating models.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing large-scale budgets, forecasting, investment evaluations, and business case development.
  • Demonstrated success influencing executive leaders and leading through ambiguity, transformation, and organizational change.
  • Experience building and leading high-performing global teams and cross-functional partnerships.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and executive presentation skills.
  • Experience within a large, global organization preferred, with exposure to technology, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.


Information for US Applicants

For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $222,500 to $360,000 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. title: Meat Processor - Lamb Technician
description:
Looking for more than just another season 🐑
Fresh Meats NZ is looking for experienced and motivated Lamb Technicians to join our Napier processing team in permanent, full-time positions.

If you’re already in the meat industry and looking for stable, year-round employment, variety, skills development and greater earning potential, we’d like to hear from you.

New to the industry? We also welcome reliable, motivated people who are ready to learn and build a career in meat processing.

Why Fresh Meats? ⭐
Fresh Meats NZ is a boutique Napier-based lamb processor operating year-round – we are not a seasonal employer. We manufacture premium lamb products for domestic and international markets and are part of Integrated Foods Group.

Our size gives our people the opportunity to gain experience across different parts of the operation rather than being limited to one task.

Variety in Your Working Week 🔄
Our unique alternate-day processing schedule covers:

  • Primary processing – slaughter
  • Secondary processing – boning, packing and product preparation


This provides genuine variety and the opportunity to develop skills across multiple areas of the plant.

Grow Your Skills – Grow Your Pay 📈
We operate a skills-based pay matrix, with earning potential increasing as you develop competency and experience across the plant.



Indicative hourly equivalent ranges:

  • Level 1 – Inexperienced: $25–$35
  • Level 2 – Experienced: $28–$38
  • Level 2+ – Experienced All-Rounder: $30–$40
  • Level 3 – New Boner/Butcher: $30–$45
  • Level 3+ – Mid-Experience Boner/Butcher: $32–$47
  • Level 4 – Experienced All-Round Boner/Butcher: $35–$50


The more skills you develop, the greater your earning potential.

Progression isn’t simply based on how long you’ve worked here. Motivated employees can develop additional competencies and progress through the pay matrix.

We also support employees to work towards nationally recognised Primary ITO qualifications, gaining formal qualifications while developing practical skills on the job.

About the Role
Depending on your skills, experience and the production schedule, duties may include:

  • Primary processing and slaughter-floor operations
  • Knife and processing roles
  • Boning-room operations
  • Packing and product preparation
  • Operating processing equipment
  • Maintaining hygiene and food safety standards
  • Working to MPI and export-market requirements
  • Following health and safety procedures


Previous meat-industry experience is highly valued, particularly in slaughter, boning, knife-hand or other skilled processing roles.

Full training is also available for suitable candidates with the right attitude, reliability and willingness to learn.

With year-round processing, you can count on consistent work rather than relying on a seasonal schedule.

  • Have reliable transport
  • Work well as part of a team
  • Be positive and willing to learn
  • Be physically fit and comfortable in a processing environment
  • Take pride in producing quality work
  • Be committed to health, safety, food safety and animal welfare
  • Complete pre-employment drug testing and a meat handler’s medical assessment
  • Be legally entitled to work in New Zealand


What We Offer:

  • Permanent, stable, year-round employment
  • Monday-to-Friday working week
  • Skills-based pay progression
  • Primary ITO qualification pathways
  • Experience across primary and secondary processing
  • On-the-job training and development
  • Career opportunities within Fresh Meats and Integrated Foods Group
  • A varied and supportive working environment
  • All required PPE provided


Ready for Your Next Step? 🚀
Whether you’re an experienced meat-industry professional looking for your next opportunity or new to the industry and keen to build a career, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply now or come and see us at:
Fresh Meats NZ
11 Thames Street
Pandora, Napier

Build your skills. Gain qualifications. Grow your earning potential. Build a career with Fresh Meats.

Questions? Contact Michelle McLeely on 027 568 9945.

title: Epidemiologist
description:
Tunnell Government Services, Inc., is comprised of the industry’s leading scientists, medical and technical experts, and human capital and organizational development professionals. We approach all projects as a team and are committed to helping our clients transform and quickly achieve strategic goals. If you are interested in joining an employee-owned company that develops and implements innovative, integrated and differentiated solutions, please click on the links below to find the job that is right for you and contact us.

Epidemiology Subject Matter Expert – Position Description

The mission of the FDA Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH) is to protect and promote the public health. CDRH assures that patients and providers have timely and continued access to safe, effective, and high-quality medical devices and safe radiation-emitting products.

The Office of Clinical Evidence and Analysis within CDRH's Office of Product Evaluation and Quality (OPEQ) provides policy and program support regarding clinical trials, biostatistics, real-world evidence, epidemiological analysis and outreach and collaboration with hospitals and other external stakeholders.

Tunnell Government Services, Inc. is providing professional and scientific services to CDRH with expert consultants with scientific expertise in the regulation and approval and of medical devices. In general, these consultants provide consultation related to supporting medical device reviews (EUA, 510(k), PME and De Novo marketing applications, Pre-submissions); participate in meetings and teleconferences; coordinate meetings with internal and external stakeholders; develop written reviews and correspondence; write detailed documents and reports; and execute other administrative tasks related to CDRH’s projects.

Tunnell is seeking a candidate to provide expert consulting services to assist the CDRH with their regulatory responsibilities. This candidate should possess specific expertise and applicable training in epidemiology, as relevant to:

  • Evaluating the safety, effectiveness, and post-market performance of medical devices and radiation-emitting products
  • Analyzing clinical trial data, real-world evidence (RWE), and adverse event reports monitoring the safety and effectiveness of medical devices, under the direction of federal personnel.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Post-Market Surveillance: Monitor medical devices already on the market to detect safety signals, assess risks, and investigate adverse events
  • Clinical Trial & Study Design: Collaborate with biostatisticians and medical officers to review study protocols, clinical evidence, and real-world data (RWD)
  • Regulatory Decision-Making: Use epidemiological methods to guide policy frameworks, ensuring that patients and healthcare providers have timely access to safe and effective devices
  • Risk/Benefit Analysis: Quantify the benefits and risks of innovative medical technologies, including AI and digital health applications

Qualifications

  • The ideal candidate will have a doctorate in an area of study such as Epidemiology, Applied Statistics, or Public Health.
  • Possess several years of experience coordinating, conducting, and/or reviewing epidemiologic studies, surveys, and/or analyses to inform program and policy decisions.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: An understanding of medical device regulations is preferred.
  • The candidate must possess a bachelor’s degree (BS) in a relevant field
  • An advanced degree (MD, MS, PhD) in a related/applicable field is strongly preferred.
  • 5-7 years of applicable experience is required, however advanced degrees can substitute for professional work experience
  • Ability to communicate well with others using excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively work both independently and within a team of technical personnel.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.)

Job Type: Full Time

Schedule: Monday through Friday (No Holidays)

Location: This position is 100% telework.

Must be a US Citizen or a Full Green Card holder.

Tunnell strives to hire and retain the most qualified talent. We believe that having employees with different backgrounds and capabilities contributes to the success of our business. To attract qualified applicants, Tunnell posts to a wide variety of job sites. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Please be advised that certain client contracts may outline specific requirements for onsite work. Tunnell employees and/or contractors are expected to comply with all client requirements, including any safety and health protocols.

title: Data Scientist, Senior
description:
Data Scientist, Senior

The Opportunity:

As a data scientist, you’re excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you’re fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open new opportunities. As a data scientist at Booz Allen, you can help turn these complex data sets into useful information to solve global challenges. Across private and public sectors—from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence—we need you to help find the answers in the data.

On our team, you’ll use your leadership skills and data science expertise to create real-world impact. You’ll work closely with clients to understand their questions and needs, and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. You’ll guide teammates and lead the development of algorithms and systems. You’ll use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into objective answers to advise your clients as they make informed decisions. Ultimately, you’ll provide a deep understanding of the data, what it all means, and how it can be used.

Work with us as we use data science for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 8+ years of experience correlating complex technical findings into graphical, written, visual, and verbal narrative products
  • 5+ years of experience building advanced analytics and AI/ML models, particularly tools leveraging LLMs or agentic AI, including data retrieval and cleaning, modeling, accuracy evaluation and testing, and visualization
  • Experience working on classified networks in support of DoW or IC clients
  • Ability to visualize complex data and concepts for non-technical leadership, highlighting system risks and articulating "go or no-go" criteria clearly
  • Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
  • Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience with scientific techniques such as mathematics, statistics, information science, AI, machine learning, probability modeling, data mining, data engineering, or data warehousing, or 12+ years of experience with scientific techniques such as mathematics, statistics, information science, AI, machine learning, probability modeling, data mining, data engineering, or data warehousing in lieu of a degree

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience in the development of algorithms leveraging R, Python, or SQL/NoSQL
  • Experience with Distributed data and computing tools, including MapReduce, Hadoop, Hive, EMR, Kafka, Spark, Gurobi, or MySQL
  • Experience with visualization packages, including Plotly, Seaborn, or ggplot2
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000.00 to $225,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.

  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

title: Research Associate II, Clinical Biomarker Development
description:
Revolution Medicines is a late-stage clinical oncology company developing novel targeted therapies for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. The company’s R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins. The company’s RAS(ON) inhibitors daraxonrasib (RMC-6236), a RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitor; elironrasib (RMC-6291), a RAS(ON) G12C-selective inhibitor; zoldonrasib (RMC-9805), a RAS(ON) G12D-selective inhibitor; and RMC-5127, a RAS(ON) G12V-selective inhibitor, are currently in clinical development. As a new member of the Revolution Medicines team, you will join other outstanding professionals in a tireless commitment to patients with cancers harboring mutations in the RAS signaling pathway.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a Research Associate II to join our Clinical Biomarker Development team. The selected candidate will play a vital role in supporting clinical biomarker leads in implementing biomarker strategies for RAS(ON) inhibitor clinical trials. This role offers the chance to work in a collaborative and innovative environment while contributing to ongoing clinical studies.

  • Collaborate with Clinical Biomarker Leads, Biomarker Scientists and other Translational Medicine team members in Clinical Biomarker Operations and Clinical Bioinformatics to support the execution of biomarker strategies.

  • Perform quality control (QC) on study-related biomarker data and figures that lead to scientific presentations.

  • Conduct detailed review of clinically relevant documents for RAS(ON) inhibitor clinical trials to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and compliance with study protocols.

  • Work with Clinical Biomarker Operations to facilitate biomarker sample testing and design inventories of biomarker samples to support study planning and biomarker data delivery.

  • Plan, perform, and present semi-routine analysis of biomarker data under general supervision.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Masters in cancer biology, cell or molecular biology, or a related field with 0-1 years of relevant experience.

  • Excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and effective time management with the ability to adapt to shifting priorities.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Proficiency in quality control of scientific data.

  • Ability to thrive in detail-oriented work within fast-paced, team-based environments.

Preferred Skills:

  • Hands on experience with data science languages such as R, Python, and SQL.

  • Understanding of oncology drug development, clinical trial design, and biomarker integration.

  • Familiarity with clinically relevant biomarker platforms, including NGS and qPCR/ddPCR.

You'll be hands-on — architecting, building, and maintaining the ecomm/web platform yourself — while also directing the work of a junior engineer focused on backend and data projects and coordinating with an external contractor building our AI/agent enablement tools (MCP servers, agent workflows).

This is a working technical lead role: most of your week is still spent writing code and solving problems directly, but you're also the person who decides what the team works on next and reviews how it gets built.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Own the architecture, development, and ongoing maintenance of Greenix's ecommerce platform and website
  • Drive improvements in site performance, technical SEO, and conversion-relevant metrics, using analytics (Google Analytics or similar) to inform decisions
  • Own project intake and prioritization for the development team's backlog, directing the day-to-day work of a junior engineer and an external AI/agent enablement contractor
  • Review code and provide technical guidance to the junior engineer, raising the bar on engineering standards across backend and data-focused projects
  • Coordinate with the external contractor on AI/agent and MCP server initiatives, ensuring their work aligns with the broader platform and priorities
  • Apply DevOps practices across CI/CD, deployment, and infrastructure for web/ecomm systems, partnering closely with your manager (Systems, InfoSec & Infrastructure) on security and infrastructure standards
  • Work full-stack as needed — front-end, back-end, integrations — to keep the ecomm/web roadmap moving
  • Help guide the platform toward an API-first architecture, where front-end experiences are built on top of well-defined APIs.
  • Help shape AI Development Practices for the company.

Qualifications:

  • ~5 years of experience in software engineering, with a strong track record on ecommerce platforms (having supported or built multiple ecomm sites is a big plus)
  • Full-stack development experience across modern front-end and back-end technologies
  • Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and web analytics tools (Google Analytics or equivalent)
  • Practical DevOps experience — CI/CD, deployment pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, or similar
  • Experience directing the work of other engineers or contractors — setting priorities, reviewing output — without necessarily having held a formal management title
  • Strong communication skills; comfortable setting technical direction and prioritizing work for a small team
  • Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, plus experience with React, Angular, or a similar front-end framework

title: Facilities Operations Centre (FOC) Engineer, AWS
description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centres and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Centre Global Engineering Operations organisation is looking for an individual with proven and tested leadership skills to help bring to fruition a newly developed Facilities Operations Centre (FOC). The FOC is responsible for 24X7 monitoring of the data centre’s physical infrastructure and will serve as a facilitator for all Large Scale Events (LSEs) and Critical Site Events (CSEs). This role will also serve as a central monitoring location for the facility electrical and mechanical systems. This team will ensure that the customer experience will be optimal and gratifying by way of consistency, reliability and attention to detail.

The ideal candidate will need to have an understanding of data centre IT infrastructure and data centre facilities infrastructure and how the two entities co-exist. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing assistance and support to the onsite team. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels. Qualified candidates must also have experience functioning in a large-scale data centre and have demonstrated and displayed the ability to think outside of the box. This skill is essential, as the candidate will assist with aligning the FOC with the larger objectives of other business and peer organisations. You will need to play a role with growing the team to a standard of operational excellence.

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, you think and act globally, and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon Data Centre's, then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!

Key job responsibilities
You'll be the operational heartbeat of our data centre infrastructure — monitoring, coordinating, and driving excellence across every shift.

Your core mission centres on real-time monitoring of the Amazon facilities infrastructure platform, where you'll interpret signals from electrical and mechanical systems to maintain optimal performance. You'll serve as the trusted point of contact for both internal engineering teams and external partners, ensuring seamless communication flows during normal operations and critical events alike.

When emergencies strike, you'll step into a coordination role that demands clarity under pressure. You'll facilitate recovery efforts during Large Scale Events and Critical Site Events, bringing together the right people with the right information at the right time. Your post-mortem contributions will turn incidents into insights, strengthening the entire operation with every lesson learned.

Beyond reactive response, you'll be a builder. You'll help develop communication and escalation protocols that sharpen team performance, and contribute to creating tools that make the entire FOC more effective. Your meticulous record-keeping will ensure continuity across shifts and provide the data foundation for continuous improvement.

This is shift work in a 24/7 environment — weekends and holidays included — because the infrastructure never sleeps, and neither does your commitment to the customer experience. Every shift you complete is another layer of reliability added to the systems that Australia's most critical operations depend upon.

A day in the life
Your day begins with a handover that's more than a formality — it's a transfer of situational awareness. You absorb the state of play across the entire facility ecosystem: which systems are nominal, what's being watched, and where attention might be needed next.

Screens illuminate with real-time data from electrical and mechanical systems across the data centre fleet. You're reading the rhythm of the infrastructure — power distribution, cooling performance, environmental conditions — identifying patterns before they become problems. A temperature anomaly in one zone catches your eye; you investigate, correlate with recent maintenance activity, and determine it's within expected parameters. Documented. Noted. Moving on.

Mid-shift, an alert escalates. A critical system requires coordinated response. You activate the communication protocol you helped design, reaching the right engineers within minutes. As the facilitator, you're tracking actions, updating stakeholders, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks. The issue resolves cleanly — another testament to preparation meeting execution.

Between events, you're collaborating with peers on improving a monitoring dashboard, drafting a proposal for a new escalation pathway, or reviewing post-mortem findings from last week's incident. You're not just maintaining the status quo — you're actively raising the bar.

As your shift closes, you compile a comprehensive handover that gives the incoming team everything they need to maintain continuity. You leave knowing that your vigilance kept critical systems running, your coordination brought teams together, and your ideas are making the operation stronger every day.

About the team
About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

title: Sr. Data Engineer - Hybrid
description:
Sr Data Engineer - GE07BE

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

The Actuarial Engineering/Data Management Department’s Global Specialty team is seeking a skilled Sr. Data Engineer with a proven track record. The ideal candidate will use deep technical expertise and strong communication skills to deliver new initiatives while providing ongoing maintenance and support.

To excel in this role, you must be proficient in writing complex SQL transformations. You should also have experience in data analysis, requirements gathering, data modeling, and process design, with the ability to document and communicate technical details to business partners with varying levels of technical expertise.

This role will have a Hybrid work schedule, with the expectation of working in an office location (Hartford, CT; Chicago, IL; Columbus, OH; and Charlotte, NC) 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday).

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Support the legacy on-premises Oracle PL/SQL application until it is successfully migrated to the AWS Snowflake platform.
  • Lead the migration of the legacy system to Snowflake, including application design, data modeling, process flows, source-to-target mapping, coordination with external teams, code development, developer leadership, and results validation.
  • Ensure the new Snowflake application is designed for long-term maintainability and enhancement, with a clear code base that supports effective communication with business users.
  • Support the new Snowflake application and document support procedures.
  • Coordinate activities with cross-functional IT stakeholders.
  • Research and evaluate alternative solutions and recommend the most efficient and cost-effective approach for system design.
  • Translate business problems into logical solution designs, then develop, test, and implement efficient, cost-effective application solutions by writing new code, reusing existing code, or integrating purchased solutions.
  • Prepare charts, tables, and diagrams to support problem analysis using appropriate business, scientific, engineering, and mathematical techniques. Analyze existing systems and programming logic to improve operations, identify issues, and revise logic or procedures as needed.
  • Foster a positive work environment by modeling cultural values and encouraging collaboration, accountability, diversity, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications:

  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship. The company will not support the STEM OPT I-983 Training Plan endorsement for this position.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Data Science, Computer Science, or related discipline, or seven or more years of relevant IT experience.
  • Robust SQL experience: must be comfortable writing complex transformations.
  • Seven or more years of ETL/data integration experience.
  • Two or more years of Oracle PL/SQL experience.
  • Solid data warehouse knowledge in insurance, financial services, or a related domain.
  • Knowledge of data modeling and familiarity with dimensional database structures.
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills.
  • Proven ability to organize and manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Excellent facilitation, requirements elicitation, and data analysis skills.
  • Experience mentoring and leading other Data Engineers.
  • Continuous learning mindset: must be comfortable learning new languages, platforms and approaches as needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Python.
  • Experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, Nexus, and uDeploy.
  • Experience with AWS cloud technologies; certifications are a plus.
  • Experience with Snowflake databases.
  • Knowledge of Global Specialty insurance.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence; certifications are a plus.

title: Sr. Data Scientist - AI Research
description:
About Lyra Health

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About the Role:

Lyra is transforming mental health care by creating a frictionless experience for members, providers, and employers. We connect companies and their employees to mental health providers, therapy, and coaching programs that work.

We are looking for a self-driven, technical Data Scientist who cares about impact, ownership and innovation. In this role, you will work closely with Lyra’s Data, Product, Engineering, and Clinical teams on AI/ML initiatives that will enhance the experience of mental health patients and providers.

This Data Scientist role can be filled remotely anywhere within the US, as well as locally in our Burlingame, CA headquarters. Please note that remote-based candidates must be physically located within the United States.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with Lyra’s Data, Product, Engineering, and other associated teams to enhance the Lyra platform to serve the needs of our providers and clients.

  • Become an expert in the diverse data sources we collect and partner with data engineers to build pipelines that apply clinical logic to raw data

  • Extract actionable insights, develop predictive and generative models, and implement rigorous evaluation frameworks to support product iterations

  • Complete time-sensitive ad hoc data requests for internal and external stakeholders

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of data analysis in an industry setting with a preference for individuals who have experience in product analytics in the AI/ML space and have partnered with engineering and product teams in prior roles.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders across technical, business, and (ideally) clinical domains

  • Demonstrated understanding of statistical applications and methods (experimentation, probabilities, regression). Experience applying hypothesis testing in an industry or research setting.

  • Experience developing comprehensive analyses using irregular data from disparate sources. Willing to do whatever it takes to clean messy data prior to deriving insights.

  • Strong SQL proficiency. Experience writing complex queries with multiple schemas and tables. Preference for candidates who have experience creating views.

  • Graduate-level Statistics coursework with MS in a quantitative field is preferred (statistics, econometrics, biostatistics, quantitative social sciences).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Interest in public health a plus

  • Experience with AI/ML R&D, e.g. prompt engineering and RAG

  • Experience with Python, including cleaning and analyzing data as well as using Python to parse JSON structured data, call APIs, create user-defined functions, and automate.

over 100,000 units, employs over 2,800 people, owns its processes in-house, and is praised by Fortune

Magazine as the “Best Workplace for Women,” “Best Workplace for Millennials,” and “Best Workplaces

BH is passionate about setting the standard in the multifamily industry. We are a welcoming band of go-

Position Summary:
The Leasing Consultant is responsible for responding to inquiries/leads from prospective clients to identify potential renters, market, lease, and renew apartment leases in accordance with Company standards and Fair Housing guidelines and provide excellent customer service. Exhibits strong commitment to the service needs of the internal and external customers. Represents the company in a professional and courteous manner.

Essential Functions:

  • Responsible for ensuring the daily marketing, administrative, and financial operation of the property under the direction of the Community Manager.

  • Maintains a strong understanding of the community and local market competitor's specials and floor plans. Have comprehensive working knowledge of all aspects of leasing units and documents in accordance with Company standards and Fair Housing guidelines.

  • Processes lease application paperwork for the approval of the CM and prepares new lease contracts.

  • Inspects all target and/or show units in advance and in preparation of greeting and touring new prospects. Touring prospects may include, but is not limited to, vacant or model units and common/amenity areas of the property.

  • Inspect pre-leased apartments prior to the move-in date and promptly communicate any concerns to the Service Manager or Community Manager.

  • Understands, utilizes and promotes all third-party online leasing programs appropriately.

  • Ensure timely and accurate logging of all prospect information and notifications into our Property Management software.

  • Responsible for checking, responding to and documenting community and individual emails, voicemails, and text messages.

  • Stays up to date with all promotion/leasing incentives.

  • Assist with completing Move Out Vacant Inspection Checklist (MOVIC) accurately and within the specified deadline per Company standards.

  • Post notices to vacate and other community communication, if applicable.

  • Assist with daily community inspections to ensure community policies are being followed and addressing, if applicable.

  • Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications/Skills:

  • Previous experience in a customer-facing/customer service role

  • Demonstrated sales and closing skills

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills

  • Ability to work with a diverse group of people

  • Where required by law, must have state leasing license or ability to obtain the required license(s) within the timeframe required by law

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday (work schedule may vary depending on business needs).

Physical Requirements/Environment: The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
