title: CMM Programmer (1st Shift)
description:
About Us:

Drake is a high-tech manufacturing company based in Cypress, Texas. We proudly serve leading customers across aircraft, space, energy, semiconductor, defense, medical, and other highly regulated industries.

We work in a collaborative, supportive environment where employees are valued, empowered, and provided opportunities for hands-on learning and professional growth. At Drake, customers are our focus, and we build success together.


Position Summary:

The CMM Programmer supports Drake’s quality system by developing and maintaining CMM programs, performing dimensional inspections, and partnering with manufacturing to prevent defects and ensure product conformance. This position plays an important role in supporting reliable, repeatable manufacturing performance and timely product releases.

What Success Looks Like:

During your first year, you will:

  • Ensure product quality — Perform incoming, first-piece, in-process, and final inspections using drawings, specifications, GD&T, and precision measuring equipment.
  • Support production and QC releases — Partner with operators to resolve measurement and quality issues while supporting accurate and timely product releases.
  • Maintain quality and compliance — Document inspection results, identify nonconforming product, and maintain accurate, audit-ready records in accordance with AS9100D and QMS requirements.
  • Build technical expertise — Develop proficiency with inspection equipment, support calibration activities, and progress toward programming automated inspection equipment.
  • Drive accuracy and customer satisfaction — Take ownership of inspection activities, consistently meet quality expectations, and help ensure conforming products are delivered to customers on time.

What We’re Looking For:

The ideal candidate will bring:

  • Experience programming and operating CMM equipment.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional inspection and precision measurement.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and GD&T.
  • Experience using precision measuring equipment and inspection tools.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering.
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to train and support others.
  • Experience in precision manufacturing, aerospace, medical, or another highly regulated environment is preferred.

Work Environment / Schedule: (as applicable):

title: Quality Control VT Level II
description:
Job Summary:

The Quality Control Visual Inspector is responsible for the visual inspection and verification of mechanical, piping, and welding-related installation activities. This role primarily supports high-purity industrial projects, such as semiconductor tool hookups and cleanroom piping, ensuring all work complies with strict ASME piping codes and customer-specific requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Conduct thorough visual testing (VT) of welded, brazed, and mechanical joints (including Victaulic, flanges, and fittings) to ensure structural and functional integrity.

  • Verify pipe fit-up, alignment, cleanliness, and overall workmanship for high-purity process piping, clean utilities, and HVAC mechanical systems.

  • Ensure all installations comply with project specifications, semiconductor customer standards, and applicable ASME piping codes (e.g., B31.3, B31.9).

  • Review and maintain critical fabrication and installation logs, including weld maps, fit-up logs, brazing logs, and torque records.

  • Identify nonconforming workmanship and initiate Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) via construction management platforms such as OpenSpace.

  • Participate in pressure tests, system walkdowns, punch-list inspections, and pre-turnover verification.

  • Perform inspections on material and equipment site deliveries to verify they meet order specifications.

  • This position does not qualify welders or brazers, approve WPS/PQR, serve as CWI of record, or approve repairs or deviations.

  • Other responsibilities as directed by the supervisor.

Position Requirements (Work Experience, Skills, Licenses, etc.):

  • Ability to read and interpret Isometrics, P&IDs, shop drawings, and technical inspection reports.
  • Comprehensive working knowledge of weld and braze acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with mechanical piping systems and semiconductor cleanliness standards.
  • Ability to identify, analyze, and solve problems in support of organizational objectives.

  • Strong team player, approachable, and shares information effectively to achieve common goals.

  • Proactive approach to recognizing necessary tasks and accomplishing them with minimal supervision

Education and Experience:

Required:

  • Current ASNT VT Level II certification.

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • 3+ years of experience in construction or fabrication quality control

  • 1–2 years' experience in cleanroom piping, process utilities, or high-purity/semiconductor projects.

  • Ability to meet business Standard Written Practice and Examination requirements and obtain approval.

Desired:

  • Proficiency in using construction management platforms such as OpenSpace for documentation.

ACCO Competencies:

  • Proactivity/Initiative: Recognizes what needs to be done and accomplishes it in a manner appropriate for one’s level/position and with minimal supervision.

  • Perseverance: Shows wherewithal to fight for difficult goals despite challenges and to bounce back from adversity.

  • Motivation/Dedication: Commits to excellence in pursuing unselfish goals. Initiates action with collective goals, takes responsibility, and shows personal humility.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is seeking a Hardware Test Engineer to join the System Integration & Test (SEIT) team in Cincinnati, OH. This position will be 100% on-site.

  • Develop hardware test requirements and detailed integration test plans, procedures, readiness reviews (TRRs), test data, and reports.

  • Data Analysis of test data, identify anomalies, perform root cause analysis, and generate comprehensive test reports.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM discipline from an accredited university with 2 years of related test experience, or a Master's Degree in a STEM discipline from an accredited university.
  • Experience authoring hardware test procedures and ensuring data integrity and cataloging under general supervision.
  • Experience with hardware test execution, diagnostics, and formal requirement decomposition with traceability and verification under general supervision.
  • Working knowledge of standard test equipment: RF Power Meters, Frequency Generators, Network Analyzers, Spectrum Analyzers, Oscilloscopes, Waveform Generators, Synthesizers, Digitizers, and/or Signal Analyzers.
  • Proficient in at least one of the following software packages used in hardware testing: LabVIEW, MATLAB, and Python and/or have experience with test interfaces such as: Ehternet TCP/IP, USB, GPIB, RS-232, RS-422, etc.
  • Active US Government Secret Level security clearance or ability to obtain one.

  • Ability to work 100% onsite is required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to apply problem solving skills to provide technical hardware solutions to complex engineering test cases.
  • Experience creating automated test scripts that integrate with hardware interfaces.
  • Experience working with operational hazards such as overhead lifting, Thermal Chambers, and Vibration Test systems
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple, shifting priorities while maintaining safety standards.
  • Demonstrated leadership of System Test efforts in a dynamic work environment.
  • Experience with COMSEC material management.
  • Experience engaging external customers through meetings, presentations, and technical negotiations.
  • Active US Government Top Secret Level security clearance.

title: Senior Analyst - Special Assets
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and relationship-oriented Senior Analyst – Special Assets to join our team. This role is responsible for the delinquency management, servicing, and resolution of loans across the full life cycle, with a strong focus on real estate–secured agricultural lending loan servicing.

The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of loan origination through payoff, including closing, servicing, modifications, defaults, and resolutions. This position evaluates and underwrites servicing and credit requests, develops well-supported recommendations, and delivers practical, relationship-based solutions aligned with borrower, investor, and regulatory requirements.

While this role primary includes management of delinquent and problem assets, it is also focused on servicing strategy, credit analysis, and life-of-loan risk management. This role serves as a subject matter expert in loan servicing, real estate–secured credit, and special asset resolution, contributing to the overall strength and integrity of the servicing portfolio.

The People You Will Work With

The position will report directly to the Manager - Servicing and will directly work with members of the Operations, Accounting, Farm and Ranch Credit, and Legal departments. In addition, the position will liaison with external stakeholders including Seller Banks, borrowers, outside legal counsel, investors, and other counterparties.

Where and When You Will Work

Farmer Mac embraces a Presence with Purpose work environment, which allows for flexibility of work location while providing the opportunity for teams to come together in the office with purpose. The position will be based in Farmer Mac’s Washington, D.C. headquarters, the Johnston, Iowa office, or working remotely within the contiguous United States. Core business hours are Monday through Friday 8:00 am to 5:00 p.m. Central. Work outside of core hours may be required for planned and unplanned activities to complete time sensitive projects or to attend off-site meetings or events.

Primary Responsibilities and Duties

Loan Servicing & Special Asset Management

  • Oversee higher risk and non-performing assets, coordinating with Legal and other internal and external stakeholders as needed to deliver a resolution
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for agricultural real estate secured loan servicing matters, including interpretation of loan documents, mortgages, and related collateral.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to develop practical servicing and resolution strategies that balance credit risk, borrower relationships, and investor requirements.

Servicing Analysis, Recommendation, and Processing

  • Analyze, identify, request, and evaluate required borrower, property, and financial information to support servicing actions.
  • Clearly communicate servicing decisions, terms, and conditions to internal partners and external stakeholders.
  • Generate, review, and execute action-specific documentation and ensure accurate system updates to reflect approved servicing actions.
  • Ensure all servicing activities, documentation, and decisions comply with regulatory requirements, investor guidelines, and internal policies.

Risk & Portfolio Support

  • Act as a subject matter expert in loan servicing and special asset management, contributing to policy development and process improvements.
  • Provide strategic insight into emerging servicing and portfolio risks related to real estate and agricultural loan portfolios.
  • Support training initiatives and knowledge-sharing efforts focused on servicing best practices and life-of-loan considerations.

Desired Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
  • Solid understanding of real estate–secured lending and agricultural loan servicing, including regulatory and investor considerations.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with a borrower-focused approach.
  • Experience working with loan servicing systems and financial analysis tools.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the full loan life cycle, from origination and closing through servicing, modification, and payoff or resolution.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain servicing decisions clearly and professionally.
  • High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism in handling sensitive borrower information.
  • Collaborative team player with the ability to work independently and contribute to team success.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Finance, Accounting, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the role.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in agriculture and business finance, with demonstrated knowledge of credit risk and loan servicing.

Our compensation philosophy is targeted pay positioning relative to peers, our industry, and external markets. Farmer Mac is committed to a compensation program that will enable the organization to attract, motivate, reward, and retain highly skilled and creative talent to maintain sustained long-term performance and achieve the organization’s strategic business objectives. The typical starting salary range for this position is between $75,000 - $95,000, although wages can vary based on experience and geography, plus performance-based bonus and equity-based awards. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience.

title: UAC Analyst - Mid
description:

We specialize in delivering integrated, high-impact solutions across cyber operations, enterprise resource management, and mission support services. Our culture emphasizes collaboration, accountability, and innovation - empowering our teams to deliver meaningful outcomes in complex, high-security environments.

Who We're Looking For (Position Overview)

The Mid-Level Data Analyst plays a key role in supporting the performance monitoring, reporting, and continuous improvement efforts of the IT Call Center program. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining analytical products, evaluating operational performance data, and delivering actionable insights that support service delivery, customer satisfaction, and data-driven decision-making. Working closely with program leadership, operations managers, and stakeholders, the Mid-Level Data Analyst helps ensure reporting accuracy, identifies performance trends, and supports strategic initiatives that drive operational excellence. The ideal candidate is an analytical problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, and is passionate about using information to improve business outcomes and customer experience.

What Your Day-To-Day Looks Like (Position Responsibilities)

As a Mid-Level Data Analyst, you will:
  • Collect, analyze, and validate operational data from ITSM platforms, telephony systems, workforce management tools, and other program data sources.
  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reports that provide visibility into call center performance, service levels, customer satisfaction, and operational trends.
  • Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics, identify trends and anomalies, and provide actionable recommendations to program leadership.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports, performance reviews, executive briefings, and customer-facing deliverables.
  • Conduct root cause analysis of performance gaps, SLA impacts, and operational challenges to support informed decision-making.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis, performance monitoring, and process optimization recommendations.
  • Develop and maintain data governance standards, reporting templates, data dictionaries, and analytical documentation to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency.
  • Partner with supervisors, team leads, and operations managers to validate data, resolve reporting discrepancies, and improve data quality.
  • Perform workforce management analysis, including staffing trends, schedule adherence, forecasting, and capacity planning.
  • Support operational reviews and customer briefings by presenting analytical findings and responding to stakeholder questions.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior analysts, sharing best practices and supporting professional development.
  • Maintain reporting configurations, data extraction processes, dashboards, and supporting analytical infrastructure.
  • Analyze quality assurance results, call monitoring data, and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities and support coaching initiatives.
  • Respond to stakeholder data requests with accurate, timely, and well-presented analytical products.

What You Need to Succeed (Minimum Requirements)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Administration, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operational reporting, or a related analytical role.
  • Experience independently developing and maintaining reports, dashboards, and analytical products for management, customer, or stakeholder audiences.
  • Experience designing and maintaining performance dashboards and data visualization products using Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting platforms.
  • Experience collecting, validating, analyzing, and presenting operational data to support performance monitoring and business decision-making.
  • Experience working within a service delivery, call center, help desk, or other SLA-driven operational environment.
  • Experience supporting federal government programs or working within a government contracting environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex data findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, advanced formulas, charting, and data analysis functions.
  • Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence and data visualization tools.
  • Experience using SQL or similar data querying languages to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or comparable ticketing and workflow management systems.
  • Knowledge of ITIL principles, service delivery metrics, SLA management, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Experience developing and maintaining data governance artifacts, including reporting standards, data dictionaries, process documentation, and quality controls.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and collaboration tools including Teams and SharePoint.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and deliverables with minimal supervision.
  • Experience performing trend analysis, root cause analysis, and developing data-driven recommendations to improve operational performance.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with program leadership, operational teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required customer security clearance.

Ideally, You Also Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.ITIL Foundation, ITIL 4, or higher IT service management certification.
  • Experience using Python, R, or similar tools for advanced data analysis, automation, and reporting.
  • Lean Six Sigma White Belt, Yellow Belt, Green Belt, or comparable process improvement certification.
  • certification or experience supporting projects, reporting initiatives, or analytical programs.
  • Experience working with enterprise data warehouses, ETL processes, or data integration tools.
  • Familiarity with federal IT governance and compliance frameworks, including FITARA, FedRAMP, and NIST.
  • Experience supporting quality assurance programs and incorporating customer satisfaction, call monitoring, and performance data into reporting frameworks.
  • Familiarity with workforce management platforms and call center performance analytics tools.

title: Clinical Supervisor- MCI
description:
Behavioral Health Network (BHN) is a leading statewide provider of behavioral health services and a Certified Great Place to Work. Since 1938, BHN has helped individuals, families, and communities thrive through compassionate, high-quality care and support. With deep roots in Western Massachusetts and a growing presence in communities throughout the state, we are currently seeking a Clinical Supervisor to join our Mobile Crisis Intervention (MCI) team and help advance our mission of empowering people to live healthier, more fulfilling lives.

What We Offer:

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Make a meaningful impact in the lives of individuals, families, and communities throughout Western Massachusetts.
  • Professional Growth – Access ongoing training, mentorship, career development, and advancement opportunities across one of the region's largest behavioral health organizations.
  • Supportive Team Culture – Join a collaborative workplace guided by our HEART values: Humanity, Empowerment, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork.
  • Stability & Opportunity – Build your career with a well-established organization serving Western Massachusetts since 1938.
  • Comprehensive Benefits – Generous PTO, 403(b), educational assistance, medical, dental, vision, employee assistance programs, and more.
  • Certified Great Place to Work – Work for an organization recognized for creating a positive and engaging employee experience.

What You Will Do:

  • Provide regularly scheduled, staff-centered individual clinical supervision and document supervision in accordance with BHN guidelines.
  • Guide clinicians in delivering timely, trauma-informed, culturally responsive crisis assessments, interventions, and stabilization services for adults, youth, and families.
  • Provide clinical consultation and oversight for high-acuity and high-risk situations, including risk assessment, safety planning, level-of-care decisions, and diversion from unnecessary emergency department or inpatient care.
  • Help clinicians establish professional-development goals, monitor progress, and connect them with training and resources that strengthen crisis-service competencies.
  • Assess clinicians' core competencies at onboarding and defined milestones, providing feedback and support that promotes growth toward independent practice.
  • Monitor caseloads, response and stabilization timeframes, schedules, productivity, documentation quality and timeliness, service utilization, and other performance expectations.
  • Review and sign required clinical documentation and support compliance with BHN, CBHC, MassHealth, payer, regulatory, HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, and ethical standards.
  • Provide crisis assessments, short-term stabilization interventions, care coordination, and other direct clinical services as assigned.
  • Collaborate with MCI team members, CBHC services, emergency departments, first responders, families, schools, providers, and community partners to coordinate care and safe transitions.
  • Participate in clinical consultation, program meetings, training, quality-improvement activities, and incident or risk-review processes while maintaining required licensure and continuing education.

Who You Are:

  • Master's or doctoral degree in Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, or another eligible behavioral health field required.
  • Current independent clinical license in Massachusetts, such as LICSW or LMHC, required.
  • Clinical experience in crisis services, mobile crisis intervention, emergency services, stabilization, or another high-acuity behavioral health setting required.
  • Strong clinical judgment and demonstrated skill in risk assessment, safety planning, crisis intervention, level-of-care determination, and care coordination.
  • Knowledge of CBHC, Mobile Crisis Intervention, MassHealth crisis-service models, medical necessity, and payer documentation expectations preferred.
  • Ability to coach clinicians, provide constructive feedback, and support professional growth and high-quality crisis practice.
  • Cultural responsiveness and the ability to work effectively with individuals and families from diverse backgrounds during complex and stressful situations.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, organization, collaboration, and technology skills, including proficiency with electronic health records, telehealth, email, and common office tools.

We Hire for HEART!

Since 1938, BHN has delivered high-quality, culturally responsive behavioral health care, building deep roots in Western Massachusetts while expanding our impact in communities throughout the state. Our core values—Humanity, Empowerment, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork—guide how we lead, serve, and support one another. If you’re ready to bring your skills and experience to a mission-driven organization where your work can make a meaningful difference, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Profit protection team member
description:
The opportunity

Constellation is looking for Casual Profit Protection Team Members to join our team at The O2 Arena in North Greenwich. If you're looking for a fast-paced role where no two days are the same, this is your opportunity to work behind the scenes at one of the world's most iconic entertainment venues. From world-class concerts and sporting events to comedy shows and live entertainment, you'll play a vital role in protecting business assets, supporting operational excellence, and helping deliver an exceptional experience for every event.

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Profit Protection & Systems Coordinator to support the delivery of secure, compliant, and efficient event operations. The role is responsible for maintaining PCI compliance, supporting payment and till systems, monitoring operational controls, identifying and investigating risks, and ensuring accurate stock and process management. Working closely with operational teams, you will help protect business assets, minimise losses, resolve technical issues, and drive continuous improvement while promoting compliance, operational excellence, and a positive team culture. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong analytical skills, a passion for problem-solving, and the ambition to develop within a Profit Protection and Systems function.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support PCI compliance and ensure payment devices (PEDs) remain secure, operational, and compliant.
  • Monitor operational controls, identify risks, and support loss prevention initiatives.
  • Analyse stock processes, investigate discrepancies, and contribute to improved stock accuracy and performance.
  • Monitor live event transactions, escalating unusual activity and supporting investigations where required.
  • Provide first-line support for tills, payment devices, and iPads to minimise operational disruption.
  • Ensure all event documentation, system checks, and control procedures are completed accurately and on time.
  • Work closely with operational managers to maintain compliance, improve efficiency, and support business performance.
  • Promote company standards, effective communication, and a positive, safe working environment.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and demonstrate readiness to take on increased responsibility within the Profit Protection and Systems function.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in Profit Protection, Loss Prevention, Retail Operations, or a similar operational support role.
  • Good understanding of PCI compliance, operational controls, and risk management.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify discrepancies, investigate issues, and recommend solutions.
  • Experience supporting payment systems, tills, handheld devices, or similar operational technology.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to work accurately in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Proactive approach to problem-solving with a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Comfortable working independently while contributing positively as part of a wider team.
  • Flexible and willing to work evenings, weekends, and event days as required.
  • A positive attitude, high level of integrity, and commitment to protecting company assets and maintaining compliance.

What We Offer

  • £15.53 per hour, availability 2–4 shifts per week, depending on the event schedule. Shift times vary based on event requirements and may include 10:00–17:00 or 15:00–22:00.
  • The opportunity to gain hands-on experience supporting high-profile, fast-paced live events.
  • A varied and dynamic role where no two days are the same.
  • The chance to make a real impact by protecting business assets, enhancing operational performance, and contributing to exceptional customer experiences.

  3. If you are not legally authorized to work in the U.S. and not eligible for a TN, this isn't the role.
  4. This is a do-er role, not a rotation through strategy decks. If you want a title, a manager ladder, and a narrowly defined scope — stop here.
  5. Ideal profile: new grad or ~0–2 years out, scary-smart, high agency, thrives in chaos. Not looking for a scaled-corp "ops analyst" who needs a playbook handed to them.

About the Role

Truss is a ~dozen-person YC fintech building banking and payments for construction. We move real money. The company still runs on a small set of people who catch whatever is on fire and finish it.

We already have a Head of Operations. This role is different. We're hiring a Founder's Associate / ops generalist — someone who sits close to the founder and the operating core of the company and makes hard, ambiguous work disappear. One week that might be diligence follow-ups and a partner packet. The next it might be cleaning a broken internal process, running a hiring loop, digging into funnel metrics, drafting something customers will actually read, or owning a weird project nobody else has bandwidth for.

You are not joining to "learn how startups work" from the sidelines. You are joining to ship work that matters in week one. The job is to be useful at everything: figure it out, drive it to done, leave the system better than you found it.

If you've only ever succeeded inside highly structured programs with clear owners and weekly OKRs written for you, this will feel uncomfortable. If you are the person friends call when something messy needs fixing — keep reading.

What You'll Actually Do

  • Be the net. When something important has no obvious owner, you pick it up. Tracking, chasing, deciding, closing. Partnerships die in inboxes; tickets die in backlogs; you don't let either happen on your watch.
  • Multiply the founder and Head of Ops. Turn vague asks into finished artifacts: research, memos, trackers, checklists, outreach, scheduling that actually results in outcomes, not calendar spam. Anticipate the next three steps.
  • Run real company ops work. Vendor follow-through, customer or partner admin, internal tooling hygiene, process docs that people actually use, light finance/people/ops support alongside the people who own those functions. Not pure EA work — operator work.
  • Build systems from zero. Spreadsheets → lightweight tools → something the team can run without you. Prefer boring reliability over pretty process theater.
  • Dig into numbers and write clearly. Funnel leaks, vendor costs, "why is this broken," competitive notes, internal briefs. You don't need to be a quant — you need to be rigorous and honest.
  • Use AI as a default lever. Draft, summarize, structure, automate the grunt work. We expect you to move faster because of tools, not hide behind them.
  • Wear whatever hat the week requires. Early-stage fintech is uneven. Some days are glamorous product energy. Most days are unglamorous follow-through. Both count.

What We're Looking For

  • High agency is non-negotiable. You start things without being asked twice. You finish them. You update people before they chase you.
  • New grad or early career (0–2 years) is fine — preferred, even — if you have proof you operate like an owner. Campus orgs, startups, research projects, side businesses, military, family business, competitive teams: something where outcomes depended on you.
  • Evidence you can context-switch without dropping balls. Multiple workstreams, incomplete information, shifting priorities — and still deliver.
  • Strong written communication. Short, specific, no fluff. You can turn a messy thread into a crisp next-action list.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and regulated-ish reality. We are a real fintech (accounts, payments, compliance surfaces). You don't need to already know BSA/AML cold, but you can't freeze when the work is detailed and consequential.
  • Tooling fluency or fast ramp: Google Workspace, Notion/Linear-class tools, spreadsheets that don't embarrass you, modern AI tools daily.
  • Bias to systems over heroics. You'll hero when needed; you'll also leave a checklist so it doesn't need a hero next time.
  • Discretion. You'll see sensitive company, customer, and people information. That stays put.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. (or eligible for TN as a Canadian citizen). Remote OK within the U.S.; Austin is a plus.

This Is Not the Role If

  • You want a narrow "strategy & ops" seat with no execution.
  • You need a manager to define your week every Monday.
  • Your strongest stories are coursework only, with no ownership outside a syllabus.
  • You're optimizing for brand-name logos and a rotational program aesthetic.
  • You flinch at unglamorous work (chasing a vendor, fixing a sheet, sitting in a messy process until it's clean).

Bonus Points

  • You've worked at or interned at an early-stage startup (messy > prestigious)
  • You've been a founder, co-founder, or the "do everything" early hire somewhere small
  • Construction, fintech, payments, SMB, or other real-economy domain exposure
  • You've run recruiting loops, events, partnerships, or customer ops end-to-end
  • Quantitative coursework or proof you can analyze data without hand-holding
  • You're in Austin (or want to be) and excited about a possible local footprint; or happy to spend time in the SF office when it helps
  • You've used AI to build small internal tools, agents, or automations — not just chat prompts

What We Offer

  • $70,000 – $90,000 base and 0.08% – 0.20% equity (early-company ownership; we can discuss cash vs. equity mix for the right person)
  • Direct exposure to the founder and the real operating problems of a regulated fintech — not a shadow program
  • A small, sharp team where your output is visible immediately
  • Scope that grows as fast as you do: this role can become the spine of chief-of-staff / business ops / special projects as the company scales
  • Remote-friendly setup; SF office today; possible Austin office
  • The boring stuff: medical/dental/vision, 401(k), reasonable PTO, equipment, the usual

How to Apply

Send us:

  1. Your resume and LinkedIn.
  2. A short note — half a page is plenty — covering:
    • the messiest thing you've owned end-to-end (what it was, what you did, what changed)
    • a time you operated without a playbook
    • why Truss / why this kind of role (be specific — generic "passionate about fintech" will not help you)
  3. Optional but high signal: a work sample (tracker, memo, analysis, side-project writeup, automation). Redact anything confidential.

If your application reads like it was written by ChatGPT to sound impressive, we'll know. Be specific. Name the work.

About the Interview

  • Short founder screen (fit, agency, communication)
  • Working session on a real, lightweight ops / prioritization / analysis problem — bring a clear brain, not a deck
  • Conversation with Head of Ops and/or teammates you'd support day to day
  • Reference check (someone who watched you own something messy)

About Truss

Truss is a YC-backed (S21), fast-growing fintech — an all-in-one banking and payment automation platform for construction businesses. With Truss, construction companies manage bill payments, receivables, and corporate cards in one place, and automate the billing cycle from invoicing through reconciliation.

We started by building a B2B payment platform in Canada called MazumaGo — and discovered most of our customers were construction companies. We took what we learned and built a U.S. banking and payments engine purpose-built for SMB construction, with a built-in network effect. Soft-launched beta in 2023, fully launched in 2024, growing fast since.

Construction still runs on slow payments, paper checks, and fees that punish small businesses. We fix that with real accounts, instant ledgering, and money movement that has to be right. That's why operators who can actually finish hard work matter here.

A note from the founder: I'm a technical founder. We hired a Head of Ops so the company has a real operating backbone — and I still need another pair of high-agency hands on the unpredictable pile: special projects, follow-through, analysis, and the random critical path items that don't fit a neat job description. I want a sharp early-career generalist who makes problems smaller every week. Remote is fine. Austin is great if that's home. We have SF today and may build more presence in Austin. If you want maximum learning through maximum ownership, I'd love to talk.

title: Senior ServiceNow Platform Engineer, AI and Automation
description:
Short Description

Responsible for building high-quality, innovative and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards and technical design. Design, modify, develop, write and implement software programming applications. Support and/or install software applications. Key participant in the testing process through test review and analysis, test witnessing and certification of software.

Work Modality: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 days work from home)

Location: Guadalajara, Jalisco.

Description

Position Summary

The Senior ServiceNow Platform Engineer, AI and Automation will design, build, test, and operationalize secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions on the ServiceNow platform.

This role will serve as a senior technical contributor for ServiceNow development, AI-enabled workflows, orchestration, integrations, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and automated testing. The individual will help establish the engineering patterns, reusable capabilities, and technical guardrails required to scale the platform responsibly across the enterprise.

A central focus of the role will be leading ServiceNow-based artificial-intelligence and automation efforts. This includes evaluating practical use cases, designing agentic and orchestrated workflows, integrating ServiceNow with enterprise systems, and ensuring that automation improves the user experience without introducing unnecessary complexity, unmanaged risk, or technical debt.

The successful candidate will combine technical depth with a value-engineering mindset. The role is not limited to delivering code. It requires an ability to understand the underlying business problem, develop the appropriate solution, instrument the capability, and verify that the intended outcome was realized.

Qualifications and Competencies

Core Responsibilities

ServiceNow Engineering and Solution Development

  • Design, configure, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality ServiceNow solutions.
  • Translate business needs into secure, scalable, supportable, and reusable technical designs.
  • Develop applications, workflows, integrations, scripts, APIs, reusable components, and platform capabilities using established engineering standards.
  • Evaluate feasibility by analyzing requirements, data flows, system interactions, dependencies, constraints, and proposed solutions.
  • Define application interfaces, system responsibilities, deployment patterns, and nonfunctional requirements.
  • Document solution designs, technical decisions, support models, operating procedures, and reusable engineering patterns.
  • Partner with platform architects, product managers, administrators, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that solutions align to enterprise standards.

AI Orchestration and Intelligent Automation

  • Lead the engineering of ServiceNow-based AI, automation, and orchestration capabilities.
  • Identify and develop practical AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, accelerate response, and simplify the user experience.
  • Design solutions that responsibly combine ServiceNow platform capabilities, AI services, enterprise data, integrations, APIs, and workflow automation.
  • Evaluate agentic and human-in-the-loop patterns to determine where automation can safely act, where human approval is required, and where additional governance is necessary.
  • Develop technical guardrails for security, privacy, auditability, explainability, reliability, and operational support.
  • Ensure that AI-enabled solutions are designed around clearly defined business problems rather than novelty alone.
  • Measure whether AI and automation capabilities reduce friction, improve outcomes, and create sustainable value.

Integrations, APIs, and Enterprise Connectivity

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems.
  • Build and support REST-based integrations, web services, IntegrationHub spokes, APIs, data exchanges, and event-driven workflows.
  • Apply secure integration patterns, authentication standards, error handling, monitoring, logging, and recovery mechanisms.
  • Partner with enterprise integration teams to align ServiceNow connectivity with broader architectural standards.
  • Improve reuse by establishing common integration patterns, documentation, and technical accelerators.
  • Ensure that integrations are observable, supportable, and designed to minimize avoidable operational overhead.

CI/CD, Automated Testing, and Built-In Quality

  • Advance modern engineering practices across the ServiceNow platform, including source control, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, code reviews, release governance, and deployment traceability.
  • Expand automated testing coverage using appropriate platform and enterprise testing tools.
  • Embed quality controls into the development lifecycle rather than relying on late-stage validation.
  • Establish reusable testing patterns for workflows, integrations, applications, upgrades, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Improve release confidence, deployment velocity, defect prevention, and recovery readiness.
  • Contribute to technical standards for coding, configuration, documentation, peer review, testing, and production support.
  • Reduce technical debt by promoting maintainable, upgrade-resilient, and out-of-the-box-first design principles.

Customer Value Engineering and Telemetry-First Design

  • Treat value realization as an engineering requirement.
  • Partner with product managers and stakeholders to define a value hypothesis for significant development initiatives.
  • Design telemetry into solutions so that adoption, performance, quality, friction, and business outcomes can be measured after release.
  • Evaluate success using measurable indicators such as time saved, automation rates, reduction in manual touchpoints, cycle-time improvement, reduced defects, reduced risk, and user adoption.
  • Apply cognitive hospitality principles by creating workflows that reduce unnecessary cognitive load and make the next action clear.
  • Identify opportunities to remove avoidable steps, reduce swivel-chair activity, and simplify user interactions.
  • Use operational data and user feedback to continuously improve released capabilities.

Platform Engineering Leadership

  • Serve as a senior technical contributor and trusted advisor for ServiceNow engineering decisions.
  • Recommend modern tools, development practices, reusable patterns, and architectural improvements.
  • Mentor team members and promote disciplined engineering habits.
  • Provide technical guidance for complex platform initiatives while supporting decentralized decision-making.
  • Participate in sprint planning, refinement, technical reviews, retrospectives, architecture discussions, and continuous-improvement activities.
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow platform capabilities, AI developments, integration patterns, testing practices, and emerging enterprise technologies.

Required Qualifications

  • College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise software solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of software-development lifecycle practices, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Experience with APIs, integrations, secure development, source control, testing, and release processes.
  • Experience communicating with users, technical teams, and management to define requirements, identify tasks, estimate effort, and deliver production-ready solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to balance speed, quality, security, maintainability, and business value.
  • Experience developing on the ServiceNow platform using JavaScript, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST APIs, Script Includes, Business Rules, UI Builder, Service Portal, scoped applications, and platform configuration tools.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow AI capabilities, Now Assist, generative AI, virtual agents, agentic workflows, AI orchestration, machine learning, or comparable enterprise AI technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF), source control, CI/CD pipelines, update-set governance, application repositories, and release automation.
  • Experience integrating ServiceNow with enterprise systems using REST, web services, middleware, event-driven patterns, or integration platforms
  • Experience designing secure solutions with appropriate access controls, auditability, observability, and data-protection safeguards.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer, implementation certification, or comparable technical credentials.
  • Experience with DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, and reusable engineering patterns.

Indicators of Success

Success in this role will be demonstrated through measurable improvement in:

  • Delivery velocity and release predictability.
  • Automated testing coverage and deployment confidence.
  • Defect prevention, production stability, and recovery readiness.
  • Reuse of engineering patterns, integrations, and technical accelerators.
  • Reduction in manual work through effective automation.
  • Adoption and realized value of AI-enabled ServiceNow capabilities.
  • Reduction in user friction and unnecessary process complexity.
  • Upgrade resilience and reduction of avoidable technical debt.
  • Tangible business value created through time savings, quality improvements, risk reduction, and increased platform leverage.

title: Professional Engineer
description:
Position Summary

Hollingsworth Pack has an immediate opening for a licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.) to serve as the engineer in responsible charge for our Inspections & Testing team. This individual is the technical authority for the team’s inspection and certification work — setting the standards the work is performed to, supervising the inspectors who perform it, and sealing the deliverables that go out the door.

We are open to both full-time and part-time arrangements and will tailor the role to the right candidate. Because responsible charge requires meaningful supervisory involvement, this individual must be able to physically visit our active and prior jobsites throughout Central Texas on a regular basis. Candidates may reside anywhere within reasonable reach of that area.


Key Responsibilities

The core of this role is exercising responsible charge over our inspection and certification work, including:

  • Foundation Repair Project Certifications — supervising, reviewing, and sealing certification documentation.
  • Below-Slab Plumbing Tunnel Reviews — evaluating the structural conditions and components associated with plumbing tunnel work.
  • Structural Assessments — directing and reviewing structural assessment reports for accuracy, completeness, and code compliance.

Additional responsibilities include:

  • Establish and maintain the technical criteria, inspection procedures, and report standards the field team works to.
  • Train, direct, and evaluate inspectors, technicians, and junior engineering staff.
  • Personally observe a representative portion of field work at active projects in the San Antonio and Austin areas.
  • Provide P.E. review and seal on inspection reports, certifications, and related deliverables, with full authority to reject deliverables, require re-inspection, or decline to seal.
  • Ensure quality control, accuracy, and code compliance across all inspection and testing documentation.
  • Support the growth of the San Antonio office through strong client relationships and dependable service.
  • Provide occasional expert testimony, deposition support, or litigation-related consultation on prior projects.


Required Qualifications

  • Active Texas Professional Engineer (P.E.) license.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering (or a related field) from an ABET-accredited program.
  • Willingness and ability to exercise independent professional judgment and maintain responsible charge over work performed by the field team.
  • Working knowledge of the IBC and IRC, ACI, and related codes and standards.
  • Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel to and access active construction sites throughout Central Texas.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and close attention to detail.

We do not require a minimum number of years of experience. A newly licensed P.E. who is willing to learn this work and take genuine ownership of it will be given the training and support to do so.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in residential foundation evaluation, forensic engineering, or construction inspection.
  • Familiarity with the Texas Section ASCE Guidelines for the Evaluation and Repair of Residential Foundations.
  • Working knowledge of PTI DC10.5 (post-tensioned slab-on-ground), ACI 318, and ACI 332.
  • Understanding of expansive clay soils and soil-structure interaction as they affect Central Texas foundations.
  • Familiarity with common repair methods — pressed pilings, drilled piers, and helical piers.
  • Experience with floor elevation survey methods and the interpretation of elevation data.
  • Prior experience leading a structural, forensic, or inspection team.


Physical Requirements

This role involves regular field work. With or without reasonable accommodation, the position requires the ability to:

  • Walk active construction sites with uneven or unstable footing.
  • Work outdoors in Central Texas summer heat and in unconditioned interior spaces.
  • Lift and carry field equipment of approximately 25 pounds.


What We Offer

  • Compensation of $50–$70 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.
  • Full-time or part-time employment, with flexible hours to fit the right candidate.
  • Firm-provided professional liability (E&O) coverage. You are backed by the firm, not exposed on your own.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance [full-time employees].
  • Paid time off and holidays [full-time employees].
  • Professional development, licensure fees, and continuing-education support.
  • Mileage and travel reimbursement for site visits.


About Hollingsworth Pack

Hollingsworth Pack is a small business with more than 25 years of experience providing professional consulting services in the construction industry. Our clients range from private individuals and homeowners to U.S. and foreign corporations, the U.S. Federal Government, the U.S. Military, local governments, and other A/E firms. That range of work builds our knowledge base and sharpens the quality of service we deliver on every project, large or small.


Our San Antonio Inspections & Testing team started in 2016 and has grown to 14 members, including 7 full-time inspectors. Our core businesses are the inspection and certification of foundation repair projects, below-slab plumbing tunnel reviews, structural assessments, and GPR scanning services. title: Osastonsihteeri
description:
Kiinnostaako innostava ja merkityksellinen työ monipuolisten sihteerin työtehtävien ja asiakaskohtaamisen parissa? Oletko alan konkari tai työstä kiinnostunut oppija? Olemme osaajia monenlaisilla koulutus- sekä työkokemustaustoilla erilaisilta ammattialoilta.

Haussa on osastonsihteerin tehtävämme Porvoon sairaala-alueelle päivätyöhön toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen ja määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen ajalle 1.9.2026–26.4.2027.

Päivätyö sijoittuu meillä pääsääntöisesti vastaanotoille ja osastoille. Olemme moniosaajia työskennellessämme useissa yksiköissä ja toimiessamme vaihtuvissa tilanteissa useiden työtehtävien parissa. Toimintaamme on koko HUS-alueella, kuten Helsingissä, Espoossa ja Vantaalla.

Osastonsihteereinä toimimme osana moniammatillista yhteistyötä, tuemme keskeytymätöntä potilaan hoitoketjua sekä tarjoamme parasta asiakaskohtaamista. Tarjoammekin sinulle vastuulliset ja monipuoliset työtehtävät, ja keskeisiin työtehtäviisi kuuluvat potilaiden sisään- ja uloskirjaukset, hoidon ajanvaraukset, tutkimustilaukset, asiakirjojen käsittely ja läheteliikenne sekä asiakaskohtaaminen ja monikanavainen asiakaspalvelu.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden mielenkiintoiseen ja monipuoliseen itsenäiseen työhön sekä työuran rakentamiseen. Kasvatamme tekijöistämme ammattilaisia potilaan parhaaksi, ja pääset laajentamaan vastuualueitasi työssäsi sekä kehittämään itseäsi koulutuksissa, joita tarjoamme työntekijöillemme.

Pääset osallistumaan toimintamme, yhteisömme ja osaamisesi kehittämiseen sekä huolehdimme työntekijöidemme hyvinvoinnista. Käytössämme on myös yhteisöllinen työvuorosuunnittelu eli pääset vaikuttamaan omiin työvuoroihisi. Tiimityöskentelijä, liity moniosaavaan joukkoomme, jossa arvostamme toisiamme ja teemme yhdessä merkityksellistä, vastuullista ja potilaslähtöistä työtä joka päivä.

Toivomme sinulta kykyä työskennellä moniammatillisesti, hyvää kokonaisuuksien hallintaa sekä taitoa kohdata potilaat parhaalla asiakaspalveluotteella. Olet etsimämme henkilö, mikäli olet lisäksi oma-aloitteinen ja omaksut nopeasti uusia asioita. Tehtävän menestyksekäs hoitaminen edellyttää paineensietokykyä ja tarkkuutta, hyviä organisointi- ja priorisointitaitoja sekä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia eri tietojärjestelmien käyttöön työssäsi.

Arvostamme kiinnostusta alaa ja jatkuvaa kehittymistä kohtaan. Lisäksi arvostamme erikoissairaanhoidon tuntemusta, aikaisempaa kokemusta osastonsihteerin työstä, Apotin järjestelmäosaamista sekä aiempaa asiakaspalvelukokemusta.

Tutustu työhön ja työntekijöihimme ja liity osaavaan ja vauhdikkaaseen joukkoomme HUSin osastonsihteereihin.

Kiinnostuitko? Haethan tehtävään viimeistään hakuajan loppuun mennessä. Voimme aloittaa haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Määräaikaisen tehtävän täytämme heti sopivan henkilön löytyessä. Palkkaus ja työsuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Sote-sopimuksen mukaan, ja käytössämme on koeaika. Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2 725,5 €/kk.

HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Soveltuva toisen asteen koulutus ja soveltuva kokemus.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

Yhteystiedot

Lisätietoja osastonsihteerin työstä yleisesti antaa palveluesihenkilömme Katja Konate, arkisin klo 9–11, puh. 040 193 6437.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Senior Director leads health system–level clinical service-line, data, and value-based strategy to help provider organizations achieve strategic growth, patient access, and economic objectives while expanding appropriate adoption of Medtronic therapies. This role partners closely with Account Directors, Operating Units, Medical Affairs, and senior health-system executives to co-develop and scale service-line strategies that improve care delivery, expand access to the right therapy at the right time, and deliver measurable clinical and financial outcomes.

This leader manages and develops a team of Service Line Advisors and a Data Science team, ensuring the integrated deployment of clinical, strategic, and analytical capabilities. The role is accountable not only for strategy design, but also for disciplined execution, clear value demonstration, and scaling successful models across priority health-system accounts.

• Lead, develop, and mentor a team of Service Line Advisors and Data Science professionals to deliver integrated, high-impact engagements that drive growth, access, and economic value.
• Serve as a senior strategic partner to account leadership teams and health-system executives, aligning Medtronic capabilities to provider strategic, clinical, and financial priorities.
• Shape and articulate Medtronic’s service-line and clinical value propositions, linking therapy adoption to patient access, outcomes, and sustainable economics.
• Guide the design and execution of service-line strategies, clinical collaborations, and performance-improvement initiatives tailored to health-system needs.
• Engage and influence executive, physician, and service-line leaders to co-create differentiated partnership models and innovative go-to-market approaches.
• Provide executive oversight for complex, cross-functional initiatives, ensuring quality, rigor, and alignment across clinical, commercial, analytics, and medical partners.
• Translate clinical, operational, and analytical insights into clear, executive-ready economic and outcomes-based value narratives.
• Identify, formalize, and scale successful service-line strategies, engagement models, and economic frameworks across accounts.
• Apply consulting discipline to engagements, including scope definition, project management, quality assurance, and effective executive communication.

title: UAC Analyst - Junior

Our culture emphasizes collaboration, accountability, and innovation - empowering our teams to deliver meaningful outcomes in complex, high-security environments.

Who We're Looking For (Position Overview)

The Junior Data Analyst supports the delivery of high-quality IT Call Center services by transforming operational data into meaningful insights that drive performance, efficiency, and continuous improvement. Working alongside program leadership, supervisors, and senior analysts, this role collects, analyzes, and reports on program data to help monitor service delivery, identify trends, and support informed decision-making. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to grow their skills in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment while helping teams deliver exceptional support to government customers.

What Your Day-To-Day Looks Like (Position Responsibilities)

As a Junior Data Analyst, you will:
  • Collect, validate, and maintain operational data from call center systems, ITSM platforms, and workforce management tools.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and scorecards that provide visibility into key performance metrics, service levels, customer satisfaction, and operational trends.
  • Monitor performance data, identify trends and anomalies, and provide actionable insights to program leadership and stakeholders.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports, briefings, and customer-facing deliverables that support operational decision-making.

title: Campaign Marketer - USA
description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

Ottawa and Toronto, Canada - Hybrid

Other Canadian and USA locations - Remote

About the team

The Campaign Marketer develops and leads integrated account-based marketing strategies designed to drive engagement, pipeline creation, opportunity acceleration, and growth within Kinaxis' strategic and enterprise accounts. This role serves as the marketing lead for priority account programs, leveraging customer insights, account intelligence, market trends, and buying-group analysis to create highly targeted marketing strategies that align with sales priorities and business objectives.

The Campaign Marketer influences go-to-market strategy across priority segments, advises stakeholders on ABM best practices, and drives measurable business outcomes through data-driven marketing initiatives. The role collaborates across Sales, Solutions Marketing, Field Marketing, Creative, Content, and Revenue Operations teams to maximize account penetration and revenue impact.

What you will do

  • Develop and execute account-based marketing strategies for strategic and enterprise accounts that drive engagement, pipeline growth, and revenue outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales to identify priorities, build account plans, and align marketing investments to target account opportunities.
  • Design and orchestrate integrated 1:1 and 1:few marketing programs across multiple channels to support account acquisition, expansion, and opportunity acceleration.
  • Leverage account intelligence, engagement insights, and performance analytics to optimize strategy, improve account penetration, and maximize business impact.
  • Serve as the primary marketing advisor for assigned strategic account teams, providing expertise on account-based marketing best practices and tactics.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Sales to deliver coordinated account experiences and drive go-to-market objectives.
  • Manage demand requests for ad-hoc marketing requests and needs of the sales team to support account based selling initiatives and track and report on the key account metrics and outcomes of these efforts
  • Utilize marketing automation and CRM platforms to build, launch and track campaigns, manage lead nurturing workflows and measure campaign performance and ROI
  • Stay informed about industry trends, best practices and emerging technologies in campaign and ABM marketing, and recommend innovated approaches to drive results and differentiate the brand

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business or related field
  • 7+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including significant experience in account-based marketing (ABM), demand generation, integrated marketing, or revenue marketing.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing account-based marketing strategies that drive engagement, pipeline growth, opportunity acceleration, and revenue outcomes.
  • Experience partnering with Sales leaders and strategic account teams to develop account plans and aligned go-to-market strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage account intelligence, engagement data, and performance metrics to inform decisions and optimize results.
  • Experience using marketing automation, CRM, ABM, and sales enablement platforms (e.g., Salesforce, 6sense, LinkedIn, Highspot, or similar technologies).
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment across Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, and Revenue Operations teams.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to operate independently in a highly collaborative environment.

#Senior

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs, training, and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

title: Engineer/Principal Engineer Electronics - Communications (California)
description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems is looking to add an Engineer/Principal Engineer Electronics - Communications to join our team in San Diego, CA and will be primarily based within our office spaces to support the program and business needs. The candidate should be a self-starter with familiarity working in an Integrated Product Team construct.

A successful candidate will leverage extensive hands-on experience with Line of Sight (LOS) and Beyond Line of Sight (BLOS) communication systems, AESA (Active Electronically Scanned Array) and expertise in supporting test events, system verification, and troubleshooting to ensure successful integration and communication test outcomes:

Roles and Responsibilities will include:

  • Hands-on work with LOS and BLOS communication systems, including modems, up/down converters, and Active Electronically Scanned Array (AESA) antenna systems.

  • Providing direct user support, engineering expertise, and troubleshooting during test events.

  • Addressing and correcting deliverable subsystem performance concerns via program identified tools/systems on behalf of the Communications technical team.

  • Identifying opportunities for deliverable system improvement and working with engineering teams to implement in accordance with approved program processes.

  • Reporting Comms subsystem status to programmatic and technical team leadership and identifying risks/issues/concerns to prevent increased cost and/or schedule loss.

  • Develop architecture trade studies and work with the enterprise time to evaluate complex, technical decisions

  • Manage technical supplier base to ensure technical, schedule, and cost thresholds are being met

  • Manage and perform development risk reduction activities to ensure affordable and timely delivery of required technology

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility. There is no remote / hybrid / telework available for this position. Travel up to 25% may be required.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Education Experience Requirement:

    • Engineer (LV2): Bachelor's Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) discipline and 2 years of related engineering experience, OR a Master's Degree in a STEM and 0 years of related engineering experience

    • Principal Engineer (LV3): Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline and 5 years of related engineering experience; OR a Master’s degree in a STEM discipline and 3 years of related engineering experience; OR a PhD in a STEM discipline and 1 years of related engineering experience.

  • Strong understanding of RF signal chains and system-level integration of Communication components.

  • Experience in Communications system integration

  • Experience with modulation/demodulation and coding techniques as related to communications systems

  • Experience with RF and Network based test equipment to include oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and power meters

  • Active U.S. Government Top Secret SCI Security Clearance (with a background investigation within the past 5 years or enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).

  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) clearance, within a reasonable amount of time as determined by business needs

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Current applicable Special Access Program (SAP) clearance.

  • Networking Experience (Layer 2/3 Networking and training/certifications (Network+, Security+, CCNA, etc.)

  • Experience with RF performance assessment through link margin and antenna pattern analyses

  • Experience with supplier/subcontract management

  • Familiarity with common industry standards related to communications and network-based systems, such as MIL-STD-1553, RS-232/422, Ethernet (IPv4/IPv6)

Primary Level Salary Range: $91,800.00 - $137,600.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $114,000.00 - $171,000.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

  • Meet and exceed revenue targets set by the business

  • Drive sales and marketing efforts with various business units to execute sponsorship programs, including servicing of a significant and reputable client base

  • Liaise with key stakeholders and contacts from governments, tourism entities, councils, venue holders, media, sponsors and partners, as required.

Leadership

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration

Strategy, Reporting and Compliance

Are you a data-driven leader who wants to transform player behaviour into meaningful insights that shape the future of one of the world's most iconic MMORPGs?

As Lead Analyst on Old School RuneScape, you'll lead a team of analysts responsible for uncovering the insights that drive better player experiences, smarter product decisions, and long-term business success. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and senior leadership, you'll help shape the roadmap of Old School RuneScape by turning complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

This is a highly influential role where you'll combine technical expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to ensure data sits at the heart of decision-making across one of gaming's most successful live service titles.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Analysts, fostering a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and analytical excellence.

  • Develop deep knowledge of Old School RuneScape's gameplay systems, mechanics, and player behaviours to provide meaningful context to analysis.

  • Familiarity with modern data platforms and architectures such as AWS, Snowflake, and OLAP technologies.
  • Experience using data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
