title: Web/Multimedia Programmer
description:
Who We Are:

  • CAE Vision: Our vision is to be the worldwide partner of choice in defense and security, and civil aviation by revolutionizing our customers’ training and critical operations with digitally immersive solutions to elevate safety, efficiency and readiness.
  • CAE Defense & Security Mission: CAE's Defense and Security business unit focuses on helping prepare military customers to develop and maintain the highest levels of mission readiness.
  • CAE Values: Empowerment, Innovation, Excellence, Integrity and OneCAE make us who we are and we strive to make a difference in the world while helping each other succeed.

What We Have to Offer:

  • Comprehensive and competitive benefits package and flexibility that promotes work-life balance
  • A work environment where all employees are valued, respected and safe
  • Freedom to succeed by enabling team members to deliver, take initiatives and make decisions
  • Recognition, professional development, advancement and having fun!

Summary

The Web/Multimedia Programmer supports the development of training programs and courseware using established Instructional Systems Design (ISD) processes. This role produces interactive graphics, multimedia elements, animations, and web‑based content for aviation training courseware and related design assignments. The Web/Multimedia Programmer collaborates closely with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to ensure instructional materials are accurate, engaging, and instructionally sound. Responsibilities include developing course materials, conducting training needs assessments, maintaining traceability of courseware updates, supporting proposal efforts, and ensuring ISD compliance across extensive curricula. This position requires strong multimedia development capabilities, technical skill, and the ability to manage multiple tasks under strict timelines.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Coordinate with management to prioritize ISD tasks and training material development needs.
  • Assign tasks to technical representatives in alignment with project milestones and departmental priorities.
  • Coordinate with Configuration and Data Management (C&DM) to ensure traceability of courseware updates from contract startup through program completion.
  • Develop program‑specific procedures and work methods supporting ISD processes.
  • Establish and update processes for instructional design across comprehensive curriculum programs.
  • Coordinate with FTU leads and Mobility (MOB) points of contact to schedule SMEs for reviews and updates.
  • Develop and update Master Task Lists (MTLs), Master Training Task Lists (MTTLs), learning objective hierarchies, media reports, and course syllabi.
  • Develop and review course materials including instructional methods, objectives, scenarios, case studies, and assessment tools.
  • Support proposal activities by ensuring all ISD requirements meet customer specifications.
  • Maintain documentation traceability for all baseline and modified ISD products.
  • Perform ISD tasks in accordance with company policies, procedures, and work instructions.
  • Develop, prioritize, and manage ISD deliverables related to budget, schedule, and scope.
  • Conduct peer reviews to ensure courseware and multimedia meet established quality standards.
  • Consult with customers to support performance improvement strategies and instructional approaches.
  • Coordinate with TSSC management to confirm that instructional methods, sequencing, and design practices are followed.
  • Use industry‑standard software applications to format and prepare technical documents and multimedia materials.
  • Mentor team members on courseware design standards, document formatting, and multimedia development practices.
  • Promote a collaborative and positive work environment within the courseware development team.
  • Support teammates to maintain productivity and effective workflow.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, related discipline, or equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.
  • Minimum of five years of professional experience in instructional analysis, design, development, delivery, technical writing, or systematic curriculum development.
  • Due to U.S. Government contract requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for this role.

Preferred Skills

  • Intermediate proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite for multimedia development.
  • Intermediate proficiency in ActionScript 2/3, HTML, HTML5, and JavaScript.
  • Familiarity with MS Project.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Strong oral presentation skills and ability to present to management and customers.

title: Inventory & Master Data Governance Lead
description:
Enterprise Material Master Governance

Serve as the enterprise functional owner for Material Master governance within SAP S/4HANA.

Create, extend, maintain, block, archive, and retire Material Master records.

Establish and maintain enterprise Material Master standards, procedures, naming conventions, and governance policies.

Review Material Master requests for compliance with Company standards.

Prevent duplicate material creation and maintain data integrity.

Maintain material groups, units of measure, valuation classes, purchasing views, MRP views, warehouse views, accounting views, quality views, and other applicable SAP data.

Perform routine audits of Material Master records and coordinate corrective actions.

Support engineering changes, new product introductions, and product lifecycle management activities affecting Material Master data.

Coordinate Material Master governance activities across all business functions.

Inventory Planning & Management

Monitor inventory levels for direct and indirect materials.

Analyze inventory trends and recommend stocking strategies.

Maintain planning parameters including reorder points, safety stock, lot sizing, lead times, and planning strategies.

Optimize inventory investment while maintaining operational readiness.

Analyze inventory turnover, carrying costs, and material availability.

Develop recommendations to reduce obsolete, excess, and slow-moving inventory.

Support inventory optimization initiatives throughout the organization.

Material Requirements Planning (MRP)

Execute, monitor, and analyze Material Requirements Planning (MRP) recommendations.

Review MRP exception messages and coordinate resolution activities.

Maintain MRP master data and planning parameters.

Coordinate planning activities with Raw Materials Procurement, MRO Procurement, Production Planning, and Warehouse Operations.

Analyze material shortages and recommend corrective actions.

Support continuous improvement of planning processes.

Inventory Control

Support inventory accuracy across all warehouse and storage locations.

Coordinate cycle count programs and annual physical inventories.

Investigate inventory discrepancies and perform root cause analysis.

Recommend corrective and preventive actions.

Monitor inventory adjustments and transaction accuracy.

Support compliance with Company policies, SOX requirements, and internal and external audits.

Warehouse Operations Support

Support warehouse inventory transactions and inventory movement processes.

Maintain warehouse storage location master data.

Coordinate repairable inventory processes.

Support receiving, issuing, transfers, and inventory reconciliation activities.

Develop inventory control procedures supporting warehouse operations.

Partner with the Warehouse Supervisor to improve inventory accuracy and operational efficiency.

MRO Procurement Support

Create and maintain Material Master records supporting MRO inventory.

Support spare parts inventory planning.

Maintain repairable inventory records.

Support storeroom optimization initiatives.

Coordinate catalog standardization and inventory rationalization activities.

Raw Materials Procurement Support

Support Material Master creation and maintenance for direct production materials.

Maintain procurement-related master data for steel coils, strip steel, couplings, protectors, tubing, packaging materials, and other production materials.

Support planning parameters associated with production materials.

Coordinate Material Master activities supporting new suppliers and new production materials.

Production, Engineering & Maintenance Support

Coordinate Material Master activities supporting engineering changes.

Support Bills of Material (BOM) coordination as applicable.

Maintain planning parameters supporting manufacturing operations.

Support new product introduction activities.

Assist with material substitutions and engineering revisions.

SAP System Administration Support

Serve as the functional business owner for Material Master governance.

Participate in SAP S/4HANA enhancements, testing, validation, and upgrades affecting Material Master and inventory management.

Develop and maintain business procedures supporting SAP inventory and Material Master processes.

Support integration with SAP MM, PP, PM, QM, FI/CO, and future Warehouse Management capabilities.

Reporting & Analytics

Develop, maintain, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) including Material Master Accuracy, Inventory Accuracy, Inventory Turns, Dead Stock, Excess Inventory, Material Availability, Cycle Count Accuracy, MRP Exception Performance, Inventory Adjustments, Inventory Valuation, Material Creation Turnaround Time, and Data Quality Metrics.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve inventory management and Material Master governance.

Develop and maintain Supply Chain standard operating procedures.

Standardize inventory management processes.

Lead continuous improvement initiatives.

Train end users on inventory and Material Master processes.

title: Senior Product Designer (Up)
description:
About Ferocia

We're the team behind Up, but under the hood, we're Ferocia - a passionate tech company driven by financial inclusion. Since 2011, we've been crafting innovative financial tools, starting with the digital platform for Bendigo Bank. We believe technology can empower everyone, from the advantaged to the disadvantaged, which is why Up was born.

Now, as part of the Bendigo and Adelaide Bank family, we combine the agility of a small company with the reach and stability of a major player. Together, we're carbon neutral, community-focused, and dedicated to high standards of corporate governance. Our mission? To leverage technology to help Australians move from financial stress and anxiety to a place of confidence and empowerment.

Want to join us? We'd love to hear from you

The role

We're looking for 2 experienced Senior Product Designers to lead the work on our savings and home loan experiences. This is a rare opportunity to join a small team and have a real impact on people's lives by helping Australians build savings habits and feel in control of their home ownership journey.

Our designers wear many hats and own projects from start to finish — from idea to successfully shipped. Sometimes it's just a few days on a fun feature, sometimes it's months on a new financial product. So on a normal day, you could be:

  • Finding and exploring opportunities for every step of the user journey — whether it's reviewing user feedback, conducting interviews, analysing data, playing with a random idea, reinventing the wheel, refining existing concepts, or fixing tiny bugs.
  • Solving financial problems with a unique approach by focusing on how people feel and what's uniquely "Up". This takes real craftsmanship and attention to detail to make a simple feature feel like a game-changer (interactions, visuals and copy) and a genuine understanding of how people manage their money and use our app.
  • Building new financial products. This takes deep systems thinking to map complex interactions and dependencies and create a holistic experience across many touchpoints. You'll need to be comfortable with complex technical problems and know how to approach big projects strategically.
  • Working closely with our creative (Product, Design, Brand) and leadership teams to discuss ideas, review work in progress, help define our roadmap, and shape our long-term strategy. You’ll have to be comfortable designing concepts and interactive prototypes at various levels of fidelity to be able to clearly communicate your ideas to the right audience.
  • Collaborating with engineering teams to ship high-quality features to our users within our delivery timeframes — by helping scope, prioritise, review, and adapt concepts as necessary. As well as working with our Marketing and Support teams to ensure a great user experience at any touchpoint.

What we're looking for

  • Experience designing and delivering end to end projects (from idea to successfully launched) — with at least 5 years working with product teams (ideally on a SaaS or consumer product, and even better if it's in Fin-Tech), or within a digital agency.
  • Creativity and craftsmanship — strong interaction and visual skills, with a keen eye for detail to achieve visually pleasing aesthetics — from tiny micro-interactions, to complex multi-step experiences, and the ability to think outside of conventional approaches. We really pride ourselves in the way we present experiences and the emotional responses we seek from our users.
  • Problem solving skills and a strong product lens — the ability to understand customer needs, motivations and behaviours, and to know how to translate this understanding into product opportunities. Being able to think holistically about end to end experiences, and design solutions that fit into an ecosystem.
  • Collaboration and communication skills — the ability to articulate ideas effectively and provide sound reasoning for decisions, and to use storytelling to inform and influence.
  • Passion — harder to define, but we're looking for people who have a desire to push the limits, break the status quo, and be at the forefront of where technology is leading us. An eagerness to learn, expand your skills, and do the best work possible.
  • Technical knowledge, especially front-end, and a general understanding of an agile engineering development process.
  • Ability to work with a certain level of ambiguity, and "get shit done" autonomously — we operate like a start-up and things can often be messy, undefined, or change at the last minute. We're looking for someone who enjoys innovative fast paced work environments and tackling all sort of problems.

Interview process

More details will be provided on application, but all applicants will go through the same stages:

  1. Intro chat and career review with Sylvain (Head of Design) — 30min
  2. Presentation of 2-3 case studies to Sylvain (Head of Design) and 2 Product Design Leads, for a deep dive into your work and your design skills — 60min
  3. Interview with a cross-functional team (EM, Front-end developer, Product Designer) with a critique of an app of your choice, to understand how you think, and get a feel for what it would be like working together — 60min
  4. References check
  5. Offer!

When applying, make sure to attach a portfolio or provide a link to an online portfolio (including any needed passwords) to demonstrate your skills and some examples of work you’ve produced.

We are currently only hiring in Melbourne (or adjacent areas, including Bendigo) as we still value physically getting together in person.

title: Vastaava proviisori HUS Apteekki
description:
Tule meille HUS Apteekkiin, farmasian alan näköalapaikalle!

HUS Apteekin lääkitysturvallisuustiimi kehittää ja varmistaa lääkitysturvallisuutta HUSissa, Uudenmaan ja Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueilla sekä Helsingin kaupungilla yhteistyössä asiakkaiden ja muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Tiimi toimii keskeisessä roolissa turvallisen lääkehoidon varmistamisessa ja toimintatapojen kehittämisessä koko palvelualueella.

Lääkitysturvallisuustiimiin kuuluu lääkitysturvallisuuspäällikkö, vastaava proviisori, kaksi lääkitysturvallisuuskoordinaattoria, kolme alueellista lääkitysturvallisuusvastaavaa, osastokäynneistä vastaava farmaseutti sekä osastokäyntifarmaseutti.

Haemme nyt vastaavaa proviisoria vakituiseen tehtävään osaksi asiantuntevaa ja innostunutta tiimiämme.

Tehtävässä työskentelet vaativissa lääkitysturvallisuuden asiantuntija- ja kehittämistehtävissä. Vastaat Fimean edellyttämien osastokäyntien, lääkitysturvallisuusauditointien sekä asiakkaille suunnattujen ohjeiden ja koulutusten koordinoinnista ja kehittämisestä. Lisäksi osallistut lääkitysturvallisuuskäytäntöjen kehittämiseen yhteistyössä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattilaisten ja muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa.

Tehtävään voi sisältyä tiiminvetovastuuta sekä alueellisen lääkitysturvallisuusvastaavan tehtäviä Uudenmaan alueella. Valittavan henkilön osaamisprofiili huomioiden tehtäviin voidaan sisällyttää myös laatu-, opetus- ja tutkimustyötä.

Edellytämme valittavalta kokemusta lääkitysturvallisuustyöstä ja moniammatillisesta yhteistyöstä. Kokemus työskentelystä perusterveydenhuollossa ja sosiaalihuollossa sekä näytöt toiminnan kehittämisestä katsotaan eduksi. Menestyäksesi tehtävässä olet optimistinen, aloitteellinen, sinnikäs ja ratkaisukeskeinen asiantuntija. Toimit luontevasti yhteistyössä eri ammattiryhmien kanssa, viihdyt moniammatillisessa toimintaympäristössä ja haluat vaikuttaa lääkehoidon turvallisuuden kehittämiseen laajalla alueella.

Työsuhde alkaa 1.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Työaikamuoto on liukuva yleistyöaika. Noudatamme HUSin ohjeistusta hybridityöskentelystä, jossa edellytämme toistaiseksi 2-3 lähityöpäivää viikossa.

Vuosilomakertymä määräytyy työ- ja virkaehtosopimuksen (SOTE) mukaan (enimmillään 38 päivää/vuosi).

Palkkaus on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon henkilöstön työ- ja virkaehtosopimus (SOTE) mukainen. HUS Apteekin vastaavan proviisorin tehtäväkohtainen lähtöpalkka on 5803,89 eur/kk. Tehtäväkohtainen palkka määräytyy työn vaativuuden perusteella. Tämän lisäksi maksetaan kokemuslisä perustuen kokemukseen farmaseuttisissa työtehtävissä.

HUSilla on monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, kuten lounas-, liikunta-, kulttuuri-, hieronta- ja työmatkaetu sekä mahdollisuus työsuhdeasuntoihin. Lisäksi meillä on mahdollisuus monipuoliseen täydennyskoulutukseen.

Tule mukaan lääkitysturvallisuuden edelläkävijöiden joukkoomme!

Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä. HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

The Academy Lead – AI, Emerging Skills, Tech, Data & Online owns the end-to-end learning and capability pathways for colleagues AI, technology, data, and online functions. The role is accountable for ensuring learning is simple, accessible, commercially relevant and directly linked to business performance and organisational priorities.


Working closely with People Partners, functional leaders, SMEs and external partners, the Academy Lead identifies critical capability requirements, prioritises learning investment and ensures the academy delivers the skills needed to support Asda's transformation agenda, digital growth and adoption of future technologies. The role is focused on enabling capability and adoption of emerging technologies.


Key Accountabilities


Own the Capability Strategy & Pathways

  • Define and deliver the learning pathways required to support the business to effectively land technology transformation.

Drive Capability Development

  • Ensure critical capabilities are identified, prioritised and supported through effective learning solutions.

Govern Learning Quality

Measure Impact

Clear Academy Pathways

A defined and accessible set of learning pathways that provide clarity on skills, development expectations and career growth opportunities across AI, Tech, Data and Online populations.


Prioritised Capability Plan

An annually reviewed and business-aligned capability roadmap that focuses investment on the skills and roles that will have the greatest impact on organisational performance.


Enabled SME Community

A network of capable SMEs who understand their responsibilities within the Academy Model and are equipped to maintain and support local learning solutions.


Skills & Capability Insights

Essential

Desirable

What Success Looks Like

  • Critical AI, Technology and Data capabilities have clear learning pathways.

  • Learning investment is focused on the areas that most impact business performance.
  • AI adoption, digital capability and data literacy improve across target populations.

  • Asda Allies Inclusion Networks – helping colleagues to make sure everybody is included and that our differences are recognised and celebrated

  • Excellent parental leave policies, including maternity & adoption leave, paternity leave, shared parental leave, neonatal care leave, and support for those doing fertility treatments.

We want all colleagues to be able to bring their best and true selves to work, every day. Simply put, we want our colleagues to be Proud to be Asda and proud to be themselves

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Cloud Security Engineer

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud,” but not everyone knows how to secure it. As a security engineer, you know how to assess and implement requirements that ensure the safety of information systems and protect them against intentional or inadvertent access or destruction. What if you could use your cloud security skills to improve mission critical applications for the Intelligence Community (IC)? We need you to help us develop cloud-based security architectures for some of the IC's most critical systems.

As a security engineer on our team, you’ll evaluate and support the documentation, validation, assessment, and accreditation processes necessary to ensure that Information Technology (IT) systems meet the organization’s Information Assurance (IA) and security requirements. You'll assist in defining organizations’ desired state and risk thresholds and analyze actual state information to assess compliance. You'll work with leaders to advise on codifying strategic objectives into doctrine and procedures that can help meet defined objectives. You'll assist with evaluation of computer applications, software, or specialized utility programs to determine if software assurance best practices are followed. You’ll recommend tools and capabilities based on your research of the current environment and knowledge of various on-premise, cloud-based, and hybrid resources to address security requirements. You will implement the cloud security architectures, tools, and processes that you helped to shape and define. Your technical experience will be vital as you work with IC clients to ensure standards are met with security requirements. This is an opportunity to use the latest cloud technologies as you look for ways to secure your customer’s environment while collaborating with tomorrow’s cloud security experts. This position is located in Reston, Virginia.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience building and administering cloud environments and utilizing cloud-native functionality, COTs, GOTs, and open-source tools to meet objectives

  • Experience with security architecture evaluations, guidance development, and troubleshooting

  • Experience with the Risk Management Framework (RMF)

  • Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam

  • HS diploma or GED

  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 IAT Level III Certification such as SecurityX, CCNP Security, CISA, CISSP, GCED, GCIH, or CCSP Certification within 30 days of start date

  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 Cybersecurity Service Provider-Infrastructure Support Certification (CSSP-IS), including CEH, CySA+, GICSP, SSCP, CHFI, CFR, Cloud+, or CND Certification within 30 days of start date

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with the software development life cycle (SDLC)

  • Experience with cloud technologies

  • Knowledge of multicloud governance and automation such as AWS Control Tower, Azure Landing Zones, or GCP Org Policies

  • Possession of excellent team leadership, development, and client relationship skills

  • Possession of excellent interpersonal skills

  • Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills

title: Laitoshuoltaja Espoon sairaala
description:
Haluatko olla mukana tekemässä merkityksellistä työtä sairaalan puhtaanapidon tehtävissä?

Haemme laitoshuoltajaa 2-vuorotyöhön Espoon sairaalan vuodeosastolle toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen.

HUSin tukipalvelut, viralliselta nimeltään Runkopalvelut, vastaa siitä, että sairaalassa on parhaat mahdolliset puitteet potilaiden hoitamiseksi.

Meillä laitoshuoltajan tehtävät ja työympäristöt ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia. Pääset osaavan ja mukavan tiimisi kanssa varmistamaan, että tilat ovat puhtaat, turvalliset ja viihtyisät sekä asiakkaille että henkilökunnalle. Lisäksi tehtäviisi voi kuulua myös ruokahuollon avustavia tehtäviä, vuodehuoltoa ja muita huoltopalvelutehtäviä.

Työpaikan sijainti: Espoon sairaala, Espoo

Työsuhde: vakituinen, kokoaikainen, 2-vuorotyö

Työehtosopimus ja palkkaus: SOTE-sopimus, tehtäväkohtainen 2473,91€/kk ja sopimuksen mukaiset lisät

Työn aloitus: 1.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan

Tässä videossa pääset tutustumaan laitoshuoltajan työhön:

Miksi töihin HUSin Runkopalveluihin?

  • Monipuolisissa potilaan hoitoa tukevissa tehtävissä olet tärkeä osa sairaalamaailmaa.
  • Kattava perehdytys: kukaan ei joudu kylmiltään työntekoon. Saat myös aina apua perehdytyksen jälkeenkin.
  • Rento ja monimuotoinen työyhteisö, johon jokaisen työntekijän on helppoa tulla mukaan. Meillä kaikki auttavat toisiaan parhaansa mukaan ja töitä tehdään yhdessä hyvällä fiiliksellä.
  • Monipuoliset ura- ja koulutusmahdollisuudet, esimerkiksi mahdollisuuksien mukaan koulutus palvelutyöntekijän tehtäviin.
  • Työterveyshuolto, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja työsuhdematkaetu, tuettu työpaikkaruokailu sekä vaihtuvia henkilökuntaetuja liikunta- ja hyvinvointipalveluista.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Ilahdumme hyvistä vuorovaikutustaidoista ja iloisesta palveluasenteesta, sillä teet töitä tiiviisti työkavereidesi kanssa asiakkaidemme hyvinvoinnin eteen. Lisäksi toivomme ammattimaista ja reipasta työotetta, koska työ on vaihtelevaa ja jokainen työpäivä voi olla erilainen.

Suomen kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito on välttämätön.

Näin haet

Lähetä hakemus sähköisellä hakulomakkeella hakuajan loppuun mennessä. Voimme aloittaa haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laitoshuoltajan tai toimitilahuoltajan tutkinto.

Kelpoisten ja tehtävään soveltuvien hakijoiden puuttuessa työnantaja voi palkata määräajaksi henkilön, jolla on riittävä kokemus alalta.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista ja salmonellasta.

Tehtävään valittavan tulee olla täysi-ikäinen.

Yhteystiedot

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa arkisin palveluesihenkilö Piia Mustalahti 050 428 4932.

description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking an experienced Test Engineer to support our Armament Systems site in Plymouth, MN. This can be filled at the principal (Level 3) or sr. principal (level 4) depending on experience.

This site develops and produces medium and large-caliber ammunition as well as precision capabilities for direct and indirect fire systems. Leading the industry, this team successfully completes lifecycle support for medium-caliber cannons, develops miniature, precision strike weapons for airborne platforms, creates survivability solutions for soldiers and the next generation tactical ammunition for a variety of combat platforms

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure product quality by creating production test equipment for military/aerospace products. Includes programming, debugging, and deploying into production equipment that adjusts, calibrates and certifies device specifications.
  • Design, develop, and implement cost-effective methods of testing for Design Verification (DVT).
  • Maintain and update test equipment supporting functional board level and final acceptance testers. Support production floor test equipment.
  • Understand the functionality of several products to reduce test time or suggest additional tests. Co-lead design reviews and design for testability.
  • Assist with fixture fabrication and ordering of parts and managing suppliers.
  • Prepare test and diagnostic programs, design test fixtures, instrument racks and equipment.
  • Compile data and define changes required in test equipment, test procedures, manufacturing processes, or test requirements.
  • Function as liaison between Design Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering to ensure that innovative new product designs can be manufactured cost effectively with high quality. Perform Design for Testability and coverage analysis.
  • Understand customer requirements documentation and translate to test cases for DVT and production test.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering or equivalent discipline plus:
    • Principal (Level 3): 5 years of professional experience in building and maintaining automated test equipment, OR a Masters degree & 3 years of professional experience in building and maintaining automated test equipment
    • Sr. Principal Test Engineer (Level 4): 8 years of professional experience in building and maintaining automated test equipment (ATE). Or master’s degree plus 6 years of experience; or PhD plus 4 yrs of experience.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain government secret clearance after starting employment (US citizenship required)
  • Experience as Electrical Engineer or Computer Engineer oriented to hardware.
  • Proven Experience in programming languages.. 1-2 years of experience in LabVIEW.
  • Read/understand schematics, understand embedded software and communication protocols.
  • Digital and Analog Electronics experience to design circuitry for signal conditioning and isolation.
  • Knowledge in Electrical and Functional Testers with: Interfaces, Pneumatic Systems, Communication protocols, PXI and GPIB instruments test platforms.
  • Work on-site with flexible work arrangement. Able to travel 10% of time (domestic).
  • Solid communication skills and ability to clearly establish verbal communication with remote audience.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, team-oriented, self-motivated, leadership.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with cross-functional team members.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment that is fast paced, rapidly changing, short turn-around environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering is highly desired.
  • Experience with high-volume device assembly and PCB fabrication practices.
  • Experience designing test fixtures and product testing under high and low temperature extremes.
  • LabVIEW, Python or C++ and OOP experience.
  • Experience with ICT testing and fixture development is a plus (Keysight i3070 preferable).
  • Green belt or experience in the use of Six Sigma tools: DOE, R&R, MSE, DFSS is preferred.
  • PWB layout and design experience.

Secondary Level Salary Range: $123,400.00 - $185,000.00

description:
Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. The Associate Director, Marketing Analytics, Oncology is a strategic and critical role in the US APEX Oncology organization, responsible for driving advanced analytic initiatives to enable core and emerging capabilities across Data and Analytics, Marketing and Sales Operations, Customer Experiences, Digital Transformation, Executive Reporting, and Forecasting. This role will lead key marketing analytics across all Venclexta indications, enabling brand teams navigate an increasingly dynamic and challenging business environment. This role will lead an analytic team to deliver actionable results to stakeholders across the organization.

  • Bachelor's degree in Microbiology, Food Science, or a related scientific field required; advanced degree preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply scientific and technical expertise to ensure product and process safety and deliver right-first-time solutions.
  • Quality Management and manufacturing experience preferred; Factory Quality Manager experience highly desirable.

title: AI Research Engineer
description:
EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. EnCharge’s robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today’s best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems.

About the Role

EnCharge AI is looking for an experienced AI Research Engineer to optimize deep learning models for deployment on edge AI platforms. You will work on model compression, quantization strategies, and efficient inference techniques to improve the performance of AI workloads.

Responsibilities

  • Research and develop quantization-aware training (QAT) and post-training quantization (PTQ) techniques for deep learning models.

  • Implement low-bit precision optimizations (e.g., INT8, BF16).

  • Design and optimize efficient inference algorithms for AI workloads, focusing on latency, memory footprint, and power efficiency.

  • Work with frameworks such as PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, and TVM to deploy optimized models.

  • Analyze accuracy trade-offs and develop calibration techniques to mitigate precision loss in quantized models.

  • Collaborate with hardware engineers to optimize model execution for edge devices, and NPUs.

  • Contribute to research on knowledge distillation, sparsity, pruning, and model compression techniques.

  • Benchmark performance across different hardware and software stacks.

  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI efficiency, model compression, and hardware acceleration.

Qualifications

description:

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Site Observability Engineer to design and operate the metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting platforms that give engineering teams confidence in the systems they run. The role spans the full observability stack — from collection agents and pipelines to long-term storage, dashboards, and alerting workflows — with a strong focus on usability, signal quality, and operational ROI. The ideal candidate has built and operated observability platforms at scale, understands the trade-offs between open-source and SaaS approaches, and can translate noisy telemetry into actionable insight for both engineers and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate enterprise-grade observability platforms covering metrics, logs, traces, events, and synthetic monitoring.
  • Architect Prometheus / Thanos / Mimir, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry, and Datadog deployments for high availability and scale.
  • Develop standards for service instrumentation, including OpenTelemetry adoption, metric naming, label cardinality, and structured logging conventions.
  • Define and enforce SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets, and build the dashboards and alerts that operationalize them.
  • Build alerting strategies that minimize noise, surface actionable signals, and integrate cleanly with on-call workflows in PagerDuty, Opsgenie, or similar tools.
  • Operate large-scale time-series and log storage platforms, balancing retention, query performance, and cost.
  • Design distributed tracing pipelines and help teams use traces to diagnose latency and reliability issues.
  • Develop self-service tooling, paved-road libraries, and templates that make adoption of observability standards easy for product teams.
  • Drive cost management and label-cardinality discipline across the observability estate.
  • Lead incident response readiness improvements through better dashboards, alerting hygiene, and post-incident analysis tooling.
  • Partner with SRE and platform teams to integrate observability into deployment pipelines, canary analysis, and progressive delivery workflows.
  • Evaluate and recommend observability vendors and open-source tools based on cost, capability, and operational maturity.
  • Mentor engineering teams on observability fundamentals, debugging techniques, and SLO-driven operations.
  • Maintain documentation, onboarding guides, and runbooks for the observability platform.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in SRE, platform engineering, or observability roles.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, and at least one major commercial observability platform such as Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk.
  • Strong understanding of OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, and structured logging.
  • Proficiency in at least one general-purpose language such as Go, Python, or Java.
  • Experience operating high-cardinality, high-throughput metrics and log pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of SLOs, error budgets, and SRE principles.
  • Experience integrating observability with CI/CD and incident management tooling.
  • Solid grasp of Linux internals, networking, and container platforms.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Thanos, Mimir, Cortex, Loki, or Tempo at scale.
  • Contributions to OpenTelemetry or observability open-source projects.
  • Familiarity with eBPF-based observability tooling.
  • Experience driving observability cost optimization initiatives.
  • Exposure to regulated environments with audit-grade logging requirements.

Northrop Grumman's Space Sector is seeking an Electromechanical Engineer - Level 3/4 to join the Vehicle Engineering Directorate within Western Region Engineering. This position is located onsite in Redondo Beach, CA.

Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Perform Electromechanical engineering on multiple projects through all phases of development and manufacturing
  • Develop technical specifications, conceptual designs, trade studies, detail designs, procedures, assembly, testing, and reports
  • Assist with technical data packages including fabrication, source control, and assembly drawings in accordance with internal drawing standards

  • Assist with internal design reviews, provide, and incorporate feedback from reviewers and management
  • Employ strong interpersonal and communication skills while contributing to an integrated product team
  • Demonstrate accountability to obtain results and contribute to organizational objectives

This requisition may be filled at a higher grade based on qualifications listed below.

Basic Qualifications for Electromechanical Engineer - Level 3:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline with 5 years of relevant experience; OR Master’s degree in STEM with 3 years of relevant experience; OR PhD in STEM with 1 year of relevant experience
  • Must have active SCI access at the time of application or an active Top-Secret clearance with the ability to obtain SCI access within a reasonable period, as determined by the company, prior to the start date
  • Experience with mechanisms design, Electromechanical or opto-mechanical
  • Experience with Creo, SolidWorks, NX, or CATIA V5/3DExp industry CAD software

Basic Qualifications for Electromechanical Engineer - Level 4:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline with 8 years of relevant experience; OR Master’s degree in STEM with 6 years of relevant experience; OR PhD in STEM with 4 years of relevant experience
  • Must have active SCI access at the time of application or an active Top-Secret clearance with the ability to obtain SCI access within a reasonable period, as determined by the company, prior to the start date
  • Experience with mechanisms design, Electromechanical or opto-mechanical
  • Experience with Creo, SolidWorks, NX, or CATIA V5/3DExp industry CAD software

Preferred Qualifications:

  • M.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering or related STEM technical discipline
  • Experience with the design, development, analysis, and verification of moving mechanical assemblies (e.g. mechanisms or electro-mechanical products) for space applications
  • Proficiency with Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerance (GD&T)
  • Experience working on Special Access Programs
  • Active U.S. Government TS/SCI clearance

Primary Level Salary Range: $114,000.00 - $171,000.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $142,200.00 - $213,400.00

title: Pool Technician
description:
The Technician is responsible for performing a variety of general maintenance and repair duties across the property to ensure all facilities, equipment, and systems are functional, safe, and well-maintained. This role supports the Engineering Department in routine upkeep, troubleshooting, and emergency repair services to maintain optimal operations and guest satisfaction.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide friendly, prompt, and professional service to guests and team members.
  • Conduct routine inspections, repairs, and preventative maintenance on facility equipment and property systems.
  • Repair or replace broken equipment and fixtures throughout the property as needed.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment, complying with all safety protocols.
  • Assist with basic troubleshooting and repairs involving electrical, plumbing, and carpentry systems.
  • Operate hand tools, power tools, lifts, and other maintenance equipment safely and effectively.
  • Perform general property maintenance including furniture repair, door adjustments, light fixture replacements, and minor construction tasks.
  • Safely handle and utilize chemicals, including those used for pool maintenance, while following appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) protocols.
  • Test pool and spa water to maintain correct chlorine, pH, and alkalinity levels; log and respond to abnormal readings.
  • Maintain and repair pool and spa filtration systems, including skimmer and pump baskets, jets, valves, and tile.
  • Follow safety policies and procedures including Lock Out/Tag Out (LOTO), MSDS compliance, hazard communication, and proper PPE usage.
  • Communicate effectively with other departments to respond to maintenance requests in a timely and professional manner.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:
This position does have direct supervisory responsibilities but may provide guidance or support to other team members.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Basic knowledge of building systems and repair practices, including plumbing, electrical, carpentry, and HVAC.
  • Ability to safely operate and maintain tools, machinery, and equipment related to general facility upkeep.
  • Understanding of workplace safety requirements, including chemical handling and emergency response.
  • Strong communication skills; able to follow directions and communicate effectively via two-way radios.
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team while maintaining a focus on safety and service quality.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • Technical or vocational training in a maintenance-related trade (e.g., HVAC, electrical, plumbing) preferred.
  • Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in general maintenance, repair, or a technical trade required.
  • Basic understanding of mechanical, electrical, or plumbing systems.
  • Experience performing routine maintenance tasks, repairs, and inspections.
  • Familiarity with hand and power tools and the ability to follow safety procedures.
  • Prior experience in a commercial, hospitality, or facilities environment preferred.
  • Ability to work independently, follow instructions, and complete work orders in a timely manner.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

LICENSES, CERTIFICATES, REGISTRATIONS:

Must have successfully completed a background check and obtained a gaming license issued by the Morongo Gaming Agency, as required.

LANGUAGE SKILLS:

Must be able to read and interpret documents in English, such as instructions, guidelines, policies, and procedures. Must also be able to communicate clearly and effectively with team members, management, and guests.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

  • Communication Skills: Must be able to communicate clearly and professionally with supervisors, team members, vendors, and other departments in person and via radio; must be able to follow written and verbal instructions and relay technical issues accurately.
  • Lifting and Carrying: Frequently lifts, carries, and moves tools, parts, equipment, and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds; may assist with heavier items using carts or team lifting techniques.
  • Manual Dexterity: Regularly uses hands and fingers to operate hand tools, power tools, diagnostic devices, and control systems; must perform technical repairs and installations with precision.
  • Mobility: Frequently walks, climbs ladders, bends, kneels, crouches, and crawls to access mechanical areas, equipment, and tight spaces; must be able to perform tasks in a variety of physical positions and environments.
  • Stationary Work: Occasionally remains seated to complete documentation, review service manuals, or input data into computerized systems.
  • Tool Operation: Regular use of maintenance tools, diagnostic instruments, electronic testing devices, computers, and lifts; responsible for proper handling and safe operation of all tools and equipment.
  • Visual Acuity: Requires strong near and far vision, depth perception, and the ability to read schematics, wiring diagrams, technical manuals, and equipment displays; must be able to identify mechanical or electronic faults accurately.
  • Working Conditions: Routinely works in mechanical rooms, utility spaces, and operational areas both indoors and outdoors; exposed to loud noise, high and low temperatures, moving machinery, dust, chemicals, electrical systems, and a smoking environment in or near the casino or public areas.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

This is a dynamic, fast-paced environment that requires the ability to adapt and perform under pressure. The casino operates with moderate to loud noise levels and is a smoking environment, requiring team members to work comfortably in these conditions.

WORKING HOURS:

Morongo Casino Resort & Spa operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year; therefore, flexibility in scheduling is essential. Team members must be available to work shifts that may include evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events. Schedules are subject to change based on business needs and may include overtime, as well as work on both weekdays and weekends.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPRTUNITY (EEO) AND INDIAN PREFERENCE:

Morongo Casino Resort & Spa is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives hiring preference to qualified Native Americans as allowed by law. We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or national origin.

We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities as required by the ADA. If you need help or an accommodation during the hiring process, please contact Human Resources.

title: UAC Analyst - Senior
description:
Company Overview
Spry Methods is a proven provider of mission-focused technology, cybersecurity, and program management solutions supporting critical Federal missions. We specialize in delivering integrated, high-impact solutions across cyber operations, enterprise resource management, and mission support services. Our culture emphasizes collaboration, accountability, and innovation - empowering our teams to deliver meaningful outcomes in complex, high-security environments.

Who We're Looking For (Position Overview)

The Senior Data Analyst serves as the analytical lead for the IT Call Center program, driving performance measurement, operational reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining the program's reporting strategy, conducting advanced analyses, and delivering actionable insights that support service delivery, customer satisfaction, and mission success. Working closely with program leadership, operations managers, and government stakeholders, the Senior Data Analyst provides strategic analytical guidance, champions data governance best practices, and helps shape data-driven decisions across the organization.

The ideal candidate is a trusted advisor who combines strong technical expertise with business acumen, thrives in a fast-paced operational environment, and is passionate about transforming data into actionable insights that improve performance, efficiency, and customer outcomes.

What Your Day-To-Day Looks Like (Position Responsibilities)

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will:
Serve as the lead analyst for the Nashville IT Call Center site, managing performance reporting, data analysis, and data governance activities.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reports that provide visibility into call center performance, service levels, workforce utilization, and customer experience.
Analyze complex operational data, including call volumes, ticket trends, handle times, first call resolution, SLA compliance, escalations, and customer satisfaction.
Prepare and quality-check customer-facing reports, executive briefings, and performance summaries to ensure accuracy, clarity, and timely delivery.
Provide data-driven recommendations to program leadership and government stakeholders to support operational decisions and continuous improvement.
Lead process improvement initiatives by identifying trends, performance gaps, and opportunities to improve service delivery.
Develop and maintain reporting standards, data dictionaries, templates, and analytical documentation to support consistency and data quality.
Partner with operations leadership to support workforce planning, capacity analysis, staffing recommendations, and resource allocation.
Serve as the primary analytical liaison between the Nashville site and headquarters reporting teams to ensure consistent reporting methods and data definitions.
Identify data quality issues, reporting risks, and performance trends, and recommend mitigation strategies.
Lead operational reviews and customer briefings by presenting analytical findings and responding to stakeholder questions.
Mentor junior and mid-level analysts by reviewing work products, sharing best practices, and supporting analytical skill development.
Support quality assurance activities by analyzing call monitoring results, ticket quality scores, and customer feedback trends.
Contribute to proposal and business development efforts as needed through performance data, analytical narratives, and past performance support.

What You Need to Succeed (Minimum Requirements)

Active Public Trust or ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Public Trust.
U.S. Citizenship or lawful permanent residency (Green Card) in accordance with customer requirements.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Administration, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operational reporting, or a related analytical role, with progressively increasing responsibility.
Experience designing, implementing, and managing enterprise performance measurement frameworks, reporting programs, and executive-level dashboards.
Experience developing and maintaining advanced data visualizations, scorecards, and analytical reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Proven experience leading data-driven process improvement initiatives within a service delivery, call center, help desk, or other SLA-driven operational environment.
Experience supporting federal government programs or working within a government contracting environment.
Demonstrated experience mentoring analysts, leading analytical workstreams, and providing technical guidance to team members.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex analytical findings and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and government stakeholders.
Expert-level analytical skills with experience interpreting large, complex datasets to identify trends, root causes, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, Power Query, and advanced reporting functions.
Advanced proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence and data visualization tools.
Strong SQL skills with experience extracting, transforming, and analyzing data from multiple data sources and ITSM platforms.
Extensive experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or comparable systems.
Strong knowledge of ITIL principles, incident management, problem management, SLA governance, and continuous service improvement practices.
Experience leading data governance initiatives, including development of reporting standards, data quality controls, data dictionaries, and analytical process documentation.
Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority analytical initiatives and stakeholder relationships simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Experience delivering executive briefings, customer-facing reports, and strategic performance assessments.
Ability to obtain and maintain any required customer security clearance.

Ideally, You Also Have (Preferred Qualifications)

Active Secret clearance or higher.
Advanced ITIL certification and/or Lean Six Sigma certification.
Experience with Python, R, statistical analysis, predictive analytics, or machine learning.
PMP certification or experience leading complex analytical initiatives and programs.
Experience with enterprise data warehouses, ETL processes, and data integration tools.
Familiarity with federal IT governance frameworks, including FITARA, FedRAMP, and NIST.Experience developing quality assurance analytics, customer satisfaction programs, and call center performance frameworks.
Experience with workforce management platforms and enterprise call center analytics tools.
Familiarity with cloud-based analytics platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Experience supporting proposal development, capability development, and past performance documentation.
HDI Support Center Analyst (HDI-SCA) or equivalent IT service management certification.

title: Senior Analyst, Quality Control Analytical
description:
Genefab is seeking an experienced analyst to join it’s Quality Control Analytical group. In this role, you will support the GMP QC testing at GeneFab, with a focus on testing, method transfer, qualification, troubleshooting and investigations.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical expertise (SME).
  • Provide technical support to Analytical Development and QC Analytical Operations as needed.
  • Develop, implement, and update all Quality Control SOPs, testing records and other documentation needed for cGMP compliance.
  • Perform QC testing on in-process and final product samples to support release and stability testing.
  • Lead and perform technical root-cause investigations for aberrant results and deviations relating to analytical methods.
  • Lead and train junior employees to ensure testing procedures and practices comply with all applicable regulations and procedures.
  • Plan, lead, and execute analytical method transfers, qualifications, and validations.
  • Draft, Review, and Approve Method Transfer Protocols and Reports
  • Generate and review procedures, protocols and reports.
  • Proactively identify areas for continuous improvement in processes and procedures and lead these initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with Interdepartmental MSAT, ASAT, and Manufacturing groups to support, execute, and/or provide oversight in the execution of method optimization, characterization, troubleshooting, transfer, and qualification
  • Perform additional duties as assigned

    • Requirements

  • B.S. degree in biology or related field with experience in cell therapy, immunology, cancer biology, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of GMP/QC Laboratory experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work in cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with relevant technologies such as: multicolor flow cytometry, cell culture (e.g., aseptic techniques, cell line expansion), multiplexed immunoassay, qPCR, and dPCR methods, Luminex, and ELISA.
  • Experience in GMP.
  • Experience with contract laboratories and or CDMO is a plus
  • Knowledge related to laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and electronic lab notebook record keeping (ELN) is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Word, Excel, Project, and PowerPoint
  • Experience with cell therapy or gene therapy is a plus
  • Availability to work extended hours such as evenings or weekends to meet deadlines when necessary
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with minimal direction and able to adjust workload based on changing priorities
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and willing to accept temporary responsibilities outside of the initial job description
  • Able to lift up to 40 pounds
    • About GeneFab
    GeneFab is a contract manufacturing and synthetic biology biofoundry focused on cell and gene therapies. GeneFab was formed in 2023 with a vision to combine industry leading expertise in synthetic biology with advanced cGMP capabilities in order to accelerate the development and commercialization of genetic medicines. GeneFab offers its customers an extensive technology platform and know-how that spans early stage product design, technical development, and cGMP compliant production. GeneFab's technology platform includes bioinformatic-guided discovery of cell type promoters, directed evolution of small molecule-regulated gene switches, and the engineering of highly sensitive kill switches for enhanced safety and control of cellular therapies.

    We are committed to an inclusive and diverse GeneFab. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse GeneFab team. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.

description:

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is seeking Systems Controls and Simulation Engineer Level 4 for the development and ongoing support of new and existing turbine generators used in surface ship and submarine propulsion and power generation systems for the US Navy based out of Sunnyvale, CA.

What You’ll get to Do:

Our Sunnyvale site specializes in the development, manufacture, assembly and testing of propulsion and power generation systems for naval surface ships and submarines. The candidate selected will apply their skills to support current and future Navy Power & Propulsion development. Responsibilities include:

  • Analyzing control system performance and requirements using systems models
  • Modeling dynamic multi-physics systems from first principles; mechanical, electrical, magnetic
  • Use model reduction methods to simplify systems for control design
  • Perform linear systems analysis
  • Perform stability analysis
  • Build and parameterize uncertainty models
  • Develop nonlinear simulation models
  • Document work to share with engineering community and customer

Must be onsite 4 days a week, remote work is not an option for this role.

Basic Qualifications for level T4:

  • Bachelor's Degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) discipline with 8 years relevant work experience; or Master’s Degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) with 6 years relevant experience; or Ph.D in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) with 3 years of relevant work experience.
  • Experience in frequency domain analysis.
  • Experience characterizing and analyzing system stability.
  • Experience with block diagrams and linear algebra.
  • Experience with grey-box model validation.
  • Proficiency with MATLAB coding and Simulink modeling.
  • Experience building state space models of multiphysical systems.
  • Experience with numerical methods for solving differential equations.
  • Must be a US citizen.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Secret Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active US Government Secret clearance.
  • Master's degree or higher in Aerospace, Mechanical, or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • Controller tuning experience on real machines
  • Experience with ModelCenter Integrate and Explore
  • Familiar with rotordynamic analysis
  • Familiar with FEA and super elements models
  • Familiar with electromagnetics
  • Experience designing weighting functions to meet operating criteria of large, MIMO systems
  • Performing robust control design

title: QA Specialist
description:
About Us:

Drake is a high-tech manufacturing company based in Cypress, Texas. We proudly serve leading customers across aircraft, space, energy, semiconductor, defense, medical, and other highly regulated industries.

We work in a collaborative, supportive environment where employees are valued, empowered, and provided opportunities for hands-on learning and professional growth. At Drake, customers are our focus, and we build success together.


Position Summary:

The Quality Assurance Specialist supports the effectiveness of the quality management system by ensuring products, processes, and documentation meet customer, engineering, regulatory, and company requirements. This position works closely with Quality and Manufacturing to support inspections, investigate quality issues, maintain accurate records, and promote compliance and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like:

During your first year, you will:

  • Ensure product and process quality — Support visual and dimensional inspections, first articles, product releases, and other quality activities to verify compliance with drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.
  • Maintain quality documentation — Complete, review, and maintain inspection records, FAI documentation, QC releases, nonconformance records, and other QMS documentation.
  • Support quality investigations — Participate in nonconformance, corrective action, root-cause, and MRB activities to identify issues and prevent recurrence.
  • Strengthen QMS compliance — Support quality procedures, internal audits, document control, calibration, and other activities necessary to maintain an effective and audit-ready quality system.
  • Partner with production — Work with manufacturing teams to resolve quality concerns, improve specification compliance, and reduce defects, NCRs, and scrap.
  • Promote continuous improvement — Identify opportunities to strengthen quality processes and provide training and guidance to employees on quality requirements and procedures.

What We’re Looking For:

The ideal candidate will bring:

  • 1–3 years of quality assurance, quality control, or inspection experience in manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of quality systems, documentation practices, and corrective action processes.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
  • Familiarity with precision measurement and inspection tools.
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with AS9100D, ISO 9001, or a similar regulated quality system.
  • Knowledge of GD&T, AS9102 First Article Inspection, MRB, CAPA, or internal audits.
  • Experience with CMMs, vision systems, or other advanced inspection equipment.


      Work Environment / Schedule: (as applicable):

      Primarily a shop and quality-lab environment involving product inspection, quality documentation, manufacturing support, and computer-based work. This position follows a 4/10 schedule, Monday through Thursday, 7:00 a.m. – 5:30 p.m.


      Why Join Drake?

      Drake offers competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, and 401(k), along with a collaborative culture built on integrity, innovation, and continuous improvement. We are committed to helping our employees grow through hands-on experience, ongoing training, and opportunities for career advancement.

      Drake Plastics is a drug-free workplace. All applicants who receive conditional offers of employment will be subject to pre-employment drug testing.

Job Description

Patient Service Representative serves as the first point of contact for patients within the Valley Health physicians’ network. This is a key role in the patient experience and must demonstrate excellence in all patient and customer encounters including face-to-face and telephone interactions. This position assures that a high-quality patient experience takes place by providing administrative support to the ambulatory care team through excellent customer service, attention to detail and interpersonal skills. This position is responsible for the accurate and appropriate scheduling of patients for optimum care and provider efficiency. This position is responsible for collecting accurate demographic and financial information during the scheduling and/or registration processes to ensure full and timely revenue capture.

Appointment Scheduling and Referral Functions

Listens to patients requests for an appointment and then schedules an outpatient appointment while following clinic scheduling guidelines. Offers alternate providers or locations when appropriate to meet the patients’ needs. Raises up patients’ needs that they cannot meet to Office Coordinator or Practice Manager.


Electronically selects and sends appropriate appointment reminder letter to the patient in accordance with clinic scheduling guidelines.

Utilizes all available scheduling functions, such as Wait Lists, to aid service to patients as appropriate.

Follow established clinic scheduling guidelines when cancelling and rescheduling appointments. Directs any requests from providers or other staff to adjust appointment schedules to Office Coordinator or Practice Manager for review and approval before acting.

Process urgent requests for referrals same day. Process routine referral requests within 72 hours.

Obtains prior approval or prior authorization as needed. Communicates referral appointment and appointment instructions to patient.

Performs Reception Functions

Receives and greets every patient in a courteous and friendly manner using a welcoming and positive tone, words and actions. Patients are serviced with the objective of meeting patient needs.

Ensures new patients are provided appropriate documents as determined by the practice.

Raises up emergent situations or expressed patient problems or concerns directly to Office Coordinator or Practice Manager for assistance.

Supports the care team with keeping patients informed about any delays in the delivery of care the patient might experience in the waiting room and exam room.

Performs Registration Functions

Obtains all information necessary to complete the outpatient registration process assuring demographic and financial/insurance information is correct and entered accurately into the Epic system.

Assures correct data capture and data entry necessary for regulatory agencies and compliance requirements.

Maintains required level of knowledge and proficiency in all core functions (demographic and financial information capture, insurance eligibility and verification, regulatory and compliance monitoring) of front desk operations.

Collection of Payments/Cash Handling

Conveys to patient what payment is due based upon Insurance card or insurance verification and requests of patient how they will be paying today (cash, check, credit card).

Receive and receipt all payments accurately as determined by daily cash verification process.

Maintain and balance cash drawer accurately as determined by daily cash up process.

Telephone Functions

Answers phones within 3 rings using a 3-part greeting (Name of clinic, your name, “How may I help you?”).

Ends calls courteously by asking patient if there is anything else we can for them today.

Takes clear, complete and accurate phone messages or prescription requests using the Epic messaging system.

Health Information Management Functions

Date stamps all incoming patient related information and delivers to appropriate provider or staff person for action on a daily basis.

Prepares accurately all correspondence to patients and/or other entities as directed by providers or other staff person.

Sends requests for routine or subpoenaed medical record releases to assigned HIM location for processing. Handles same day requests for medical records for patient care continuity as needed. Seeks assistance from HIM resources with any questions related to medical records release process.

Receives, process and distributes incoming mail in a timely manner and in accordance with established clinic processes.

Patient Health Information is accessed to perform job responsibilities and for no other reason. Patient information is kept confidential and discussed on a need-to-know basis only.

Cross Coverage/Office Support Functions

Covers at other locations performing like office functions as requested in times of staffing shortages or during workload efficiency adjustments.

Maintains sufficient office supplies and required forms for daily front desk operations.

Maintains departmental filing system accurately. Classifies, sorts, distributes and/or files correspondence, articles, mail, records and other documents.

Opens and/or closes clinic according to practice guidelines

Performs Similar or Related Duties as Requested or Directed

Performs other duties as requested and observed.

High School Diploma or equivalent is required.

Associates degree is preferred.

Experience

(1) year of relevant work experience is required.

Associate's degree may substitute for one year of relevant work experience.

Qualifications

Customer service experience preferred.

Strong computer, customer service and communication skills required.

Ability to prioritize work.

Ability to handle confidential information and sensitive situations required.

Interpersonal skills to work with diverse people within and outside organization required.

Benefits

At Valley Health, we believe everyone is a caregiver, and our goal is to create an environment where our caregivers thrive physically, financially, and emotionally. In addition to a competitive salary, our most popular benefits for full-time employees include:

  • A Zero-Deductible Health Plan
  • Dental and vision insurance
  • Generous Paid Time Off

Valley Health also offers a health savings account & flexible spending account for childcare, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, and professional development. Creative Therapy Solution provides ABA (Applied Behavior Analysis) services to families across Arizona.   • Ability to work independently and manage deadlines
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information
  • Reliable internet access
  • Must pass a background check

Nice to have:

  • Experience billing multiple Arizona payers (Mercy Care, BCBS, Aetna, United, etc.)

Schedule & Pay
